plugin.source: 3rd of Rain's Hand, 4E 175 The war is finally over. It seems like nothing's been achieved - so many humans died to the Elven onslaught, just for us to negotiate with them. At least I met Jori. Maro asked me if I wanted to join the Penitus Oculatus, which was being expanded quite a bit since the Blades were disbanded, and they needed good soldiers. A flattering offer, but I refused. Jori's with child, and she wants to go back to Skyrim. [pagebreak] 22nd of Hearthfire, 4E 175 I've seen a lot of unforgettable things in my life, and not all of them were good. Laying eyes on my daughter for the first time, though, was really something else. Childbirth is more gruesome than some of of the toughest battles I've seen, and I'm really sorry I put Jori through all this, but it was still all worth it. Jori said I could give her an Imperial name, since she'd dragged me up to this freezing wasteland. I like Lydia. Lydia Delinus. [pagebreak] 15th of First Seed, 4E 180 Never would have imagined it. Fifteen years ago, I was picking pockets in Bravil. Five years later, I was fighting the Dominion under the Emperor's banner. Now, I'm married to one of the most amazing women I've ever met with a five-year-old daughter. Life is boring compared to what it used to be. Jori and I still practice a few times a week, but thankfully, a life of "excitement" is behind us. [pagebreak] 29th of Second Seed, 4E 181 Jori had seemed distressed for a while, so I tried talking to her while Lydia was out playing. She made the most absurd confession I've ever heard, and as much as I trust her, I'm not even sure on this. Apparently, after the war ended, she was offered a place in the Circle for all her valor. I always thought she left the companions for me and Lydia, but it turns out there was another part of the question. All the ranking members of the Companions are werewolves, and she'd have had to become one to stay with them. She refused. [pagebreak] 24th of Midyear, 4E 185 I failed Jori. I failed Lydia. I let those bastards surround me, leave me crippled, kill my wife, and ransack my home. I want to go outside and vomit, but I can't even stand up. I guess I should have done that before I crawled inside. Stendarr be praised for Lydia's survival in all that. She's turning into a smart lass. I told her to check the area for guard patrols, since niether of us can fight. My hope is to get one man posted at the farm, and another going into town to find a healer from a temple. [pagebreak] 5th of Last Seed, 4E 185 Danica finally got my legs working again. The moment she left, Lydia told me she wanted to learn how to fight. She's only ten years old, but I don't think I have much of a choice. The Red-Tundra bandits are still out there, and she needs be able to protect herself. I started teaching her basic sword stances. I hope this isn't a mistake. [pagebreak] 3rd of First Seed, 4E 186 I accidently hit Lydia while we were training today. Wasn't exactly soft, unfortunately. She broke down crying, and I embraced her right away and apologized. A minute later, with tears still in her eyes, she asked me if we could keep training. I was unsure about it, but she insisted. [pagebreak] 23rd of Sun's Dawn, 4E 191 Managed to kill a few more of those Red-Tundra bastards. I've been culling their numbers for a while now, but now that Lydia's old enough to hold the fort on her own, I was able to go out and track them to one of their camps. Issue is, I've come down with a bad fever ever since I went in there. Nasty horker-bellies kept that place disgusting, and were probably full of disease. [pagebreak] 11th of Frostfall, 4E 192 I can barely even get out of bed at this point. What I thought was a simple fever stuck around for almost two years, and now I'm worried it might be the end of me. In truth, part of me has wished I was dead since I lost Jori. Watching her die helplessly was the worst moment of my entire life, and I haven't recovered from it. I couldn't leave Lydia on her own, though. Not in a million years. Does wanting to die make me a coward? Should I be more resentful about my illness, and not accept my fate out of grief? I suppose that's the last question of my life. Lydia's sixteen now, and she's strong enough to wear her mother's old armor. She's turning into a skilled fighter and a beautiful young lass, and those two together have me concerned. Not to mention her willfullness. At least she'll be able to fend for herself. [pagebreak]
plugin.seed: 第四纪175年雨手月3日 战争终于结束了。似乎什么都没有达成——这么多人死于精灵的袭击，最终只换来了我们与他们的谈判。至少我见到了乔莉。 马洛问我是否想加入洞察之眼，自从刀锋卫士解散后，这个组织的规模扩大了不少，他们需要优秀的士兵。一个不错的提议，但我拒绝了。乔莉还带着孩子，她想回天际。 [pagebreak] 第四纪元175年，炉火月22号 我一生中见过很多难忘的事情，但并不是所有的都是好事。然而，第一次看到我的女儿真的令我触动。分娩简直比我见过的最艰难的战斗更可怕，我真的很抱歉我让乔莉经历了这一切，但这一切仍然值得。 乔莉说我可以给她起个帝国人风格的名字，因为她把我带到了这片冰冷的荒原上。我喜欢莱迪亚这个名字，就叫莱迪亚·德林斯。 [pagebreak] 第四纪元180年，初种月15日 十五年前，我还在布拉维尔掏人腰包。过了五年后，我在皇帝的旗帜下与先祖神州作战。现在，我嫁给了我见过的最棒的女人之一，还有一个五岁的女儿。 与过去相比，生活很无聊。乔莉和我每周仍练习几次，但谢天谢地，“兴奋”的生活已经过去了。 [pagebreak] 第四纪元181年，次种月29号 乔莉似乎有一段时间很难过，所以趁着莱迪亚在外面玩，我试着和她聊了一会儿。她做了我听过的最荒谬的忏悔，尽管我信任她，但我还是难以相信。 显然，战争结束后，她因其英勇善战而获得了圆环的一席之地。我一直以为她把同伴留给了我莱迪亚, 但事实证明问题的另一部分是。战友团的所有高级成员都是狼人，她必须成为狼人才能与他们为伍。 她拒绝了。 [pagebreak] 第四纪元185年，年中月24日 我辜负了乔莉。我辜负了莱迪亚。 我真没用，那些混蛋围住了我，让我变成残废，杀害我的妻子，洗劫我的家。我想出去呕吐，但我甚至站不起来。我想我应该在爬进去之前就这么做。 请斯坦德尔保佑莱迪亚能活下去。她现在正在变成一名聪明的女孩。我告诉她要去找找这附近是否有守卫在巡逻，因为我们中没有人有能力去战斗。我的希望是能找到一个人帮助我们继续农场的工作，再找到一个人能帮我们去寻找神殿中的医生。 [pagebreak] 第四纪元，末种月5日 丹尼卡终于让我的腿恢复了。她离开的那一刻，莱迪亚告诉我她想学习如何战斗。她才十岁，但我觉得我别无选择。红苔的强盗团仍在那里，她需要能够保护自己。 我开始教她基本的剑姿。我希望这不是个错误。 [pagebreak] 第四纪元186年，初种月3日 当我们今天训练的时侯，我不小心撞到了莱迪亚。不幸的是，撞得不轻。她哭了，我马上拥抱她并道歉。一分钟后，她眼泪汪汪地问我是否可以继续训练。我对此不确定，但她坚持了下来。 [pagebreak] 第四纪元191年日晓月23日， 又杀了几个红苔杂种。我已经统计他们人数有一段时间了，但现在莱迪亚年纪够大了，已经可以独自守住堡垒，我可以出去追踪他们直到他们的一个营地。 问题是，自从我进去之后，我就一直高烧不退。恶心的海象把那里弄得异常恶心，而且可能到处都是疾病。 [pagebreak] 第四纪元192年，霜落月11日 在这一点上我甚至都无法下床了。我以为一场简单的发烧持续了近两年，现在我担心这可能是我的末日。 事实上，自从我失去乔莉后，我的一部分就已经死去了。看着她无助地死去是我一生中最糟糕的时刻，我还没有从中恢复过来。我无法离开莱迪亚 不过，还是得靠她自己。自杀会让我变成懦夫吗？我是否应该对自己的病更加愤懑，不因悲伤而接受命运？我想这是我生命中的最后一个问题。 莱迪亚她现在16岁了，她已经足够强壮，可以穿上她母亲的旧盔甲了。她正在变成一个熟练的战士和一个美丽的年轻姑娘，她依旧让我担心，更不用说她的任性了。 至少她能养活自己。 [pagebreak]
plugin.target: 第四紀175年雨手月3日 戰爭終於結束了。似乎什麼都沒有達成——這麼多人死於精靈的襲擊，最終只換來了我們與他們的談判。至少我見到了喬莉。 馬洛問我是否想加入洞察之眼，自從刀鋒衛士解散後，這個組織的規模擴大了不少，他們需要優秀的士兵。一個不錯的提議，但我拒絕了。喬莉還帶著孩子，她想回天霜。 [pagebreak] 第四紀元175年，爐火月22號 我一生中見過很多難忘的事情，但並不是所有的都是好事。然而，第一次看到我的女兒真的令我觸動。分娩簡直比我見過的最艱難的戰鬥更可怕，我真的很抱歉我讓喬莉經歷了這一切，但這一切仍然值得。 喬莉說我可以給她起個帝國人風格的名字，因為她把我帶到了這片冰冷的荒原上。我喜歡萊迪亞這個名字，就叫萊迪亞·德林斯。 [pagebreak] 第四紀元180年，初種月15日 十五年前，我還在布拉維爾掏人腰包。過了五年後，我在皇帝的旗幟下與先祖神州作戰。現在，我嫁給了我見過的最棒的女人之一，還有一個五歲的女兒。 與過去相比，生活很無聊。喬莉和我每週仍練習幾次，但謝天謝地，“興奮”的生活已經過去了。 [pagebreak] 第四紀元181年，次種月29號 喬莉似乎有一段時間很難過，所以趁著萊迪亞在外面玩，我試著和她聊了一會兒。她做了我聽過的最荒謬的懺悔，儘管我信任她，但我還是難以相信。 顯然，戰爭結束後，她因其英勇善戰而獲得了圓環的一席之地。我一直以為她把同伴留給了我萊迪亞, 但事實證明問題的另一部分是。戰友團的所有高級成員都是狼人，她必須成為狼人才能與他們為伍。 她拒絕了。 [pagebreak] 第四紀元185年，年中月24日 我辜負了喬莉。我辜負了萊迪亞。 我真沒用，那些混蛋圍住了我，讓我變成殘廢，殺害我的妻子，洗劫我的家。我想出去嘔吐，但我甚至站不起來。我想我應該在爬進去之前就這麼做。 請斯坦德爾保佑萊迪亞能活下去。她現在正在變成一名聰明的女孩。我告訴她要去找找這附近是否有守衛在巡邏，因為我們中沒有人有能力去戰鬥。我的希望是能找到一個人幫助我們繼續農場的工作，再找到一個人能幫我們去尋找神殿中的醫生。 [pagebreak] 第四紀元，末種月5日 丹尼卡終於讓我的腿恢復了。她離開的那一刻，萊迪亞告訴我她想學習如何戰鬥。她才十歲，但我覺得我別無選擇。紅苔的強盜團仍在那裡，她需要能夠保護自己。 我開始教她基本的劍姿。我希望這不是個錯誤。 [pagebreak] 第四紀元186年，初種月3日 當我們今天訓練的時侯，我不小心撞到了萊迪亞。不幸的是，撞得不輕。她哭了，我馬上擁抱她並道歉。一分鐘後，她眼淚汪汪地問我是否可以繼續訓練。我對此不確定，但她堅持了下來。 [pagebreak] 第四紀元191年日曉月23日， 又殺了幾個紅苔雜種。我已經統計他們人數有一段時間了，但現在萊迪亞年紀夠大了，已經可以獨自守住堡壘，我可以出去追蹤他們直到他們的一個營地。 問題是，自從我進去之後，我就一直高燒不退。噁心的海象把那裡弄得異常噁心，而且可能到處都是疾病。 [pagebreak] 第四紀元192年，霜落月11日 在這一點上我甚至都無法下床了。我以為一場簡單的發燒持續了近兩年，現在我擔心這可能是我的末日。 事實上，自從我失去喬莉後，我的一部分就已經死去了。看著她無助地死去是我一生中最糟糕的時刻，我還沒有從中恢復過來。我無法離開萊迪亞 不過，還是得靠她自己。自殺會讓我變成懦夫嗎？我是否應該對自己的病更加憤懣，不因悲傷而接受命運？我想這是我生命中的最後一個問題。 萊迪亞她現在16歲了，她已經足夠強壯，可以穿上她母親的舊盔甲了。她正在變成一個熟練的戰士和一個美麗的年輕姑娘，她依舊讓我擔心，更不用說她的任性了。 至少她能養活自己。 [pagebreak]

plugin.source:
<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>
Taro,

I need you to get rid of <Alias=Player>, a Thane of Whiterun. <Alias.Pronoun=Player> is a skilled fighter, and probably the greatest threat to our plans. Apart from <Alias.PronounObj=Player>, there isn't much in the way of finishing what my family started.

Get rid of <Alias.PronounObj=Player> and find Kolgar in Rorikstead. He has your payment.

-V
</font>

塔洛,

我需要你解决掉 <Alias=Player>, 一个白漫的武卫。 <Alias.Pronoun=Player> 是一个熟练的战士, 并且可能是我们计划的最大威胁。除了 <Alias.PronounObj=Player>, 没有人可以阻止我家族的事业。

解决掉 <Alias.PronounObj=Player> 然后找到洛利克的科尔加。他可以支付你的报酬。

-V

plugin.source: I never saw this coming, darling. You should talk to Maramal, in Riften.

plugin.source: Yes. Let me show you.

plugin.source: Let's see it.

plugin.source: What was it you needed, again?

plugin.target: 我想要你去做件事。

plugin.source: Yes, Thane. What is it?
plugin.seed: 是的，武卫。怎么了？
plugin.target: 是的，男爵。什麼事？
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Am I in your way?
plugin.seed: 我挡你的路了吗？
plugin.target: 我擋你的路了嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Steel yourself. I don't like the looks of this.
plugin.seed: 好好锻炼锻炼。我不喜欢这个样子。
plugin.target: 好好鍛鍊鍛鍊。我不喜歡這個樣子。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You really go out of your way take me to the most romantic places, don't you?
plugin.seed: 你真是特意带我去最浪漫的地方，是吗？
plugin.target: 你真是特意帶我去最浪漫的地方，是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Ysmir's beard, look at that. It's amazing.
plugin.seed: 伊斯米尔的胡子，看看那个。太奇妙了。
plugin.target: 伊斯米爾的鬍子，看看那個。太奇妙了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Gods, that's amazing... I'm glad your here to see this with me.
plugin.seed: 天啊，太棒了……我很高兴你能和我一起看到这个。
plugin.target: 天啊，太棒了……我很高興你能和我一起看到這個。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Thinking of going in there? Might not be the safest thing to do, but I've got your back.
plugin.seed: 想进去吗？可能不太安全，但我支持你。
plugin.target: 想進去嗎？可能不太安全，但我支持你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Look at that ruin. The ancestors were almost as clever as the Dwarves were, the way they built it.
plugin.seed: 看看那个废墟。我们的祖先就像矮人一样聪明，看看他们建造它的方式。
plugin.target: 看看那個廢墟。我們的祖先就像矮人一樣聰明，看看他們建造它的方式。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You don't see Dwarven ruins every day. Thinking of heading inside?
plugin.seed: 您不会每天都看能到矮人废墟。想进去吗？
plugin.target: 您不會每天都看能到矮人廢墟。想進去嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I need to trade some things with you.
plugin.seed: 我想要跟你交换些东西。
plugin.target: 我想要跟你交換些東西。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: I am sworn to carry your burdens.
plugin.seed: 我已经宣誓替你分担一切。
plugin.target: 我已經宣誓替你分擔一切。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: I never loved you, anyway.
plugin.seed: 我从没爱过你。
plugin.target: 無論如何，我從沒愛過你。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Are you serious? After all we've been through, you're just going to...? You should be ashamed.
plugin.seed: 你是认真的？在我们经历了这么多之后，你只是要……？你真该感到羞耻。
plugin.target: 你是認真的？在我們經歷了這麼多之後，你只是要……？你真該感到羞恥。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: In hindsight, I never really loved you that much.
plugin.seed: 转过头看，我从来没那么爱过你。
plugin.target: 轉過頭看，我從來沒那麼愛過你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It was a mistake. Can we start over?
plugin.seed: 是我错了，我们能重新开始吗？
plugin.target: 這是個錯誤。我們能重新開始嗎？
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: On that, we can agree. I can't say I'm not mad, but at least you came to your senses.
plugin.seed: 在这一点上，我们可以达成一致。我不能说我没有生气，但至少你恢复了理智。
plugin.target: 在這一點上，我們可以達成一致。我不能說我沒有生氣，但至少你恢復了理智。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Sigh* Let's go back to the temple and try this again.
plugin.seed: *叹息*让我们回到神殿，再试一次。
plugin.target: *嘆息*讓我們回到神殿，再試一次。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm sorry, I made a horrible mistake. Can you give me another chance, Lydia?
plugin.seed: 对不起，我犯了大错。你能再给我一次机会吗，莱迪亚?
plugin.target: 對不起，我犯了大錯。你能再給我一次機會嗎，萊迪亞?
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can't believe what you did. Does everything we went through together mean anything to you?
plugin.seed: 我真不敢相信你会做出这种事。我们一起经历的一切对你还有意义吗？
plugin.target: 我真不敢相信你會做出這種事。我們一起經歷的一切對你還有意義嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You make a good point. Might as well, before some Dragon shouts us to death.
plugin.seed: 很好。也许，在龙吼死我们之前。
plugin.target: 很好。也許，在龍吼死我們之前。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: To tell you the truth, I'm excited. It's sudden, but it's still our wedding.
plugin.seed: 说实话，我很兴奋。这很突然，但这仍然是我们的婚礼。
plugin.target: 說實話，我很興奮。這很突然，但這仍然是我們的婚禮。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That tradition exists because people die quickly here. Out of everyone in Skyrim, we arguably live the most dangerous lives.
plugin.seed: 早婚的传统起源于天际人的短命。而我们过着全天际最危险的生活。
plugin.target: 早婚的傳統起源於天霜人的短命。而我們過著全天霜最危險的生活。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Interested in me, are you?
plugin.seed: 你对我有兴趣，对吧？
plugin.target: 你對我有興趣吧？
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: I know tradition would have us get married quickly, but...
plugin.seed: 我知道传统要求尽快结婚，但是...
plugin.target: 我知道傳統要求儘快結婚，但是...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Maybe some day, but not now.
plugin.seed: 也许是日后有一天，但不是现在。
plugin.target: 也許是日後有一天，但不是現在。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're right, it'd be too sudden.
plugin.seed: 你说得对，这太突然了。
plugin.target: 你說得對，這太突然了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Follow me.
plugin.seed: 跟着我。
plugin.target: 跟著我。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: As you will, my Thane. I will protect you with my life.
plugin.seed: 如您所愿，武卫。我会用生命保护您。
plugin.target: 悉聽尊意，男爵大人。我會用生命保護您。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Wait here.
plugin.seed: 在这里等着。
plugin.target: 在這裡等著。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: As you wish, my Thane.
plugin.seed: 如您所愿，武卫大人。
plugin.target: 悉聽尊便，男爵大人。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: This is it... today, it's just you and me.
plugin.seed: 就是这样……今天，只有你和我。
plugin.target: 就是這樣……今天，只有你和我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Are you serious? After all we've been through, you're just going to...? You should be ashamed.
plugin.seed: 你是认真的？在我们经历了这么多之后，你只是要……？你真该感到羞耻。
plugin.target: 你是認真的？在我們經歷了這麼多之後，你只是要……？你真該感到羞恥。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't want to see you ever again.
plugin.seed: 没想到会再次遇到你。
plugin.target: 沒想到會再次遇到你。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: What does a housecarl do?
plugin.seed: 侍卫的职责是什么？
plugin.target: 侍衛的職責是什麼？
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: As my Thane, I'm sworn to your service. I'll guard you, and all you own, with my life.
plugin.seed: 我宣誓为你效忠，武卫。我是你的侍卫，以我的生命保护你的一切。
plugin.target: 我宣誓為你效忠，男爵。我是你的護衛，以我的生命保護你的一切。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: I keep you and your belongings safe, or die trying. Before you, I was responsible for guarding the Jarl's children.
plugin.seed: 我保护你和你的财物安全，否则我会死的。在你之前，我负责保护领主的孩子。
plugin.target: 我保護你和你的財物安全，否則我會死的。在你之前，我負責保護領主的孩子。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: As much as I respect Jarl Balgruuf... his spawn are a nightmare.
plugin.seed: 尽管我很尊重巴尔古夫领主...但是他的孩子简直是噩梦。
plugin.target: 儘管我很尊重巴爾古夫領主...但是他的孩子簡直是噩夢。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Long life to you, Thane.
plugin.seed: 愿您长寿，武卫大人。
plugin.target: 願您平安健康，男爵大人。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: I am your sword and your shield.
plugin.seed: 我就是你的剑和你的盾。
plugin.target: 我願為你赴湯蹈火，在所不辭。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Honor to you, my Thane.
plugin.seed: 很荣幸为你服务，我的武卫大人。
plugin.target: 願榮耀與您同在，男爵大人。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: What do you need, my Thane?
plugin.seed: 您有什么吩咐吗，我的武卫大人？
plugin.target: 有何差遣，男爵大人？
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Honored to see you again, my Thane.
plugin.seed: 很荣幸再见到你，我的武卫大人。
plugin.target: 很榮幸又能見到您，男爵大人。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: The Jarl has appointed me to be your housecarl. It's an honor to serve you.
plugin.seed: 领主任命我做你的侍卫，很荣幸为你服务。
plugin.target: 領主任命我做你的侍衛，很榮幸為你服務。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Living with you would be perfect.
plugin.seed: 和你一起生活将会很完美。
plugin.target: 和你一起生活將會很完美。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: We could live in my house in Whiterun.
plugin.seed: 我们可以住在我在白漫城的房子里。
plugin.target: 我們可以去我白漫城的房子居住。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: I have a house in Riften.
plugin.seed: 我在裂谷城有栋房子。
plugin.target: 我在裂谷城有棟房子。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: My house in Markarth would be perfect.
plugin.seed: 我在马卡斯城的房子将会很完美。
plugin.target: 我在馬卡斯城的房子將會很完美。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: How about my house in Windhelm?
plugin.seed: 我在风舵城的房子怎么样？
plugin.target: 我在風舵城的房子怎麼樣？
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Let's live in my house in Solitude.
plugin.seed: 让我们住在我在独孤城的房子里吧。
plugin.target: 那我們就去我在獨孤城的房子居住吧。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Your old place would suit us just fine.
plugin.seed: 你的老地方会很适合我们的。
plugin.target: 你的原本的住處會很適合我們。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Breezehome, my house in Whiterun.
plugin.seed: 微风阁，我在白漫城的房子。
plugin.target: 微風閣，我在白漫城的房子。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Honeyside, my house in Riften.
plugin.seed: 甜蜜湾，我在裂谷城的房子。
plugin.target: 甜蜜灣，我在裂谷城的房子。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Vlindrel Hall, my house in Markarth.
plugin.seed: 林德尔会堂，我在马卡斯城的房子。
plugin.target: 林德爾會堂，我在馬卡斯城的房子。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Hjerim, my house in Windhelm.
plugin.seed: 霜斋，我在风舵城的房子。
plugin.target: 霜齋，我在風舵城的房子。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: A house in Solitude with "Manor" in the name? Stendarr's mercy, taking the gold off of bandits and draugr you killed pays better than I thought.
plugin.seed: 一栋名为“别墅”的独孤住宅？斯坦达尔在上，从你杀死的土匪和流氓身上拿走金币看来比我想象的要划算。
plugin.target: 一棟名為“別墅”的獨孤住宅？斯坦達爾在上，從你殺死的土匪和流氓身上拿走金幣看來比我想像的要划算。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm joking, I'll meet you there. But, I could use a new set of armor, considering all that money you have.
plugin.seed: 我开玩笑的，我在那里等你。但是，考虑到你所有的钱，我本可以用一套新的盔甲。
plugin.target: 我開玩笑的，我在那裡等你。但是，考慮到你所有的錢，我本可以用一套新的盔甲。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That'd be perfect. Falkreath is one of the loveliest holds in Skyrim. I'll meet you there, darling.
plugin.seed: 那一定不错。佛克瑞斯是天际中最漂亮的聚居地之一。亲爱的，我会在那儿等你。
plugin.target: 那一定不錯。佛克瑞斯是天霜中最漂亮的聚居地之一。親愛的，我會在那兒等你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Markarth? A city where even the beds are made of stone?
plugin.seed: 马卡斯？一个到处都是石头床的城市？
plugin.target: 馬卡斯？一個到處都是石頭床的城市？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...I know that look. You're sick.
plugin.seed: ...我了解这情况。你病了。
plugin.target: ...我瞭解這情況。你病了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Parts of Markarth are nice enough. I'll see you there.
plugin.seed: 马卡斯的部分地区已经足够好了。我在那里见你。
plugin.target: 馬卡斯的部分地區已經足夠好了。我在那裡見你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Cold up there, but at least it's not too far from home. I'll see you there.
plugin.seed: 那里很冷，但至少离家不远。我会在那里见你。
plugin.target: 那裡很冷，但至少離家不遠。我會在那裡見你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The coldest city in Skyrim? Well, we can always keep each other warm.
plugin.seed: 天际最冷的城市？好吧，我们至少可以靠彼此取暖。
plugin.target: 天霜最冷的城市？好吧，我們至少可以靠彼此取暖。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You bought Breezehome? Good call, lots of people in the city had their eyes on it.
plugin.seed: 你买下了微风阁？很好啊，这里的很多人都惦记着这房子呢。
plugin.target: 你買下了微風閣？很好啊，這裡的很多人都惦記著這房子呢。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It'll be good to be back home.
plugin.seed: 回家真好。
plugin.target: 回家真好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Hjaalmarch? You want to live in that swamp?
plugin.seed: 希雅陲？你想住在沼泽里吗？
plugin.target: 希雅陲？你想住在沼澤裡嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...Actually, that's not a bad idea. It'll be tough to find us there. And we'll have a great view of Solitude. I'll see you there, darling.
plugin.seed: ...事实上，这不是一个坏主意。在那里我们与世隔绝。我们将看到独孤城的美景。亲爱的，我在那里等你。
plugin.target: ...事實上，這不是一個壞主意。在那裡我們與世隔絕。我們將看到獨孤城的美景。親愛的，我在那裡等你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I never would have imagined this - I can hardly tell you how excited I am.
plugin.seed: 我从来没有想过会这样——我很难告诉你我有多兴奋。
plugin.target: 我從來沒有想過會這樣——我很難告訴你我有多興奮。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd love for you to live in Whiterun with me, but if you'd like to move somewhere else, that's fine.
plugin.seed: 我很想让你和我一起住在白漫城，但如果你想搬到其他地方，那没关系。
plugin.target: 我很想讓你和我一起住在白漫城，但如果你想搬到其他地方，那沒關係。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You know, I'm still your housecarl. And part of my job is making sure you don't get robbed. You're not making that easy.
plugin.seed: 你知道，我还是你的侍卫。我的部分职责是确保你不会被抢劫。你可没那么容易。
plugin.target: 你知道，我還是你的侍衛。我的部分職責是確保你不會被搶劫。你可沒那麼容易。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Living in Riften makes that much harder. But... I'll see you there.
plugin.seed: 住在裂谷城让这事更难了。但是我在那里见你。
plugin.target: 住在裂谷城讓這事更難了。但是我在那裡見你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Proudspire Manor, my house in Solitude.
plugin.seed: 豪塔别墅，我在独孤城的家。
plugin.target: 傲塔別墅，我在獨孤城的家。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: I'd like us to move somewhere else.
plugin.seed: 我想我们得去别的什么地方。
plugin.target: 我想我們得住到別的地方。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Where are we moving to?
plugin.seed: 我们要去哪里？
plugin.target: 我們要去哪裡？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Would you mind cooking something for me?
plugin.seed: 你介意帮我煮点吃的吗？
plugin.target: 你介意幫我煮點東西嗎？
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Try this. We Nords are better at cooking than anyone gives us credit for.
plugin.seed: 试试这个。我们诺德人的厨艺响当当的好。
plugin.target: 試試這個。我們諾德人的廚藝響噹噹的好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Has the store made any money?
plugin.seed: 商店有赚钱吗？
plugin.target: 生意如何？有賺到錢嗎？
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Oh, sure, because slaying dragons doesn't pay well at all.
plugin.seed: 哦，当然，因为屠龙一点也不划算。
plugin.target: 哦，當然，因為屠龍一點也不划算。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm joking. Here's your half of the profit.
plugin.seed: 我开玩笑的。这是你一半的报酬。
plugin.target: 我開玩笑的。這是你一半的報酬。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm a Thane? What does that mean?
plugin.seed: 我是个武卫？什么意思？
plugin.target: 我是個男爵？什麼意思？
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: The Jarl has recognized you as a person of great importance in the hold. A hero.
plugin.seed: 领主已经意识到你在领地里是一个非常重要的人物。一位英雄。
plugin.target: 領主視你為領地中的重要人物。一個英雄。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: The title of Thane is an honor, a gift for your service. Guards will know to look the other way, if you tell them who you are.
plugin.seed: 武卫的称号是一种荣誉，是对您服务的礼物。如果你告诉卫兵你是谁，他们就会知道要另眼相看。
plugin.target: 男爵的頭銜是種榮耀，對你所作貢獻的嘉獎。衛兵要是得知你是男爵，他們對你都會睜一眼閉一眼的。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: It means that the Jarl, and the rest of the hold, has deemed you a hero.
plugin.seed: 这意味着领主和其他人都认为你是英雄。
plugin.target: 這意味著領主和其他人都認為你是英雄。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...Who I am kidding. Nowadays, a lot of successful merchants get that title for helping to fill the coffers of Jarls all around the province.
plugin.seed: ...我在跟谁开玩笑。如今，许多成功的商人仅仅是帮助全省各地的领主填满金库都能获得这一称号。
plugin.target: ...我在跟誰開玩笑。如今，許多成功的商人僅僅是幫助全省各地的領主填滿金庫都能獲得這一稱號。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Hello.
plugin.seed: 你好。
plugin.target: 你好。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Those bastards came and took me while I was asleep, I never had a chance to fight. Thank the Divines you came, darling.
plugin.seed: 这些混蛋趁我睡着时抓走了我，我没有机会反抗。感谢你，亲爱的，感谢圣灵们。
plugin.target: 這些混蛋趁我睡著時抓走了我，我沒有機會反抗。感謝你，親愛的，感謝聖靈們。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Don't worry, I can get out of here with no trouble. I'll see you at home.
plugin.seed: 别担心，我可以毫不费力地自由进出。我在家等你。
plugin.target: 別擔心，我可以毫不費力地自由進出。我在家等你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've been teaching our little one how to hunt. Living off the land will turn them into a warrior in no time. Then, there'll be three of us.
plugin.seed: 我一直在教我们的小家伙如何打猎。没有比在荒野生活更能教人学会如何战斗、如何生存的了。我们家很快我们家就有三位战士了。
plugin.target: 我一直在教我們的小傢伙如何打獵。沒有比在荒野生活更能教人學會如何戰鬥、如何生存的了。我們家很快我們家就有三位戰士了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How's <Alias.ShortName=Child1> doing?
plugin.seed: <Alias.ShortName=Child1>还好吗？
plugin.target: <Alias.ShortName=Child1>還好嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Great. I'm teaching our little one all about my home town.
plugin.seed: 很好。我正在教我们的孩子关于我家乡的一切。
plugin.target: 很好。我正在教我們的孩子關於我家鄉的一切。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...And Heimskr is teaching them all about Talos. At least they won't grow up to be a Thalmor bootlicker.
plugin.seed: ...然后海姆斯科总是在教他们塔洛斯的事情。至少他们不会成长为梭默的拥从。
plugin.target: ...然後海姆斯科總是在教他們塔洛斯的事情。至少他們不會成長為梭默的擁從。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.seed: 我们住在裂谷城。这应该可以解释了。
plugin.target: 我們住在裂谷城。這應該可以解釋了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How's <Alias.ShortName=Child1> doing?

plugin.target: <Alias.ShortName=Child1>還好嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Poor little thing's almost fell off the ledges here twice now! This is a fine home, but it's no place for a child.
plugin.seed: 可怜的小东西已经两次差点从这里的壁架上摔下来了！这是一个很好的家，但它不是适合孩子的地方。
plugin.target: 可憐的小東西已經兩次差點從這裡的壁架上摔下來了！這是一個很好的家，但它不是適合孩子的地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How's <Alias.ShortName=Child1> doing?
plugin.seed: <Alias.ShortName=Child1>还好吗？
plugin.target: <Alias.ShortName=Child1>還好嗎？

plugin.source: They're cold, probably. But, that's what makes us Nords strong.
plugin.seed: 他们可能觉得很冷。但是，这正是我们诺德人强大的地方。
plugin.target: 他們可能覺得很冷。但是，這正是我們諾德人強大的地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My only concern is that our little one will get spoiled living in a place like this. Otherwise, it's perfect.

plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.target: 去風城莊園，我在希雅陲領的房子。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.seed: 我在苍原领的房子，赫雅根大厅。
plugin.target: 我在蒼原領的房子，赫雅根大廳。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How about my house in Falkreath?
plugin.seed: 我在佛克瑞斯领的房子如何？
plugin.target: 我在佛克瑞斯領的房子如何？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We could live in my house in Hjaalmarch.
plugin.seed: 我们可以住我在希雅陲领的房子。
plugin.target: 我們可以住我在希雅陲領的房子。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I have a house in the Pale.
plugin.seed: 我在苍原领有间房子。
plugin.target: 我在蒼原領有間房子。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can't believe I only just remembered your children. *Laughs* Never would have imagined myself as a mother. We need a home where they can stay with us.
plugin.seed: 我不敢相信我会眼里只有你的孩子。 *笑* 真难把自己当成一个母亲，我们需要一个他们可以和我们住在一起的家。
plugin.target: 我不敢相信我會眼裡只有你的孩子。 *笑* 真難把自己當成一個母親，我們需要一個他們可以和我們住在一起的家。

plugin.source: I don't plan on being killed by the likes of you.
plugin.seed: 我不打算被你这种东西杀死。
plugin.target: 我不打算被你這種東西殺死。

plugin.source: For Whiterun!
plugin.seed: 为了白漫城！

plugin.source: You don't sound very enthusiastic about this.

plugin.source: Look, Irelith and 8 other guards were out there. I knew all of them. Including the ones who didn't make it back.
plugin.seed: 你看，伊莱瑞斯和其他八位卫兵在那。我认识他们所有人。包括那个没有回来的。
plugin.target: 你看，伊萊瑞斯和其他八位衛兵在那。我認識他們所有人。包括那個沒有回來的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Hroki, Thor, Faldir, Jorving, and Asvald. I had known them for years.
plugin.seed: 赫罗基，托尔，法迪尔，约文，还有阿斯瓦德。我认识他们很久很久了。
plugin.target: 赫羅基，托爾，法迪爾，約文，還有阿斯瓦德。我認識他們很久很久了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Now, out of nowhere, some drifter shows up, and helps fight a battle that costs us half the soldiers there.
plugin.seed: 现在，不知从哪里冒出来，一些流浪者出现了，并帮助了一场战斗，这场战斗损失了我们一半的士兵。
plugin.target: 現在，不知從哪裡冒出來，一些流浪者出現了，並幫助了一場戰鬥，這場戰鬥損失了我們一半的士兵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I look at the other people in the Jarl's court - Hrongar is a good fighter, but downright stupid. If you haven't met Nazeem yet, you'll know what the problem with him is the moment you do.
plugin.seed: 我看着领主宫殿的其他人——赫鲁加是一个很好的战士，但却愚蠢至极。如果你还没有见过纳齐姆，你一见面就会知道他有什么问题。
plugin.target: 我看著領主宮殿的其他人——赫魯加是一個很好的戰士，但卻愚蠢至極。如果你還沒有見過納齊姆，你一見面就會知道他有什麼問題。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And I'm sure the Grey-Manes and Battle-Borns have already asked that you preoccupy yourself with their inane feud.
plugin.seed: 而且我确定灰鬃和战狂家族的人已经问过你站边于他们空洞愚蠢的仇恨中。
plugin.target: 而且我確定灰鬃和戰狂家族的人已經問過你站邊於他們空洞愚蠢的仇恨中。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I find it hard to believe that out of nowhere, we're finally getting a respectable member of the Whiterun court. Especially after they came back from a battle that killed 5 of my friends.
plugin.seed: 我很难相信，不知从哪里冒出来，我们终于得到了一位受人尊敬的白漫宫廷成员。尤其是在他从一场导致我5个朋友死亡的战斗中回来之后。
plugin.target: 我很難相信，不知從哪裡冒出來，我們終於得到了一位受人尊敬的白漫宮廷成員。尤其是在他從一場導致我5個朋友死亡的戰鬥中回來之後。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (Character Level) You really don't think someone like me could slay a dragon? Better than the guards, at least?
plugin.seed: （人物等级）你真以为我这样的人无法屠龙？难道我不比守卫们强吗？
plugin.target: （人物等級）你真以為我這樣的人無法屠龍？難道我不比守衛們強嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I suppose you look formidable... but looks don't count for much. Prowess in battle isn't always correlated with virtue.
plugin.seed: 我想你看起来的确很厉害……但外表并不重要。战斗勇猛不代表善良正义。
plugin.target: 我想你看起來的確很厲害……但外表並不重要。戰鬥勇猛不代表善良正義。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm not any more convinced than I was a minute ago. My apologies, Thane.
plugin.seed: 我并没改变多少想法，抱歉，武卫。
plugin.target: 我並沒改變多少想法，抱歉，男爵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (Character Level) You're a fool to doubt me. I slew that dragon with ease.
plugin.seed: （角色等级）因为你是个傻瓜，才会怀疑我。我轻松地就杀死了那条龙。
plugin.target: （角色等級）因為你是個傻瓜，才會懷疑我。我輕鬆地就殺死了那條龍。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Is this going to be a problem?
plugin.seed: 这有什么问题吗？
plugin.target: 這有什麼問題嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Not a problem worth worrying over.
plugin.seed: 这不是一个值得担心的问题。
plugin.target: 這不是一個值得擔心的問題。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're a thane, I'm a housecarl. I know what my duties are, but I'm an honest woman.
plugin.seed: 你是武卫，我是侍卫。我知道我的职责是什么，但我是一个诚实的女人。
plugin.target: 你是男爵，我是侍衛。我知道我的職責是什麼，但我是一個誠實的女人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'll make sure you keep breathing, but you need to know my concerns if I'm going to do that.
plugin.seed: 我会确保你继续呼吸，但如果我要这样做，你需要知道我的担忧。
plugin.target: 我會確保你繼續呼吸，但如果我要這樣做，你需要知道我的擔憂。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't like your attitude.
plugin.seed: 我不喜欢你的态度。
plugin.target: 我不喜歡你的態度。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Sorry, but I'm not the type to hide behind politeness when I can see there's a problem.
plugin.seed: 对不起，我不是那种看到有问题就躲在礼貌后面的人。
plugin.target: 對不起，我不是那種看到有問題就躲在禮貌後面的人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Don't consider it personal, because I don't even know if I can respect the position of thane anymore.
plugin.seed: 不要认为这是针对个人的，因为我甚至不知道我是否还能尊重大人的立场。
plugin.target: 不要認為這是針對個人的，因為我甚至不知道我是否還能尊重大人的立場。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So, are we off to High Hrothgar now, then? We could either go through the pass near Falkreath or travel around the throat of the world.
plugin.seed: 那么，我们现在要去高吼峰吗？我们要么穿过佛克瑞斯附近的隘口，要么绕过世界咽喉。
plugin.target: 那麼，我們現在要去高吼峰嗎？我們要麼穿過佛克瑞斯附近的隘口，要麼繞過世界咽喉。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah, I'd like to see what the Greybeards have to say.
plugin.seed: 是的，我想听听灰胡子们想说什么。
plugin.target: 是的，我想聽聽灰鬍子們想說什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Me too. And going with you is my job, so...
plugin.seed: 我也是。和你同行是我的工作，所以。。。
plugin.target: 我也是。和你同行是我的工作，所以。。。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Of course not. I have a couple things to do first.
plugin.seed: 当然不是。我有几件事要先做。
plugin.target: 當然不是。我有幾件事要先做。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Fair enough. I can help, if you'd like.
plugin.seed: 明白。如果你愿意，我可以帮忙。
plugin.target: 明白。如果你願意，我可以幫忙。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So you're the one who helped with the Dragon? I'm Lydia. It's an honor, you're a hero... whatever it is I'm supposed to tell you.
plugin.seed: 所以你是帮助龙的人？我是莱迪亚。这是我的荣幸，你是一个英雄...不管我该告诉你什么。
plugin.target: 所以你是幫助龍的人？我是萊迪亞。這是我的榮幸，你是一個英雄...不管我該告訴你什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think I owe you a bit of an apology, Thane.
plugin.seed: 我想我应该向你道歉，武卫 。
plugin.target: 我想我應該向你道歉，男爵 。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You being Dragonborn... It's bigger than I initially thought. I thought most of that was just some silly legend. "Nord Nonsense", as Proventus called it.
plugin.seed: 你是龙裔。。。你比我想象中厉害，曾一直以为龙裔的故事只是荒谬的传说。就像普罗万图斯所说的“诺德人的废话”。
plugin.target: 你是龍裔。。。你比我想像中厲害，曾一直以為龍裔的故事只是荒謬的傳說。就像普羅萬圖斯所說的“諾德人的廢話”。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We killed a dragon... that was incredible! *Laughs* Everything they said about you, it's all true!
plugin.seed: 我们刚杀死了一条龙。。。太不可思议了*大笑*他们对关于你的一切传说都是真的！
plugin.target: 我們剛殺死了一條龍。。。太不可思議了*大笑*他們對關於你的一切傳說都是真的！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Thane... you had me worried sick with that little infiltration. Are you alright? The Thalmor are some of the most dangerous people in Tamriel.
plugin.seed: 武卫，你的渗透行动让我很担心。你没事吧？梭默是泰姆瑞尔最危险的人群之一。
plugin.target: 男爵，你的滲透行動讓我很擔心。你沒事吧？梭默是泰姆瑞爾最危險的人群之一。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: When the Jarl assigned me to you, talking to a Dragon on top of the Throat of the world was the very last thing I was expecting.
plugin.seed: 当领主将我分配给你时，我从没想过会在世界之吼之巅与龙交谈。
plugin.target: 當領主將我分配給你時，我從沒想過會在世界之吼之巔與龍交談。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's beautiful... like it was made by the gods themselves.
plugin.seed: 它很漂亮……就像出自圣灵之手。
plugin.target: 它很漂亮……就像出自聖靈之手。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We need to talk about what just happened.
plugin.seed: 我们需要谈谈刚刚发生的事情。
plugin.target: 我們需要談談剛剛發生的事情。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So... it's over, isn't it? You defeated Miraak? What happened with...?
plugin.seed: 所以……结束了，不是吗？你打败了秘拉克？这发生了什么……？
plugin.target: 所以……結束了，不是嗎？你打敗了秘拉克？這發生了什麼……？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And to think I was worried about you going into the Thalmor Embassy alone...
plugin.seed: 我还担心你一个人去梭默大使馆……
plugin.target: 我還擔心你一個人去梭默大使館……
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You've got to be kidding me...
plugin.seed: 你一定是在开玩笑吧...
plugin.target: 你一定是在開玩笑吧...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Looks like we'll probably have to split up for this. Good luck in there - and for the love of the Divines, don't take any unnecessary risks.
plugin.seed: 看来我们可能要暂时告别了。祝你好运，原圣灵庇护，千万不要冒任何不必要的风险。
plugin.target: 看來我們可能要暫時告別了。祝你好運，原聖靈庇護，千萬不要冒任何不必要的風險。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've never seen anything like this in my life. Do you... even believe all this?
plugin.seed: 我这辈子从没见过这样的事。你。。。甚至能相信这一切？
plugin.target: 我這輩子從沒見過這樣的事。你。。。甚至能相信這一切？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Heavy Breathing* We... we actually pulled that off. That monster set off like a coward, it was us who sent him running.
plugin.seed: *沉重的呼吸*我们。。。我们真的成功了。那个怪物像个懦夫一样逃走了，我们让他感到危险了。
plugin.target: *沉重的呼吸*我們。。。我們真的成功了。那個怪物像個懦夫一樣逃走了，我們讓他感到危險了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: This is just about the craziest thing you've ever done. And I've seen you do a lot of crazy things.
plugin.seed: 这是我与你同行以来见你做过的最疯狂的事情.
plugin.target: 這是我與你同行以來見你做過的最瘋狂的事情.
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's... idyllic out here, isn't it, darling?
plugin.seed: 这是。。。亲爱的，这就是田园诗中的生活，不是吗？
plugin.target: 這是。。。親愛的，這就是田園詩中的生活，不是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't think we could have picked a better place to live.
plugin.seed: 这就是我梦中生活的地方。
plugin.target: 這就是我夢中生活的地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's... actually surprisingly peaceful out here.
plugin.seed: 这里……实际上出奇地安静。
plugin.target: 這裡……實際上出奇地安靜。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Who would have thought I wouldn't mind living in a swamp?
plugin.seed: 谁会想到我并不介意住在沼泽地里？
plugin.target: 誰會想到我並不介意住在沼澤地裡？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's... interesting living so close to where I grew up.
plugin.seed: 能住在童年的生活地附近，这感觉真奇妙。
plugin.target: 能住在童年的生活地附近，這感覺真奇妙。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd come to this part of the tundra a lot as a child. Probably went my first hunt not far from here.
plugin.seed: 我小时候经常来苔原这附近。我的第一次狩猎可能就在离这里不远的地方。
plugin.target: 我小時候經常來苔原這附近。我的第一次狩獵可能就在離這裡不遠的地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The beds aren't actually as bad as I thought.
plugin.seed: 这床实际上并没有我想象的那么糟糕。
plugin.target: 這床實際上並沒有我想像的那麼糟糕。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: After seeing this, I don't think Markarth gets enough credit. It was a good choice moving here, love.
plugin.seed: 看到这个之后，我认为马卡斯城可能并不是那么可靠。搬到这里是个不错的选择，亲爱的。
plugin.target: 看到這個之後，我認為馬卡斯城可能並不是那麼可靠。搬到這裡是個不錯的選擇，親愛的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's quaint, I'll give it that much, but I'm not sure I'm on board with the location.
plugin.seed: 这很奇怪，我有一些想法，但我不确定我是否确定在这。
plugin.target: 這很奇怪，我有一些想法，但我不確定我是否確定在這。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I had to help the guards catch a thief in the market earlier. I guess that's Riften for you.
plugin.seed: 我之前不得不帮守卫在市场上抓住一个小偷。我想这是裂谷城给你的“惊喜”。
plugin.target: 我之前不得不幫守衛在市場上抓住一個小偷。我想這是裂谷城給你的“驚喜”。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's... a bit much, but it really is lovely here.
plugin.seed: 这。。。有点多，但这里真的很可爱。
plugin.target: 這。。。有點多，但這裡真的很可愛。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Never thought I'd live in a house this extravagent.
plugin.seed: 从没想过我会住在这么豪华的房子里。
plugin.target: 從沒想過我會住在這麼豪華的房子裡。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You have no idea how happy I am to come back to Whiterun with you.
plugin.seed: 你不知道我能有多高兴和你一起回到白漫城。
plugin.target: 你不知道我能有多高興和你一起回到白漫城。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I spent four years as a guard in this city, and six as a housecarl. It's good to have a home here.
plugin.seed: 我在这座城市当了四年卫兵，当了六年管家。能在这里有家真好。
plugin.target: 我在這座城市當了四年衛兵，當了六年管家。能在這裡有家真好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's a bit big, but this really seems like the perfect home for people like us.
plugin.seed: 它有点大，但对我们这样的人来说，这真的是一个完美的家。
plugin.target: 它有點大，但對我們這樣的人來說，這真的是一個完美的家。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Now this is something I can get behind.
plugin.seed: 这就是现在我能做的事情了。
plugin.target: 這就是現在我能做的事情了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Are you positive we can trust our new friend here?
plugin.seed: 你确定我们可以信任我们的新朋友吗？
plugin.target: 你確定我們可以信任我們的新朋友嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Now that we're away from Serana, I think we need to talk about her a bit more.
plugin.seed: 既然我们离开了瑟拉娜，我想我们需要多谈谈她。
plugin.target: 既然我們離開了瑟拉娜，我想我們需要多談談她。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You have no idea how worried about you I just was, Thane.
plugin.seed: 你不知道我刚才有多担心你，武卫。
plugin.target: 你不知道我剛才有多擔心你，男爵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Isran's cleary a very smart man, doing exactly what I suggested he do well out of earshot of him. Great minds think alike.
plugin.seed: 伊士冉显然是一个非常聪明的人，他的做法和我的建议一致。英雄所见总是略同。
plugin.target: 伊士冉顯然是一個非常聰明的人，他的做法和我的建議一致。英雄所見總是略同。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Still here.
plugin.seed: 还在这里。
plugin.target: 還在這裡。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Right behind you.
plugin.seed: 我紧随在后。
plugin.target: 我緊隨在後。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We heading out?
plugin.seed: 我们启程吗？
plugin.target: 我們啟程嗎？
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Thane.
plugin.seed: 大人。
plugin.target: 大人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Need something, darling?
plugin.seed: 需要东西吗，亲爱的？
plugin.target: 需要東西嗎，親愛的？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm right with you, my love.
plugin.seed: 我永远支持你，我的爱人。
plugin.target: 我永遠支持你，我的愛人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You finally believe that I killed that dragon?
plugin.seed: 你终于相信那条龙是我杀了的吧？
plugin.target: 你終於相信那條龍是我殺了的吧？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Not alone, at least. Every guard that fought alongside you was just as much of a hero.
plugin.seed: 至少你不是一个人。每一个与你并肩作战的卫兵都是英雄。
plugin.target: 至少你不是一個人。每一個與你並肩作戰的衛兵都是英雄。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: But it's clear as day that you can hold your own in a skirmish. I shouldn't have doubted you in that regard.
plugin.seed: 但很明显，你们可以在小规模冲突中坚持阵地。在那方面我不应该怀疑你。
plugin.target: 但很明顯，你們可以在小規模衝突中堅持陣地。在那方面我不應該懷疑你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: In fact, I should be grateful that out of everyone, Jarl Balgruuf made me your Housecarl. It's good to get out of the walls, and you're not some stuck-up merchant.
plugin.seed: 事实上，我应该感谢所有人。巴尔古夫领主让我成为你的侍卫。走出围墙是件好事，而且你不是什么固步自封的商人。
plugin.target: 事實上，我應該感謝所有人。巴爾古夫領主讓我成為你的侍衛。走出圍牆是件好事，而且你不是什麼固步自封的商人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can only imagine what I'd be like if he assigned me to guard Nazeem.
plugin.seed: 我只能想象，如果他派我去守卫纳齐姆，我会是什么样子。
plugin.target: 我只能想像，如果他派我去守衛納齊姆，我會是什麼樣子。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: "Do you get to the cloud district very often? Oh, what am I saying. Of course you don't."
plugin.seed: “你常去云顶区吗？哦，我在说什么呀——你当然不常去啦。”
plugin.target: “你常去雲頂區嗎？哦，我在說什麼呀——你當然不常去啦。”
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Laughs* You sound exactly like him.
plugin.seed: *笑*你听起来和他一模一样。
plugin.target: *笑*你聽起來和他一模一樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I agree - those guards were heroes, but I slew that dragon.
plugin.seed: 我同意——那些守卫都是英雄，但龙确实是由我杀死的。
plugin.target: 我同意——那些守衛都是英雄，但龍確實是由我殺死的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You don't see any of them being made Thane though.
plugin.seed: 然而你看不到他们中的任何一个成为武卫。
plugin.target: 然而你看不到他們中的任何一個成為男爵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm sorry, that wasn't directed at you. It's just that... we've got a war going on all around us.
plugin.seed: 对不起，那不是针对你的。只是...我们周围正在进行一场战争。
plugin.target: 對不起，那不是針對你的。只是...我們周圍正在進行一場戰爭。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You need to learn your place.
plugin.seed: 你得清楚你的位置。
plugin.target: 你得清楚你的位置。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And you need to learn your's. There's a war going on all around us.
plugin.seed: 而你也得学会你该学的。我们这里正在发生一场战争。
plugin.target: 而你也得學會你該學的。我們這裡正在發生一場戰爭。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Fair enough. Some people are skeptics.
plugin.seed: 这很公平。但总有人对此表示怀疑。
plugin.target: 這很公平。但總有人對此表示懷疑。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's more about the soldiers you fought alongside than you. Look at what's happening all around the province.
plugin.seed: 更重要的是那些卫兵而不是你，看看全天际已经乱作了一团。
plugin.target: 更重要的是那些衛兵而不是你，看看全天霜已經亂作了一團。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Every day, men and women from all over Skyrim die fighting to keep the Empire together or to free their homeland, and the Jarls are honoring merchants.
plugin.seed: 每天，来自天际各地的男男女女都在为维护帝国团结或解放祖国而战斗，而领主却以商人为重。
plugin.target: 每天，來自天霜各地的男男女女都在為維護帝國團結或解放祖國而戰鬥，而領主卻以商人為重。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It makes me sick to my stomach.
plugin.seed: 真的让我反胃。
plugin.target: 真的讓我反胃。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Do you support either side?
plugin.seed: 你支持他们任何一方吗？
plugin.target: 你支持他們任何一方嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Oh, I'm not brave enough for politics.
plugin.seed: 哦，我对政治不够坚定。
plugin.target: 哦，我對政治不夠堅定。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My mother was a Nord and my father was an Imperial, if you were wondering why my name and line of work don't match.
plugin.seed: 我的母亲是诺德人，父亲是帝国人，如果你想知道为什么我的话和工作不符。
plugin.target: 我的母親是諾德人，父親是帝國人，如果你想知道為什麼我的話和工作不符。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Empire thinks they'll have a better chance of defeating the elves if we're united, and the Stormcloaks think we need to start fighting sooner.
plugin.seed: 帝国认为，如果我们团结起来，他们将有更好的机会击败精灵，而风暴斗篷认为我们需要尽快开始战斗。
plugin.target: 帝國認為，如果我們團結起來，他們將有更好的機會擊敗精靈，而風暴斗篷認為我們需要儘快開始戰鬥。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Both sides are fighting for what they believe in, and I can respect that. Even if it makes the whole thing incredibly pointless.
plugin.seed: 双方都在为自己的信仰而战，我对此表示尊重。即使这让整件事变得毫无意义。
plugin.target: 雙方都在為自己的信仰而戰，我對此表示尊重。即使這讓整件事變得毫無意義。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's sad to see so many good men and women die like this, only to be forgotten.
plugin.seed: 看到这么多优秀的天际儿女这样死去，最终被世人遗忘，让我难受痛苦。
plugin.target: 看到這麼多優秀的天霜兒女這樣死去，最終被世人遺忘，讓我難受痛苦。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's the one issue I have with you being dubbed a Thane. In a hundred years, they'll sing about how the Dragonborn saved Whiterun, not how Skyrim's sons and daughters fought for their homeland.
plugin.seed: 这是我对你被称为武卫的一个质疑。一百年后，他们将歌唱龙裔是如何拯救白漫的，而不是天际的儿女是如何为家园而战的。
plugin.target: 這是我對你被稱為男爵的一個質疑。一百年後，他們將歌唱龍裔是如何拯救白漫的，而不是天霜的兒女是如何為家園而戰的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's not your fault, though.
plugin.seed: 虽然，这不是你的错。
plugin.target: 雖然，這不是你的錯。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's a somber topic, but I'm glad we had this conversation. I don't want to sound ungrateful, either. I'm happy to be out here fighting alongside you.
plugin.seed: 这是一个令人沮丧的话题，但我很高兴我们进行了这次对话。我也不想听起来忘恩负义。我很高兴能在这里和你并肩作战。
plugin.target: 這是一個令人沮喪的話題，但我很高興我們進行了這次對話。我也不想聽起來忘恩負義。我很高興能在這裡和你並肩作戰。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Forget them. Farmers with swords aren't significant people for a reason.
plugin.seed: 忘掉他们吧。那些拿着剑的乡巴佬无法青史留名是有原因的。
plugin.target: 忘掉他們吧。那些拿著劍的鄉巴佬無法青史留名是有原因的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's a cold thing to say. Maybe you'll change your mind when you actually talk to them.
plugin.seed: 你的言词如此冰冷。也许当你真正和他们交谈时，你会改变想法。
plugin.target: 你的言詞如此冰冷。也許當你真正和他們交談時，你會改變想法。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: "Nord Nonsense"? You're a Nord, for Mara's sake.
plugin.seed: “诺德人的废话”？看在玛拉的份上，你可是诺德人。
plugin.target: “諾德人的廢話”？看在瑪拉的份上，你可是諾德人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I know, I know, but you have to admit, we have some far-fetched stories. Ever hear the one about how we were once all transformed into children, and saved by King Wulfharth?
plugin.seed: 我知道，我知道，但你必须承认，我们有一些牵强的故事。你有没有听过这样一个故事：我们曾经都变成了孩子，然后被武夫哈斯国王救了？
plugin.target: 我知道，我知道，但你必須承認，我們有一些牽強的故事。你有沒有聽過這樣一個故事：我們曾經都變成了孩子，然後被武夫哈斯國王救了？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: But you can learn the power that killed the High King of Skyrim in seconds. There has to be some truth to this.
plugin.seed: 但你可以在几秒钟内学会杀死天际至高王的力量。这一定有一些道理。
plugin.target: 但你可以在幾秒鐘內學會殺死天霜至高王的力量。這一定有一些道理。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You might be more deserving of that title than I ever thought.
plugin.seed: 你可能比我想象的更配得上这个称号。
plugin.target: 你可能比我想像的更配得上這個稱號。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Let's get to Ustengrav. I'm excited to see more of this story unfold.
plugin.seed: 我们去炙燃墓。我很开心能看到故事拉开篇章。
plugin.target: 我們去炙燃墓。我很開心能看到故事拉開篇章。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: To be honest with you, I'm kind of surprised by it all myself.
plugin.seed: 老实说，我自己也有点惊讶。
plugin.target: 老實說，我自己也有點驚訝。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I didn't even think of that. Gods, this must have all come as an enormous shock to you.
plugin.seed: 我甚至都没想到。众神啊，这一切对你来说一定是一个巨大的打击。
plugin.target: 我甚至都沒想到。眾神啊，這一切對你來說一定是一個巨大的打擊。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: But you killed a dragon. For the second time. If anyone can stop the dragon threat, it's clearly you, Thane. And I'll do everything I can to help.
plugin.seed: 但你杀了一条龙。这是第二次。如果有人能阻止龙的威胁，那显然是你，大人。我会尽我所能提供帮助。
plugin.target: 但你殺了一條龍。這是第二次。如果有人能阻止龍的威脅，那顯然是你，大人。我會盡我所能提供幫助。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm fine, Lydia. Remember who you're talking to.
plugin.seed: 我很好，莱迪亚. 记住你在和谁说话。
plugin.target: 我很好，萊迪亞. 記住你在和誰說話。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Your safety is my responsibility. Plus, if you die, I'd have to go back to guarding the Jarl's kids.
plugin.seed: 你的安全是我的责任。另外，如果你死了，我就得回去保护领主家的胸孩子。
plugin.target: 你的安全是我的責任。另外，如果你死了，我就得回去保護領主家的胸孩子。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And just like that, the "You don't deserve to be a Thane" narrative disappears.
plugin.seed: 就这样吧，再也不用听到“你不配成为武卫”了。
plugin.target: 就這樣吧，再也不用聽到“你不配成為男爵”了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I never put it like that!
plugin.seed: 我从来没有这样说过！
plugin.target: 我從來沒有這樣說過！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Gloat all you want. I'm still not supposed to let you get killed.
plugin.seed: 你就幸灾乐祸吧。我仍然不会让你被任何人杀的。
plugin.target: 你就幸災樂禍吧。我仍然不會讓你被任何人殺的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm really not happy with this Delphine character, to be honest with you. She put your life in serious danger over a hunch!
plugin.seed: 老实说，我真的不喜欢戴尔菲娜这个角色。她凭直觉把你的生命置于严重危险之中！
plugin.target: 老實說，我真的不喜歡戴爾菲娜這個角色。她憑直覺把你的生命置於嚴重危險之中！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: She's hardly the sharpest blade in the... I was going to say armory, but I guess Blades works fine. Not the sharpest Blade in the Blades.
plugin.seed: 她几乎不是最锋利的刀刃...我本来想说的是整个刀锋，但我想刀锋战士做得很好。不是刀锋战士里最锋利的刀刃。
plugin.target: 她幾乎不是最鋒利的刀刃...我本來想說的是整個刀鋒，但我想刀鋒戰士做得很好。不是刀鋒戰士裡最鋒利的刀刃。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We should probably go tell her what you found in there.
plugin.seed: 我们也许应该去告诉她你在里面发现了什么。
plugin.target: 我們也許應該去告訴她你在裡面發現了什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Is this a good or bad thing?
plugin.seed: 这是好还是坏？
plugin.target: 這是好還是壞？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: All things considered, it's the best thing that's happened to me in a long time. That's why I've been so apologetic about what I said to you when we met.
plugin.seed: 综合考虑，这是很长一段时间以来发生在我身上的最好的事情。这就是为什么我对我们见面时对你说的话深表歉意。
plugin.target: 綜合考慮，這是很長一段時間以來發生在我身上的最好的事情。這就是為什麼我對我們見面時對你說的話深表歉意。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Dragons are back, whether we like it or not. And where am I for the occasion?
plugin.seed: 巨龙回归了，无论我们是否喜欢。我又何去何从？
plugin.target: 巨龍迴歸了，無論我們是否喜歡。我又何去何從？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm not guarding some milk-drinking merchant, I'm not fighting in this stupid war; I'm fighting alongside you - the one person who can stop Alduin.
plugin.seed: 我不是在守护某个喝牛奶的商人，我不是在这场愚蠢的战争中战斗；我和你并肩作战——唯一能阻止奥杜因的人。
plugin.target: 我不是在守護某個喝牛奶的商人，我不是在這場愚蠢的戰爭中戰鬥；我和你並肩作戰——唯一能阻止奧杜因的人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I wouldn't have it any other way. This is where I belong.
plugin.seed: 我不会以任何其他方式如此。这就是我的归属。
plugin.target: 我不會以任何其他方式如此。這就是我的歸屬。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: All things considered, it's the best thing that's happened to me in a long time. You're the best thing that's happened to me in a long time.
plugin.seed: 综合考虑，这是很长一段时间以来发生在我身上的最好的事情。你是很长一段时间以来发生在我身上的最好的事情。
plugin.target: 綜合考慮，這是很長一段時間以來發生在我身上的最好的事情。你是很長一段時間以來發生在我身上的最好的事情。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Dragons are back, whether we like it or not. And where am I for the occasion?
plugin.seed: 巨龙回归了，无论我们是否喜欢。我又何去何从？
plugin.target: 巨龍迴歸了，無論我們是否喜歡。我又何去何從？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Fighting side by side with someone I care about more than anyone else.
plugin.seed: 与我比任何人都更关心的人并肩作战。
plugin.target: 與我比任何人都更關心的人並肩作戰。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I couldn't do this alone. I'm glad to have you here, Lydia.
plugin.seed: 我无法一个人完成这些事。我很高兴你能来，莱迪亚。
plugin.target: 我無法一個人完成這些事。我很高興你能來，萊迪亞。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well, good to hear that you have the humility to forgive me for doubting you at first.
plugin.seed: 很高兴听到你谦虚地原谅我一开始对你的怀疑。
plugin.target: 很高興聽到你謙虛地原諒我一開始對你的懷疑。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's rare that you meet someone who's supremely powerful but also of good character.
plugin.seed: 你很少会遇到一个非常有权势但性格也很好的人。
plugin.target: 你很少會遇到一個非常有權勢但性格也很好的人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've... honestly never met anyone like you.
plugin.seed: 老实说，我从来没有见过像你这样的人。
plugin.target: 老實說，我從來沒有見過像你這樣的人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm glad to see that you've gotten more humble since we talked about the Civil War.
plugin.seed: 我很高兴看到自从我们谈论内战以来，你变得更加谦逊了。
plugin.target: 我很高興看到自從我們談論內戰以來，你變得更加謙遜了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If you can forgive what I said, I can forgive what you said.
plugin.seed: 如果你能原谅我所说的，我也能原谅你所说的。
plugin.target: 如果你能原諒我所說的，我也能原諒你所說的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: A while ago, you said that I wasn't worthy of your service. I haven't forgotten.
plugin.seed: 前阵子，你说我不配为你效劳。我没有忘记。
plugin.target: 前陣子，你說我不配為你效勞。我沒有忘記。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And I am overjoyed that I was wrong.
plugin.seed: 我很高兴我错了。
plugin.target: 我很高興我錯了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've apologized more than once now, but I'll do it again. I'm sorry, Thane.
plugin.seed: 我已经道歉不止一次了，但我会再道歉一次的。对不起，大人。
plugin.target: 我已經道歉不止一次了，但我會再道歉一次的。對不起，大人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (Flirt) So what you're saying is that we belong together?
plugin.seed: 所以你的意思是我们适合在一起？
plugin.target: 所以你的意思是我們適合在一起？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: No, I said that we belong in the fight against the Dragons. The fact that it brought us together is-
plugin.seed: 不，我说过我们属于与龙的战斗。事实上，它让我们走到了一起-
plugin.target: 不，我說過我們屬於與龍的戰鬥。事實上，它讓我們走到了一起-
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Ysmir's beard, you really had to take it there, didn't you?
plugin.seed: 伊斯米尔的胡子啊，你真的要到这一步吗？
plugin.target: 伊斯米爾的鬍子啊，你真的要到這一步嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're worth every bit of praise you get, but I don't think of you that way. You're a Thane, I'm your Housecarl. That's how I see it. I'm... sorry.
plugin.seed: 你值得每一份赞扬，但我不这么认为你。你是武卫，我是你的侍卫。我就是这么看的。我...很抱歉。
plugin.target: 你值得每一份讚揚，但我不這麼認為你。你是男爵，我是你的侍衛。我就是這麼看的。我...很抱歉。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (Flirt) I've never met anyone like you either, Lydia.
plugin.seed: 我也从未见过像你这样的人，莱迪亚.
plugin.target: 我也從未見過像你這樣的人，萊迪亞.
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If you're saying what I think you're saying, then I'm sorry. I'm you're bodyguard. That's... all I see this as.
plugin.seed: 如果你所说的和我想的一样，那么我很抱歉。我是你的侍卫。那就是。。。我所看到的一切。
plugin.target: 如果你所說的和我想的一樣，那麼我很抱歉。我是你的侍衛。那就是。。。我所看到的一切。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's all well and good, but we need to find an Elder Scroll. Come on.
plugin.seed: 这都挺好的，但我们需要找到一部上古卷轴。来吧
plugin.target: 這都挺好的，但我們需要找到一部上古卷軸。來吧
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Don't need to tell me twice. Let's go.
plugin.seed: 你已经说过了，走吧。
plugin.target: 你已經說過了，走吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Fine. Let's be on our way then.
plugin.seed: 好的，那我们就上路吧。
plugin.target: 好的，那我們就上路吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I didn't mean to make you upset...
plugin.seed: 我不是故意让你生气的。。。
plugin.target: 我不是故意讓你生氣的。。。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You "Don't think of me that way?" That just means you can still take it into consideration.
plugin.seed: “你不这么认为我？”没想到你也能想到这点。
plugin.target: “你不這麼認為我？”沒想到你也能想到這點。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If you want to believe that, I won't stop you.
plugin.seed: 如果你相信的话，我不会阻止你。
plugin.target: 如果你相信的話，我不會阻止你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Actually, it wasn't made by anyone. It just kind of "is".
plugin.seed: 事实上，它并非由谁创作的。它就是“它”。
plugin.target: 事實上，它並非由誰創作的。它就是“它”。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If anything can exist without a creator, it's probably that.
plugin.seed: 如果没有创造者，任何东西都可能存在，那很可能就是这样。
plugin.target: 如果沒有創造者，任何東西都可能存在，那很可能就是這樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It certainly isn't something you come across every day.
plugin.seed: 这肯定不是你每天都会遇到的事情。
plugin.target: 這肯定不是你每天都會遇到的事情。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Jorving told me a lot of stories about the Neravarine, Tiber Septim, Vivec, and King Wulfaarth... but he never mentioned any of them finding an Elder Scroll.
plugin.seed: 约文给我讲了很多关于尼瑞瓦因、泰伯·赛普汀、维威克和武夫哈斯国王的故事...但他从未提及他们中的任何一个人曾经找到过上古卷轴。
plugin.target: 約文給我講了很多關於尼瑞瓦因、泰伯·賽普汀、維威克和武夫哈斯國王的故事...但他從未提及他們中的任何一個人曾經找到過上古卷軸。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We're getting close to the end now, aren't we? Soon enough, you'll be facing down Alduin.
plugin.seed: 我们现在已经接近尾声了，不是吗？很快，你就会面对奥杜因。
plugin.target: 我們現在已經接近尾聲了，不是嗎？很快，你就會面對奧杜因。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I promise I'll be right there with you, Thane. This has been the greatest honor I've had in my entire life.
plugin.seed: 我保证我会和你在一起，大人。这是我一生中最大的荣誉。
plugin.target: 我保證我會和你在一起，大人。這是我一生中最大的榮譽。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You sound worried.
plugin.seed: 你听起来很担忧。
plugin.target: 你聽起來很擔憂。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: This is the son of Akatosh we're talking about. The most horrible monster in all the Nord Legends - the World-Eater.
plugin.seed: 这是我们所说的阿卡托什之子。诺德传说中最可怕的怪物——世界吞噬者。
plugin.target: 這是我們所說的阿卡託什之子。諾德傳說中最可怕的怪物——世界吞噬者。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You have an unbreakable resolve and a great housecarl fighting alongside you - I genuinely believe you can stop Alduin.
plugin.seed: 你有牢不可破的决心和一个伟大的侍卫与你并肩作战——我真的相信你能阻止奥杜因。
plugin.target: 你有牢不可破的決心和一個偉大的侍衛與你並肩作戰——我真的相信你能阻止奧杜因。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm worried that the only way for you to stop him could be by making a big sacrifice.
plugin.seed: 我担心你要阻止它的话不得不做出巨大牺牲。
plugin.target: 我擔心你要阻止它的話不得不做出巨大犧牲。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (Flirt) You do a horrible job of making me think you only regard me as a Thane.
plugin.seed: 你知不知道你在做什么，你让我觉得“你对我来说只是一名武卫”
plugin.target: 你知不知道你在做什麼，你讓我覺得“你對我來說只是一名男爵”
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Oh, shut up.
plugin.seed: 噢，闭嘴吧。
plugin.target: 噢，閉嘴吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Fine. Since you put the idea in my head, I've taken consideration of what you said to me on the Throat of the World.
plugin.seed: 好吧。自从你把这个想法放在我的脑海里，我就考虑到了你在世界之喉上对我说的话。
plugin.target: 好吧。自從你把這個想法放在我的腦海裡，我就考慮到了你在世界之喉上對我說的話。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And maybe being stuck in a stone and bronze prison full of deranged elves with you has driven me insane, but... I'm starting to feel enticed.
plugin.seed: 也许和你一起被困在一个满是疯狂精灵的石头和青铜监狱里让我发疯了，但是...我开始觉得被诱惑了。
plugin.target: 也許和你一起被困在一個滿是瘋狂精靈的石頭和青銅監獄裡讓我發瘋了，但是...我開始覺得被誘惑了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Gods, can we do anything without you talking about honor?
plugin.seed: 天哪，我们能别谈论这些荣誉好吗？
plugin.target: 天哪，我們能別談論這些榮譽好嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Don't make me lose respect for you. Please.
plugin.seed: 不要让我失去对你的尊重。求你。
plugin.target: 不要讓我失去對你的尊重。求你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That wasn't meant to be a threat, it was a genuine request. Skyrim needs heroes, and you have the potential to be one. Don't waste it out of fear of virtue.
plugin.seed: 这并不是威胁，而是一个真诚的请求。天际需要英雄，而你有潜力成为英雄。不要因为害怕美誉而浪费它。
plugin.target: 這並不是威脅，而是一個真誠的請求。天霜需要英雄，而你有潛力成為英雄。不要因為害怕美譽而浪費它。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't want to talk about this any more. Let's get going.
plugin.seed: 我不想再谈这个了。我们开始吧。
plugin.target: 我不想再談這個了。我們開始吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm just as honored by this as you are, Lydia, but we have a fight to finish.
plugin.seed: 我和你一样为此感到荣幸，莱迪亚，但还有一场战斗等待着我们去结束。
plugin.target: 我和你一樣為此感到榮幸，萊迪亞，但還有一場戰鬥等待著我們去結束。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That we do. Let's get back to Parthurnaax.
plugin.seed: 那走吧。让我们回去找帕图纳克斯。
plugin.target: 那走吧。讓我們回去找帕圖納克斯。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You say that like it's bad thing.
plugin.seed: 你这么说得好像是坏事。
plugin.target: 你這麼說得好像是壞事。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've come so far in learning to respect you as a Thane. I wasn't meant to be anything more than a bodyguard to you.
plugin.seed: 我已经走了这么远，学会了尊重你作为一个武卫的身份了。对你来说，我只不过是个保镖。
plugin.target: 我已經走了這麼遠，學會了尊重你作為一個男爵的身份了。對你來說，我只不過是個保鏢。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If I were to fall in love with you, I'd protect you with that much more fervor. If I let you fall in love with me, you'd do the same. I can't allow that.
plugin.seed: 如果我爱上你，我会更加热情地保护你。如果我让你爱上我，你也会这么做。我不能允许这样。
plugin.target: 如果我愛上你，我會更加熱情地保護你。如果我讓你愛上我，你也會這麼做。我不能允許這樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: "Enticed". Mara's mercy, Lydia, is that the best you can do?
plugin.seed: “心动”。玛拉怜悯，莱迪亚, 你就只能止步于此吗？
plugin.target: “心動”。瑪拉憐憫，萊迪亞, 你就只能止步於此嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I didn't know how else to put it, considering that I'm not exactly sold on... us.
plugin.seed: 我不知道该怎么说，考虑到我并不完全相信...我们。
plugin.target: 我不知道該怎麼說，考慮到我並不完全相信...我們。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Let's say it happens. How far would you go to keep someone you love safe? I'm supposed to protect you, not the other way around.
plugin.seed: 假设它发生了。为了保护你爱的人的安全，你会走多远？我应该保护你，而不是反过来。
plugin.target: 假設它發生了。為了保護你愛的人的安全，你會走多遠？我應該保護你，而不是反過來。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: When did I say anything about love? That's not what I'm after.
plugin.seed: 我有说过爱吗？那并不是我想要的。
plugin.target: 我有說過愛嗎？那並不是我想要的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're insufferable.
plugin.seed: 你真让人难以忍受。
plugin.target: 你真讓人難以忍受。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Really though, I have to pass on that. If we go there, I'm almost certain I'll be even more infatuated than I am already, and I don't need that.
plugin.seed: 不过，真的，我不得不把它传下去。如果我们到那地步，我几乎可以肯定我会比现在更着迷，我不需要这样。
plugin.target: 不過，真的，我不得不把它傳下去。如果我們到那地步，我幾乎可以肯定我會比現在更著迷，我不需要這樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Too late. I've already fallen in love.
plugin.seed: 为时已晚。我已经坠入爱河了。
plugin.target: 為時已晚。我已經墜入愛河了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Ysmir's Beard, you sound ridiculous. We've only known each other for-
plugin.seed: 伊斯米尔的胡子啊，这听起来好荒谬。我们才刚认识不久...
plugin.target: 伊斯米爾的鬍子啊，這聽起來好荒謬。我們才剛認識不久...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Fine. At this point, I... admire you. If you feel the same way, who in Oblivion am I to stop you? You aren't excused for being a complete sap, though.
plugin.seed: 好吧。在这一点上，我...钦佩你。如果你也有同样的感受，我到底是谁要来阻止你？不过，你是一个彻头彻尾的笨蛋，不可原谅。
plugin.target: 好吧。在這一點上，我...欽佩你。如果你也有同樣的感受，我到底是誰要來阻止你？不過，你是一個徹頭徹尾的笨蛋，不可原諒。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You think I wouldn't have died keeping you safe right after we met? That's what warriors do.
plugin.seed: 你以为我就不会为了你而献出生命吗？这才是一位战士应做的事。
plugin.target: 你以為我就不會為了你而獻出生命嗎？這才是一位戰士應做的事。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Look at me. First, I say you don't deserve to be a Thane because you weren't a hero, now I won't even let you be a hero worthy of that title.
plugin.seed: 看看我。首先，我说你不配成为武卫，因为你不是英雄，现在我甚至不会让你成为配得上这个称号的英雄。
plugin.target: 看看我。首先，我說你不配成為男爵，因為你不是英雄，現在我甚至不會讓你成為配得上這個稱號的英雄。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I never thought I would be so happy to be proven a fool time and time again.
plugin.seed: 我从没想过我会这么高兴一次又一次地被证明是个傻瓜。
plugin.target: 我從沒想過我會這麼高興一次又一次地被證明是個傻瓜。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Fair enough. I won't mention it again.
plugin.seed: 好吧。我不会再提了。
plugin.target: 好吧。我不會再提了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's unfortunate, I know, but thanks.
plugin.seed: 我知道这很不幸，但谢谢。
plugin.target: 我知道這很不幸，但謝謝。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So there you go. I'm ready to make this something greater.
plugin.seed: 所以就这样把。我准备好让这件事更伟大了。
plugin.target: 所以就這樣把。我準備好讓這件事更偉大了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Sigh* You know, you're lucky I'm not making you wait until you kill that bastard. I had half a mind to do that, just to make sure you came back to me.
plugin.seed: *叹气*你知道，你很幸运，我没有让你等到你杀了那个混蛋。我下定决心要这么做，只是为了确保你能回到我身边。
plugin.target: *嘆氣*你知道，你很幸運，我沒有讓你等到你殺了那個混蛋。我下定決心要這麼做，只是為了確保你能回到我身邊。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Speaking of which, I believe we have a dragon to slay. Let's get to it.
plugin.seed: 说到这里，我相信我们有一条龙要杀。让我们开始吧。
plugin.target: 說到這裡，我相信我們有一條龍要殺。讓我們開始吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I finished the fight. Alduin is, as far as I can tell, dead.
plugin.seed: 战斗结束了。据我所知，奥杜因已经死了。
plugin.target: 戰鬥結束了。據我所知，奧杜因已經死了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I... I knew you could do it.
plugin.seed: 我...我知道你能做到的。
plugin.target: 我...我知道你能做到的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You just saved everyone on Tamriel, you realize that, right?
plugin.seed: 你刚刚拯救了泰姆瑞尔的所有人，你知道吗？
plugin.target: 你剛剛拯救了泰姆瑞爾的所有人，你知道嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're going down in history with Martin Septim, Ysgramor, Reman, and so many others.
plugin.seed: 你将和马丁·赛普汀、伊斯格拉谟、雷曼和其他的伟人一起书写历史。
plugin.target: 你將和馬丁·賽普汀、伊斯格拉謨、雷曼和其他的偉人一起書寫歷史。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's really exhilarating, you know that?
plugin.seed: 这真让人激动，你知道吗？
plugin.target: 這真讓人激動，你知道嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd imagine. I'm proud of you, Thane.
plugin.seed: 我想。我为你感到骄傲，大人。
plugin.target: 我想。我為你感到驕傲，大人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Every single person you see - they're alive because of you.
plugin.seed: 你看到的每一个人——他们之所以活着是因为你。
plugin.target: 你看到的每一個人——他們之所以活著是因為你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They should fear me, not idolize me.
plugin.seed: 他们应该害怕我，而不是崇拜我。
plugin.target: 他們應該害怕我，而不是崇拜我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Don't go down that path. Tamriel needs heroes, and you've just become one that could champion a victory against the Thalmor.
plugin.seed: 不要走那条道路。泰姆瑞尔需要英雄，而你刚刚成为了一个可以赢下对梭默的胜利的人。
plugin.target: 不要走那條道路。泰姆瑞爾需要英雄，而你剛剛成為了一個可以贏下對梭默的勝利的人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: More importantly, I need you to be a hero if I'm going to keep fighting with you.
plugin.seed: 更重要的是，如果我要继续和你战斗，我需要你成为英雄。
plugin.target: 更重要的是，如果我要繼續和你戰鬥，我需要你成為英雄。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You gave me too much to lose back in Blackreach. I had to win that fight.
plugin.seed: 你在黑降给我带来了太多留念，我必须赢得那场胜利。
plugin.target: 你在黑降給我帶來了太多留念，我必須贏得那場勝利。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well, I guess I didn't need to make you wait, then, darling.
plugin.seed: 好吧，我想我不需要让你等待，亲爱的。
plugin.target: 好吧，我想我不需要讓你等待，親愛的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can hardly believe what this has come to. Alduin defeated, and I have you.
plugin.seed: 我简直不敢相信会发生这样的事。奥杜因被打败了，然后我有你在身旁。
plugin.target: 我簡直不敢相信會發生這樣的事。奧杜因被打敗了，然後我有你在身旁。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization
