plugin.source: It's not over. There's still plenty of problems in Skyrim that we can fix.
plugin.seed: 这还远没结束。天际还有很多问题我们可以解决。
plugin.target: 這還遠沒結束。天霜還有很多問題我們可以解決。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: There always are. And I'm proud to be a part of fixing them.
plugin.seed: 总是有的。我很自豪能成为修复这些问题的一份子。
plugin.target: 總是有的。我很自豪能成為修復這些問題的一份子。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Thank you for everything, Thane.
plugin.seed: 谢谢你，这一切。大人。
plugin.target: 謝謝你，這一切。大人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Alright, you wanna go?
plugin.seed: 好吧，你想逃吗？
plugin.target: 好吧，你想逃嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Come on!
plugin.seed: 上啊！
plugin.target: 上啊！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Really think you can take the two of us?
plugin.seed: 你真的认为你可以带走我们两个吗？
plugin.target: 你真的認為你可以帶走我們兩個嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're horrible excuse for a Nord!
plugin.seed: 对诺德人来说你的借口真可笑！
plugin.target: 對諾德人來說你的藉口真可笑！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: An Imperial should fight better than that!
plugin.seed: 真正的帝国人可不会像你这样！
plugin.target: 真正的帝國人可不會像你這樣！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Thought you could fight a Nord, did you?
plugin.seed: 你以为你可以和一个诺德人战斗，是吗？
plugin.target: 你以為你可以和一個諾德人戰鬥，是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You picked this lifestyle, now you pay the price!
plugin.seed: 既然选择了这条路，就该付出代价！
plugin.target: 既然選擇了這條路，就該付出代價！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Do you have any idea how many we've killed who were just like you?
plugin.seed: 你知道我们杀了多少和你一样的人吗？
plugin.target: 你知道我們殺了多少和你一樣的人嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Ha! You call that armor?
plugin.seed: 哈，你称这叫盔甲？
plugin.target: 哈，你稱這叫盔甲？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Come on, you two-septim street magician!
plugin.seed: 来吧，你们这两个街头把戏人！
plugin.target: 來吧，你們這兩個街頭把戲人！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...I'm pretty sure I can conceive of "the power you wield"!
plugin.seed: ……我想“你所拥有的力量”也就这些了！
plugin.target: ……我想“你所擁有的力量”也就這些了！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Go ahead, turn me into a newt! I'll get better!
plugin.seed: 来啊，把我变成蝾螈！
plugin.target: 來啊，把我變成蠑螈！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...Can't believe anyone gets seduced by the likes of you!
plugin.seed: …真不敢相信有人会被你这样的人勾引！
plugin.target: …真不敢相信有人會被你這樣的人勾引！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'll keep my blood, thank you very much!
plugin.seed: 我会保留我的血，非常感谢你！
plugin.target: 我會保留我的血，非常感謝你！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Come on, goldenrod, tell me about "Elven Supremacy" again!
plugin.seed: 来吧，金竹竿，再次告诉我“精灵至上”！
plugin.target: 來吧，金竹竿，再次告訴我“精靈至上”！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How does it feel to get beaten by a human, elf?
plugin.seed: 被人类打败是什么感觉，精灵？
plugin.target: 被人類打敗是什麼感覺，精靈？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd expect someone who's been alive for a hundred years to be better at fighting!
plugin.seed: 我希望一个活了百年的人更精于战斗！
plugin.target: 我希望一個活了百年的人更精於戰鬥！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm sure the Thalmor are glad you pulling human civilization apart!
plugin.seed: 我敢肯定梭默会很高兴你让人类分裂了！
plugin.target: 我敢肯定梭默會很高興你讓人類分裂了！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm sure the Thalmor appreciate you enforcing their laws!
plugin.seed: 我相信梭默很感激你执行了他们的法律！
plugin.target: 我相信梭默很感激你執行了他們的法律！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Shor's bones, you smell awful!
plugin.seed: 朔尔的骨头，你闻起来真丑！
plugin.target: 朔爾的骨頭，你聞起來真醜！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Next time you try to take over the Reach, bring some armor!
plugin.seed: 下次你试图接管边塞领时，带上一些盔甲！
plugin.target: 下次你試圖接管邊塞領時，帶上一些盔甲！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You realize how ridiculous you look, right?
plugin.seed: 你知道你看起来有多可笑，对吧？
plugin.target: 你知道你看起來有多可笑，對吧？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Scared to fight us up close, Dragon?
plugin.seed: 害怕和我们短兵相接吗，胆小龙？
plugin.target: 害怕和我們短兵相接嗎，膽小龍？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My friend's got quite the surprise in store for you when we're done here!
plugin.seed: 当我们结束一切时，我的朋友会给你一个惊喜！
plugin.target: 當我們結束一切時，我的朋友會給你一個驚喜！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You'll have to land eventually!
plugin.seed: 你得下来！
plugin.target: 你得下來！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well, you're clearly concerned.
plugin.seed: 你显然很担心。
plugin.target: 你顯然很擔心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Why wouldn't I be? You just stood here while those things writhed around you and your eyes turned black
plugin.seed: 为什么我不会呢？你只是站在这里，那些东西在你周围翻腾，你的眼睛变成了黑色。
plugin.target: 為什麼我不會呢？你只是站在這裡，那些東西在你周圍翻騰，你的眼睛變成了黑色。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And you said you spoke to Hermaeus Mora? Legends say he hardly ever speaks to mortals. By the gods...
plugin.seed: 你说你和赫麦尤斯·莫拉谈过？传说他几乎从不与凡人说话。众神保佑...
plugin.target: 你說你和赫麥尤斯·莫拉談過？傳說他幾乎從不與凡人說話。眾神保佑...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'll be fine. I've dealt with the Daedra before.
plugin.seed: 我会没事的。我以前和魔族打过交道。
plugin.target: 我會沒事的。我以前和魔族打過交道。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You worry me, you know that? Just... be careful. Remember to read the fine print when he hands you a pact.
plugin.seed: 你让我担心，你知道吗？要小心。仔细考虑他提出的每个条件。
plugin.target: 你讓我擔心，你知道嗎？要小心。仔細考慮他提出的每個條件。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I lose sleep thinking about what could happen to you, you know that?
plugin.seed: 我失眠了，想着你会发生什么，你知道吗？
plugin.target: 我失眠了，想著你會發生什麼，你知道嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You mean more to me than anyone ever has. Please, for Ysmir's sake, be careful.
plugin.seed: 你对我来说比任何人都重要。看在伊斯米尔的份上，请小心。
plugin.target: 你對我來說比任何人都重要。看在伊斯米爾的份上，請小心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm worried about this, too, but it might be the only way to stop Miraak.
plugin.seed: 我也担心这一点，但这可能是阻止秘拉克的唯一方法。
plugin.target: 我也擔心這一點，但這可能是阻止秘拉克的唯一方法。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's... why I'm worried. Miraak would be another you. Fighting him doesn't sound easy.
plugin.seed: 那就是...我为什么担心的原因。秘拉克就像另一个你。与他战斗可不容易。
plugin.target: 那就是...我為什麼擔心的原因。秘拉克就像另一個你。與他戰鬥可不容易。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: He's made me his champion.
plugin.seed: 他让我成为他的勇士。
plugin.target: 他讓我成為他的勇士。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Stendarr preserve us... this could be your end. One of Skyrim's greatest heroes, enslaved to a Daedra...
plugin.seed: 斯坦德尔请保护我们…这可能变成你的下场。天际最伟大的英雄之一，被魔族奴役。。。
plugin.target: 斯坦德爾請保護我們…這可能變成你的下場。天霜最偉大的英雄之一，被魔族奴役。。。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My life isn't over yet, Lydia. I'll find a way out of this.
plugin.seed: 我的生命不会在此结束，莱迪亚. 我会找到解决办法的。
plugin.target: 我的生命不會在此結束，萊迪亞. 我會找到解決辦法的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I...  I want to believe you. They said Alduin couldn't be defeated, and you proved otherwise. Can't imagine Mora will be any different.
plugin.seed: 我…我想相信你。他们说奥杜因不会被打败，而你却证明了这一点。无法想象莫拉会有什么不同。
plugin.target: 我…我想相信你。他們說奧杜因不會被打敗，而你卻證明了這一點。無法想像莫拉會有什麼不同。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Plus, they say you're tied to Akatosh, right? Surely he'll help keep you safe from the Daedra.
plugin.seed: 再者，他们说你与阿卡托什绑定，不是吗？他肯定会帮助你摆脱魔神的控制的。
plugin.target: 再者，他們說你與阿卡託什綁定，不是嗎？他肯定會幫助你擺脫魔神的控制的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Mora has a skewed reputation. All he seeks is knowledge. I see no problem in helping with that.
plugin.seed: 莫拉的虽然臭名远扬。他所追求的只是知识。我认为帮助他解决这个事情并没有什么问题。
plugin.target: 莫拉的雖然臭名遠揚。他所追求的只是知識。我認為幫助他解決這個事情並沒有什麼問題。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Have you lost your mind? He's willing to kill the innocent for it.
plugin.seed: 你疯了吗？他愿意为此杀害无辜者。
plugin.target: 你瘋了嗎？他願意為此殺害無辜者。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You need to escape his service. If you could defeat Alduin, you can break free of Hermaeus Mora.
plugin.seed: 你需要逃避他的奴役。如果你能打败奥杜因，你就能摆脱赫麦尤斯·莫拉。
plugin.target: 你需要逃避他的奴役。如果你能打敗奧杜因，你就能擺脫赫麥尤斯·莫拉。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You said your name was Serana? I'm Lydia. Where are you from?
plugin.seed: 你说你叫瑟拉娜？我是莱迪亚。你从哪来的？
plugin.target: 你說你叫瑟拉娜？我是萊迪亞。你從哪來的？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've never seen that kind of architecture before. It looks so... ominus.
plugin.seed: 我以前从未见过那种建筑。看起来很…不祥。
plugin.target: 我以前從未見過那種建築。看起來很…不祥。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Could be because it's full of vampires. I think you should wait outside for us, Lydia.
plugin.seed: 可能是因为里面到处都是吸血鬼。我认为你应该在外面等我们，莱迪亚.
plugin.target: 可能是因為裡面到處都是吸血鬼。我認為你應該在外面等我們，萊迪亞.
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Absolutely not. I'm obligated to protect our friend here, and I intend to do just that.
plugin.seed: 绝对不行。我有义务保护我们在这里的朋友，我也打算这样做。
plugin.target: 絕對不行。我有義務保護我們在這裡的朋友，我也打算這樣做。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Alright. Can't promise there won't be consequences.
plugin.seed: 好吧。这的确不能保证不会有任何后果。
plugin.target: 好吧。這的確不能保證不會有任何後果。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I knew you'd miss me.
plugin.seed: 我知道你想我。
plugin.target: 我知道你想我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I wasn't interested in partaking in my father's insane schemes, so I didn't have much of a choice.
plugin.seed: 我对参与父亲的疯狂计划不感兴趣，所以我别无选择。
plugin.target: 我對參與父親的瘋狂計劃不感興趣，所以我別無選擇。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I wasn't expecting you to come back. Not like this, at least.
plugin.seed: 我没想到你会回来。至少不是这样。
plugin.target: 我沒想到你會回來。至少不是這樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Oh... thank you.
plugin.seed: 哦...谢谢。
plugin.target: 哦...謝謝。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If nothing else, good work getting the scroll out.
plugin.seed: 如果没有别的话，把卷轴也带出来的确是个好选择。
plugin.target: 如果沒有別的話，把卷軸也帶出來的確是個好選擇。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Gods, I never would have thought this place was this extensive.
plugin.seed: 天啊，我从来没有想过这个地方这么广阔。
plugin.target: 天啊，我從來沒有想過這個地方這麼廣闊。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's strange to think people lived here once. It's strange to think you lived here.
plugin.seed: 想到人们曾经住在这里真是奇怪。想到你曾经住在这里真奇怪。
plugin.target: 想到人們曾經住在這裡真是奇怪。想到你曾經住在這裡真奇怪。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That was back in the Second Era. Seeing it like this is... strange.
plugin.seed: 那要追溯到第二纪元了。看到这个...很奇怪。
plugin.target: 那要追溯到第二紀元了。看到這個...很奇怪。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The relationship I had with my parents was tumoltuous at best. It's hard for me to see this castle as home, with everything that's happened between us.
plugin.seed: 我和父母之间的关系充其量是恶性的。我很难把这座城堡看作家，因为我们之间发生了这一切。
plugin.target: 我和父母之間的關係充其量是惡性的。我很難把這座城堡看作家，因為我們之間發生了這一切。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're upset anyway, aren't you?
plugin.seed: 不管怎样，你很难过，不是吗？
plugin.target: 不管怎樣，你很難過，不是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Bold assumption.
plugin.seed: 很明显。
plugin.target: 很明顯。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I didn't mean to offend... I'm sorry, it was a careless thing to say.
plugin.seed: 我不是有意冒犯...对不起，说这话太冒犯了。
plugin.target: 我不是有意冒犯...對不起，說這話太冒犯了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's fine... it can just be a bit of a sore subject.
plugin.seed: 没事...这可能只是一个有点棘手的话题。
plugin.target: 沒事...這可能只是一個有點棘手的話題。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And... you're not wrong. It's still sad to see the place I grew up in in this state.
plugin.seed: 还有...你没有错。看到我长大的地方如此现状仍然让我很难过。
plugin.target: 還有...你沒有錯。看到我長大的地方如此現狀仍然讓我很難過。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Erik, you said your father was in the Legion during the Great War, right?
plugin.seed: 艾瑞克，你说你父亲是参与了浩大战争的退伍军人，对吧？
plugin.target: 艾瑞克，你說你父親是參與了浩大戰爭的退伍軍人，對吧？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah, he served with General Jonna's army.
plugin.seed: 是的，他曾在乔娜将军的队伍中服役。
plugin.target: 是的，他曾在喬娜將軍的隊伍中服役。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Companions came to Cyrodiil with General Jonna. My mother was with them.
plugin.seed: 战友团们和乔娜将军一起来到了赛瑞迪尔。我妈妈和他们同行。
plugin.target: 戰友團們和喬娜將軍一起來到了賽瑞迪爾。我媽媽和他們同行。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: He never mentioned anything about the Companions.
plugin.seed: 他从未提及任何关于战友团的事情。
plugin.target: 他從未提及任何關於戰友團的事情。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well either way, my da was with the Emperor's army at that point. The Skyrim legions saved him, so next time you see your father... tell him I said thank you.
plugin.seed: 不管怎样，我的爸爸当时在皇帝的军队里。是天际的军团救了他，所以下次你见到你父亲时...请替我道声谢谢。
plugin.target: 不管怎樣，我的爸爸當時在皇帝的軍隊裡。是天霜的軍團救了他，所以下次你見到你父親時...請替我道聲謝謝。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Sorry, I just can't get over how young you are.
plugin.seed: 对不起，我就是无法忘记你还这么年轻。
plugin.target: 對不起，我就是無法忘記你還這麼年輕。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I just saw my twentieth winter. How old were you when you started doing this?
plugin.seed: 我才刚刚年满二十。你开始做这个的时候多大了？
plugin.target: 我才剛剛年滿二十。你開始做這個的時候多大了？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I was never a mercenary like you, but I became a guard in Whiterun when I was 17. I was 23 when I became a housecarl.
plugin.seed: 我从来没有像你那样当过一名雇佣兵，但我十七岁时成为了白漫城的一名守卫。当我成为一名侍卫时，我23岁。
plugin.target: 我從來沒有像你那樣當過一名僱傭兵，但我十七歲時成為了白漫城的一名守衛。當我成為一名侍衛時，我23歲。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They moved you up to the palace in just six years? Not bad.
plugin.seed: 他们只用了六年就让你进入了宫廷？不错。
plugin.target: 他們只用了六年就讓你進入了宮廷？不錯。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My parents trained me well. That, and all the more experienced guards new better than to volunteer for that.  I wound up guarding the Jarl's children.
plugin.seed: 我父母把我训练得很好。这一点上，我比那些更有经验的候选都要强。我最终被指派去保护了领主家的孩子。
plugin.target: 我父母把我訓練得很好。這一點上，我比那些更有經驗的候選都要強。我最終被指派去保護了領主家的孩子。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So... what's Jarl Balgruuf like?
plugin.seed: 那么...巴尔古夫领主是什么样的人？
plugin.target: 那麼...巴爾古夫領主是什麼樣的人？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: He's a good man, and a true Nord. He's getting up in years, though. His stomach isn't quite flat any more.
plugin.seed: 他是一个好人，一个真正的诺德人。不过，他已经长大了。他的胃不太平了。
plugin.target: 他是一個好人，一個真正的諾德人。不過，他已經長大了。他的胃不太平了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: He doesn't get enough opportunities to travel, and too many to drink.
plugin.seed: 他没有足够的机会旅行，也没有太多的机会喝酒。
plugin.target: 他沒有足夠的機會旅行，也沒有太多的機會喝酒。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well... I guess that's what happens to true Nords when they get old.
plugin.seed: 好吧……我想这就是真正的诺德人变老时会发生的事情。
plugin.target: 好吧……我想這就是真正的諾德人變老時會發生的事情。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Is that complacency I hear? Erik, you're not going to just let yourself get fat after the next twenty years, are you?
plugin.seed: 你是在说你自己吗？艾瑞克，你不会让自己在接下来的二十年后变胖吧？
plugin.target: 你是在說你自己嗎？艾瑞克，你不會讓自己在接下來的二十年後變胖吧？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Not if I can help it.
plugin.seed: 如果我能帮上忙，就不会。
plugin.target: 如果我能幫上忙，就不會。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Good, it'd be a complete waste.
plugin.seed: 好吧，那真是浪费。
plugin.target: 好吧，那真是浪費。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What?!
plugin.seed: 什么？！
plugin.target: 什麼？！
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: I'm kidding! You're a little too young for me.
plugin.seed: 我在开玩笑！你对我来说有点太年轻了。
plugin.target: 我在開玩笑！你對我來說有點太年輕了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's always good to meet a mercenary with a sense of honor. You put some faith back in me, Mjoll.
plugin.seed: 遇到有荣誉感的佣兵感觉真好。穆月尔，你让我重拾信心。
plugin.target: 遇到有榮譽感的傭兵感覺真好。穆月爾，你讓我重拾信心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've never been a sellsword... never traded my skills for pay. I've always adventured on my own terms.
plugin.seed: 我从来就不是个佣兵……我从不为钱打杀。我总是为了自己而冒险。
plugin.target: 我從來就不是個傭兵……我從不為錢打殺。我總是為了自己而冒險。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: My mistake. But in all fairness, if you make a living by fighting, and it's not for anything higher, doesn't that make you a mercenary?
plugin.seed: 抱歉。不过平心而论，如果战斗只为谋生，不为荣誉，那不就是佣兵了吗？
plugin.target: 抱歉。不過平心而論，如果戰鬥只為謀生，不為榮譽，那不就是傭兵了嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't like it, but I suppose.
plugin.seed: 我不喜欢它，但我想试试。
plugin.target: 我不喜歡它，但我想試試。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Rarely in my travels have I encountered those who possess skills equal to your own.
plugin.seed: 我旅途中极少能遇见能力与你不相上下的人。
plugin.target: 我旅途中極少能遇見能力與你不相上下的人。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Thank you. Between what my parents taught me, what I learned from the other guards in Whiterun, and what I've learned from travelling with our dear friend, I've come along way.
plugin.seed: 谢谢，这些都是从我父母、白漫的其他守卫以及和我们亲爱的朋友一起旅行学到的东西，这些一路伴随着我。
plugin.target: 謝謝，這些都是從我父母、白漫的其他守衛以及和我們親愛的朋友一起旅行學到的東西，這些一路伴隨著我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My mother was a strong woman... she's the one who instructed me on my swordfighting techniques.
plugin.seed: 我妈妈是个厉害的女人...她是指导我剑术的人。
plugin.target: 我媽媽是個厲害的女人...她是指導我劍術的人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My father wanted me to follow in his footsteps as a hunter, but I set my aspirations a bit higher. He never complained.
plugin.seed: 我父亲想让我追随他的脚步成为一名猎人，但我把自己的志向定得更高了。他从不抱怨。
plugin.target: 我父親想讓我追隨他的腳步成為一名獵人，但我把自己的志向定得更高了。他從不抱怨。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's funny, it's kind of the other way around in my case. Either way, they did a good job.
plugin.seed: 这很有趣，我的情况正好相反。不管怎样，他们都做得很好。
plugin.target: 這很有趣，我的情況正好相反。不管怎樣，他們都做得很好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've heard you and Aerin are some of the only people in Riften who are willing to stand up the Black-Briars. Good for you.
plugin.seed: 我听说你和艾灵是裂谷城唯一愿意站出来反抗黑棘家族的人。真为你高兴。
plugin.target: 我聽說你和艾靈是裂谷城唯一願意站出來反抗黑棘家族的人。真為你高興。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Its been difficult. I've taken the burdens of this city's problems upon myself and I keep running into impossible obstacles.
plugin.seed: 这很困难。我把这个城市问题的负担压在了自己身上，我不断遇到不可能的障碍。
plugin.target: 這很艱難。我一直獨自承擔這城市的所有問題，而且不斷有棘手的事出現。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: I've tried everything I can to protect Riften's citizens from her family, but to no avail.
plugin.seed: 我已经尽我所能保护裂谷城的公民免受她的家人的伤害，但无济于事。
plugin.target: 我已經試過了所有方法保護裂谷城的公民免受她的家族的危害，但是毫無幫助。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Well, Mjoll, you're fighting the good fight. Maybe our dear friend will lend you a hand at some point.
plugin.seed: 好吧，穆月尔，你正在打一场正义的仗。也许我们亲爱的朋友会在某个时候帮助你。
plugin.target: 好吧，穆月爾，你正在打一場正義的仗。也許我們親愛的朋友會在某個時候幫助你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So are you from Vvardenfell or the Mainland, Erandur?
plugin.seed: 那么你是来自瓦登费尔还是来自内陆，依兰杜尔？
plugin.target: 那麼你是來自瓦登費爾還是來自內陸，依蘭杜爾？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I was born in raised in Skyrim, actually. And for a Dunmer, that's quite a statement, I assure you.
plugin.seed: 实际上，我出生在天际。对于丹莫，我向你保证，这是一个很好的声明。
plugin.target: 實際上，我出生在天霜。對於丹莫，我向你保證，這是一個很好的聲明。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Oh... what part of Skyrim?
plugin.seed: 哦......天际的哪里 ？
plugin.target: 哦......天霜的哪裡 ？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I grew up in The Pale. This land was my home for most of my life...
plugin.seed: 我在苍原领长大。这片土地是我大半生的家……
plugin.target: 我在蒼原領長大。這片土地是我大半生的家……
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: A Dark Elf in one of the most Nordic parts of Skyrim? That must have been interesting.
plugin.seed: 天际最诺德化之一地区的暗精灵？那一定很有趣。
plugin.target: 天霜最諾德化之一地區的暗精靈？那一定很有趣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It was a bit difficult.
plugin.seed: 很艰难。
plugin.target: 很艱難。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Our dear friend told me you went from worshipping the Daedra to serving Mara, Erandur. If you don't mind me asking, how did you make such a drastic change?
plugin.seed: 我们亲爱的朋友告诉我，你从崇拜魔神变成了侍奉玛拉，依兰杜尔。如果你不介意我问你的话，你是如何做出如此巨大的改变的？
plugin.target: 我們親愛的朋友告訴我，你從崇拜魔神變成了侍奉瑪拉，依蘭杜爾。如果你不介意我問你的話，你是如何做出如此巨大的改變的？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: After running from Nightcaller Temple, I wandered Skyrim for years until I was taken in by a priest of Mara who lived in Morthal.
plugin.seed: 从唤夜神殿跑出来后，我在天际徘徊了好几年，直到我被一位住在墨索尔的玛拉牧师收留。
plugin.target: 逃離喚夜神殿之後，我在天霜浪跡了好多年，之後我被住在墨索爾城的一位瑪拉的教士收留了。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Finding Mara was the greatest moment of my life. I'll never forget the warmth that spread through my heart when we embraced.
plugin.seed: 找到玛拉是我一生中最伟大的时刻。我永远不会忘记当我接受玛拉赐福的时候，温暖在我心中蔓延。
plugin.target: 投身瑪拉是我一生中最美好的時刻。我永遠不會忘記我們相擁時那傳遍全身的溫暖感覺。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: That's... touching. It almost makes it sound like the divines are more powerful than the Daedra, after all.
plugin.seed: 那是……真动容。毕竟，这听上去让人觉得圣灵们比魔神更强大得多。
plugin.target: 那是……真動容。畢竟，這聽上去讓人覺得聖靈們比魔神更強大得多。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Mara will protect you.
plugin.seed: 玛拉会保佑你的。
plugin.target: 瑪拉會保佑你的。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Haven't you heard of Martin Septim? He was only around 200 years ago.
plugin.seed: 你没听说过马丁·赛普丁吗？一位200多年前的传奇。
plugin.target: 你沒聽說過馬丁·賽普丁嗎？一位200多年前的傳奇。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Fair point, but I never heard of him shouting dragons out of the sky.
plugin.seed: 听说过，但从没听说过他能从天空中召唤一直巨龙出来。
plugin.target: 聽說過，但從沒聽說過他能從天空中召喚一直巨龍出來。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Follow me. I need your help.
plugin.seed: 跟着我。我需要你的帮助。
plugin.target: 跟著我。我需要你的幫助。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: I'm right behind you.
plugin.seed: 我紧随在后。
plugin.target: 我會緊跟在後。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Too big of a crowd. We'd probably wind up accidentally hitting each other.
plugin.seed: 这里太挤了，很容易撞到别人。
plugin.target: 這裡太擠了，很容易撞到別人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've lived in Skyrim my whole life and never left. I'd like to visit Cyrodiil some day, though. My father told me to visit West Weald before the Thalmor invade again.
plugin.seed: 我一直都在天际生活，还从没出去看看。我希望有一天能去赛瑞迪尔看看。我的父亲曾告诉我，一定要在梭默再次入侵前，去一趟“西部旷野”旅店
plugin.target: 我一直都在天霜生活，還從沒出去看看。我希望有一天能去賽瑞迪爾看看。我的父親曾告訴我，一定要在梭默再次入侵前，去一趟“西部曠野”旅店
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I was cooped up in Whiterun for too long. It's good to be travelling again.
plugin.seed: 我被关在白漫城太久了。再次旅行的感觉真好。
plugin.target: 我被關在白漫城太久了。再次旅行的感覺真好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The other day, a traveller from Cyrodiil asked me if I'd heard of the High Elves. I wasn't entirely sure how to respond.
plugin.seed: 前几天，一位来自赛瑞迪尔的旅行者问我是否听说过高精灵。我不完全确定该如何回应。
plugin.target: 前幾天，一位來自賽瑞迪爾的旅行者問我是否聽說過高精靈。我不完全確定該如何回應。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I never get tired of the sight of the sun rising behind Dragonsreach.
plugin.seed: 太阳又从龙临堡后面升起来了，这场景，百看不腻。
plugin.target: 太陽又從龍臨堡後面升起來了，這場景，百看不膩。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I grew up on a farm in the plains here, but I wanted to be like my parents and become a soldier or a mercenary. They were... somewhat supportive.
plugin.seed: 我是在这片平原上的一个农场长大的，我想像我的父母一样，成为一名士兵或雇佣兵。但是他们...不太支持。
plugin.target: 我是在這片平原上的一個農場長大的，我想像我的父母一樣，成為一名士兵或僱傭兵。但是他們...不太支持。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The giants won't hurt you if you stay away from them, but I've heard some travellers say they keep a lot of gold stashed in their camps. Gods only know why.
plugin.seed: 巨人不会伤害你的，如果你远离他们的话，但我听一些旅行者说他们在营地里藏了很多黄金。只有众神知道为什么。
plugin.target: 巨人不會傷害你的，如果你遠離他們的話，但我聽一些旅行者說他們在營地裡藏了很多黃金。只有眾神知道為什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Contrary to popular belief, there's actually plenty of game out on the Tundra. It's a great place to hunt.
plugin.seed: 与人们的想法相反，苔原上实际上有很多猎物。这是一个狩猎的好地方。
plugin.target: 與人們的想法相反，苔原上實際上有很多獵物。這是一個狩獵的好地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Always good to be home. I'd lived here since I was a child.
plugin.seed: 回到从小长大的家真好。
plugin.target: 回到從小長大的家真好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Adrienne doesn't give herself enough credit. She made the armor I'm wearing right now, actually.
plugin.seed: 阿德里安没有给自己足够的信心。事实上，我现在穿的盔甲就是她做的。
plugin.target: 阿德里安沒有給自己足夠的信心。事實上，我現在穿的盔甲就是她做的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Adrienne doesn't give herself enough credit. She made the armor I had when we first met, you know.
plugin.seed: 阿德里安没有给自己足够的信心。你知道吗，我们第一次见面的时候我穿的就是她做到盔甲。
plugin.target: 阿德里安沒有給自己足夠的信心。你知道嗎，我們第一次見面的時候我穿的就是她做到盔甲。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've heard a lot of bad things about Mikael from other women in this city. Luckily, he didn't mention me in that revolting book of his.
plugin.seed: 我从这个城市的其他女人那里听到了很多关于米凯尔的不好的事情。幸运的是，他在那本令人反感的书中没有提到我。
plugin.target: 我從這個城市的其他女人那裡聽到了很多關於米凱爾的不好的事情。幸運的是，他在那本令人反感的書中沒有提到我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My mother was a Companion, before she married my father. Always told me to stay away from them. Never knew why, but I listened.
plugin.seed: 我的母亲在嫁给我父亲之前是一名战友团战友。她总是告诉我离他们远点。虽然不知道为什么，但我照做了。
plugin.target: 我的母親在嫁給我父親之前是一名戰友團戰友。她總是告訴我離他們遠點。雖然不知道為什麼，但我照做了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can't stand Sinmir. He constantly harasses guards about how he thinks they aren't doing enough, and how much better of a warrior he used to be.
plugin.seed: 我受不了辛米尔。他不断骚扰警卫，说他认为他们做得不够，以及他曾经是一个多么优秀的战士。
plugin.target: 我受不了辛米爾。他不斷騷擾警衛，說他認為他們做得不夠，以及他曾經是一個多麼優秀的戰士。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If Olfina has the audacity to ask if you can't stand the sight of a strong Nord woman while I'm standing right next to you, so help me gods...
plugin.seed: 奥菲娜是否大胆地问你，当我站在你旁边时，你是否无法忍受一个强壮的诺德女人的目光，我天...
plugin.target: 奧菲娜是否大膽地問你，當我站在你旁邊時，你是否無法忍受一個強壯的諾德女人的目光，我天...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's warm in the hot springs. Almost a little uncomfortable.
plugin.seed: 温泉里很暖和，真舒服。
plugin.target: 溫泉裡很暖和，真舒服。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: There are so many giants out here. They'll wack you all the way to Hammerfell if you're not careful.
plugin.seed: 这里有很多巨人。如果你不小心，他们会一路把你打飞到苔原上。
plugin.target: 這裡有很多巨人。如果你不小心，他們會一路把你打飛到苔原上。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can't help but wonder how Eastmarch is holding up, with their Jarl focused on the war.
plugin.seed: 我不禁想当他们的领主只关心战争时，东陲领是如何支撑下去的。
plugin.target: 我不禁想當他們的領主只關心戰爭時，東陲領是如何支撐下去的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Do you smell that? I think its coming from the hot springs.
plugin.seed: 你闻到了吗？我认为它来自温泉。
plugin.target: 你聞到了嗎？我認為它來自溫泉。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: King Wulfharth was a legend. They even say he was a Dragonborn, like you.
plugin.seed: 武夫哈斯国王是一个传奇。传说他和你一样是龙裔。
plugin.target: 武夫哈斯國王是一個傳奇。傳說他和你一樣是龍裔。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We might have a better shot at beating the Thalmor if the Empire stays together, but I respect the Stormcloaks. They're brave men and women.
plugin.seed: 如果帝国能团结一致，我们才可能更有机会击败梭默，但我尊重风暴斗篷。他们都是勇敢的天际男女。
plugin.target: 如果帝國能團結一致，我們才可能更有機會擊敗梭默，但我尊重風暴斗篷。他們都是勇敢的天霜男女。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Draugr, I can handle. But Hagravens? Well... I'm glad I'm not fighting them alone.
plugin.seed: 我能应付尸鬼。但是乌鸦鬼婆？好吧……我很高兴我不是一个人在和他们战斗。
plugin.target: 我能應付屍鬼。但是烏鴉鬼婆？好吧……我很高興我不是一個人在和他們戰鬥。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They say the Reach used to be the only part of Skyrim that wasn't covered in snow.
plugin.seed: 他们说边塞领曾经是天际唯一不被雪覆盖的部分。
plugin.target: 他們說邊塞領曾經是天霜唯一不被雪覆蓋的部分。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Reach is... beautiful, in it's own way. And by that, I mean it's way worse from up close.
plugin.seed: 瑞驰如此...美丽，以它独自的方式。我的意思是，近距离观察的话情况会更糟。
plugin.target: 瑞馳如此...美麗，以它獨自的方式。我的意思是，近距離觀察的話情況會更糟。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Stendarr, Stuhn, whatever you might call him - he frowns on this city, the way they throw everyone who looks at the Silver-Bloods wrong in the mine.
plugin.seed: 斯坦德尔、斯图恩，不管你怎么称呼他——他都对这座城市不满，银血家族把所有得罪了的人都扔进矿坑。
plugin.target: 斯坦德爾、斯圖恩，不管你怎麼稱呼他——他都對這座城市不滿，銀血家族把所有得罪了的人都扔進礦坑。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Dibella is probably the last divine I'd associate with this place. Granted, Mara's temple is in Riften.
plugin.seed: 我很难想象到蒂贝拉的神殿能出现在这个地方。当然，玛拉神庙不也位于裂谷城嘛。
plugin.target: 我很難想像到蒂貝拉的神殿能出現在這個地方。當然，瑪拉神廟不也位於裂谷城嘛。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: As far as I know, this is the only city the Dwarves built above ground.
plugin.seed: 据我所知，这是矮人们在地上建造的唯一一座城市。
plugin.target: 據我所知，這是矮人們在地上建造的唯一一座城市。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I have no sympathy for the Forsworn. Killing defenseless miners and farmers won't get them anywhere. If it weren't for the Thalmor and Stormcloaks, the Empire would have crushed them by now.
plugin.seed: 我对弃誓者毫无同情。杀死手无寸铁的矿工和农民不会让他们得到什么。如果不是梭默和风暴斗篷，帝国现在早就消灭他们了。
plugin.target: 我對棄誓者毫無同情。殺死手無寸鐵的礦工和農民不會讓他們得到什麼。如果不是梭默和風暴斗篷，帝國現在早就消滅他們了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The castle off the coast - that's where your vampire lady-friend grew up, right?
plugin.seed: 海岸古堡——那就是你的吸血鬼小情人长大的地方，对吧？
plugin.target: 海岸古堡——那就是你的吸血鬼小情人長大的地方，對吧？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Plenty of Thalmor patrols come through this part of Skyrim. We should be careful.
plugin.seed: 许多梭默巡逻队在附近游荡。我们应该小心。
plugin.target: 許多梭默巡邏隊在附近遊蕩。我們應該小心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: General Tullius is a good strategist and a better leader. Solitude is lucky to have him.
plugin.seed: 图留斯将军是一位优秀的战略家，一个更好的领导者。独孤城很幸运能拥有他的支持。
plugin.target: 圖留斯將軍是一位優秀的戰略家，一個更好的領導者。獨孤城很幸運能擁有他的支持。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Between you and me, I'm not sure if Jarl Elisif is suited to be the High Queen. She's half a decade younger than I am.
plugin.seed: 我悄悄给你说，我其实不太确定艾利西弗领主是否适合担任至高女王。她比我都小五岁。
plugin.target: 我悄悄給你說，我其實不太確定艾利西弗領主是否適合擔任至高女王。她比我都小五歲。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My father was in the Legion. He said it got him off the streets of Bravil and turned his life around. I have a lot of respect for the soldiers here.
plugin.seed: 我父亲曾经是一名军团士兵。他加入军团让他离开了布拉维尔的街道并改变了他的生活。因此我非常尊重这里的士兵。
plugin.target: 我父親曾經是一名軍團士兵。他加入軍團讓他離開了布拉維爾的街道並改變了他的生活。因此我非常尊重這裡的士兵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Watch out for bears... eh, never mind, you'll probably hear them coming.
plugin.seed: 当心熊……呃，没关系，你可能已经听到它们来了。
plugin.target: 當心熊……呃，沒關係，你可能已經聽到它們來了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Beautiful hold, horrible city. Damn the Black-Briars to Oblivion.
plugin.seed: 美丽的堡垒，可怕的城市。该死的黑荆家族就该滚去湮灭。
plugin.target: 美麗的堡壘，可怕的城市。該死的黑荊家族就該滾去湮滅。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I might be biased, but the mead here is completely overrated.
plugin.seed: 我可能有带有偏见，但这里的蜜酒完全过誉了。
plugin.target: 我可能有帶有偏見，但這裡的蜜酒完全過譽了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've heard it's gotten a lot warmer in Falkreath since the Third Era, and no one is quite sure why.
plugin.seed: 我听说自第三纪元以来，佛克瑞斯变得暖和了许多，但没有人十分清楚这是为什么。
plugin.target: 我聽說自第三紀元以來，佛克瑞斯變得暖和了許多，但沒有人十分清楚這是為什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Whiterun will always be my home, but I'll admit that this is one of the loveliest holds in Skyrim.
plugin.seed: 白漫城永远是我的家，但不得不承认这里是天际最可爱的地方之一了。
plugin.target: 白漫城永遠是我的家，但不得不承認這裡是天霜最可愛的地方之一了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Falkreath is... bittersweet. The forest is beautiful, but the bones of great Nord heroes lie under the soil here. At least the people won't ever forget them.
plugin.seed: 佛克瑞斯......这里苦乐参半。森林很美，但下方埋葬着诺德英灵们的骸骨。至少人们永远不会忘记他们。
plugin.target: 佛克瑞斯......這裡苦樂參半。森林很美，但下方埋葬著諾德英靈們的骸骨。至少人們永遠不會忘記他們。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I haven't heard many good things about Jarl Siddgeir. Damn shame. The people of Falkreath deserve better.
plugin.seed: 我没有怎么听过关于西德盖尔领主的好话。他真该感到耻辱，佛克瑞斯的人民应该过上更好的生活。
plugin.target: 我沒有怎麼聽過關於西德蓋爾領主的好話。他真該感到恥辱，佛克瑞斯的人民應該過上更好的生活。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Why anyone chose to build a town out here is beyond me. Where are they supposed to grow crops?
plugin.seed: 我不明白为什么有人选择在这里建造城镇。他们应该在哪里种植庄稼？
plugin.target: 我不明白為什麼有人選擇在這裡建造城鎮。他們應該在哪裡種植莊稼？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Ugh... got some water in my boots. My father said the most important thing he learned in the Legion was what happens to your feet happens to the rest of your body.
plugin.seed: 呃……我的靴子里进了一些水。我父亲说，他在军团学到的最重要的事情是，你的脚会发生什么，你身体的其他部分也会发生什么。
plugin.target: 呃……我的靴子裡進了一些水。我父親說，他在軍團學到的最重要的事情是，你的腳會發生什麼，你身體的其他部分也會發生什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think I hear another Nirnroot...
plugin.seed: 我想我听到这里有奈恩根...
plugin.target: 我想我聽到這裡有奈恩根...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm still not over the fact that they call it the "Winterhold Hold."
plugin.seed: 我仍然没有忘记他们称之为“冬堡领”的事实。
plugin.target: 我仍然沒有忘記他們稱之為“冬堡領”的事實。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My father grew up in Bravil, and he always complained about the cold in Whiterun, of all places. Now I know how he must have felt.
plugin.seed: 我父亲在布拉维尔长大，他总是抱怨白漫的寒冷。现在我知道他的感受了。
plugin.target: 我父親在布拉維爾長大，他總是抱怨白漫的寒冷。現在我知道他的感受了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can't believe we built our capital up here once. It's even colder than Windhelm.
plugin.seed: 我真不敢相信我们曾经在这里建立了我们的都城。比风舵城还要冷。
plugin.target: 我真不敢相信我們曾經在這裡建立了我們的都城。比風舵城還要冷。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's ironic - the town closest to the center of all magic in Skyrim hates magic the most.
plugin.seed: 讽刺的是，在天际，离魔法中心最近的小镇最讨厌魔法。
plugin.target: 諷刺的是，在天霜，離魔法中心最近的小鎮最討厭魔法。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think the reason why the college survived is obvious enough - they were able to protect themselves with magic. A shame they didn't share it.
plugin.seed: 我认为这所学院幸存下来的原因很明显——他们能够用魔法保护自己。可惜他们没有分享这份力量。
plugin.target: 我認為這所學院倖存下來的原因很明顯——他們能夠用魔法保護自己。可惜他們沒有分享這份力量。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Pale is dangerous, it's cold, but it's undeniably Nordic for those reasons.
plugin.seed: 苍原领又冷又危险，正因如此，它无疑很有诺德范。
plugin.target: 蒼原領又冷又危險，正因如此，它無疑很有諾德範。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Forsworn raid Karthwasten regularly, and the Silver-Bloods just harass the town. Shame on them. True Nords are better than that.
plugin.seed: 弃誓者经常袭击西卡斯镇，而银血家族也来骚扰这个城镇。他们真为真正的诺德人丢脸。
plugin.target: 棄誓者經常襲擊西卡斯鎮，而銀血家族也來騷擾這個城鎮。他們真為真正的諾德人丟臉。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Lots of soldiers complain about this armor, but my father told me that's only because they wear it wrong. You have really tighten the segments on your waist so that it doesn't ride your shoulders too much.
plugin.seed: 很多士兵抱怨这件盔甲难穿，但我父亲告诉我，这只是因为他们穿错了。你只要收紧了腰部，它就不会太勒你的肩膀了。
plugin.target: 很多士兵抱怨這件盔甲難穿，但我父親告訴我，這只是因為他們穿錯了。你只要收緊了腰部，它就不會太勒你的肩膀了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: This armor... it just doesn't feel right. Like it wasn't meant to be worn by a human.
plugin.seed: 这件盔甲。。。只是感觉不对劲。就像它不是人类应该穿的一样。
plugin.target: 這件盔甲。。。只是感覺不對勁。就像它不是人類應該穿的一樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Can you give me some different armor? I look ridiculous, and all of the weight is on my shoulders - my hips aren't doing anything!
plugin.seed: 你能给我一些别的盔甲吗？我看起来很可笑，所有的重量都在我的肩膀上——我的臀部也使不上力！
plugin.target: 你能給我一些別的盔甲嗎？我看起來很可笑，所有的重量都在我的肩膀上——我的臀部也使不上力！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It looks a little silly, but otherwise this armor is perfect. It's strong, and it's tight enough to feel a lot lighter than it actually is.
plugin.seed: 它看起来有点傻，但除此之外，这件盔甲很完美。它很结实，而且很紧，感觉比实际轻很多。
plugin.target: 它看起來有點傻，但除此之外，這件盔甲很完美。它很結實，而且很緊，感覺比實際輕很多。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: For armor like this... carrying all your Dragon bones around was worth it.
plugin.seed: 对这样的盔甲。。。带着你所有的龙骨到处走走是值得的。
plugin.target: 對這樣的盔甲。。。帶著你所有的龍骨到處走走是值得的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm more of a heavy armor woman myself, but it's nice to carry a lighter load.
plugin.seed: 我自己更像是一个重甲战士，但轻装上阵依然能行。
plugin.target: 我自己更像是一個重甲戰士，但輕裝上陣依然能行。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Why are you making me wear this? Everything is so... exposed.
plugin.seed: 你为什么要让我穿这个？看上去...那么暴露。
plugin.target: 你為什麼要讓我穿這個？看上去...那麼暴露。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I never understood why they don't just drink blood from bandits. It would make life easier for everyone.
plugin.seed: 我一直不明白他们为什么不喝强盗的血。这会让每个人的生活都更开心。
plugin.target: 我一直不明白他們為什麼不喝強盜的血。這會讓每個人的生活都更開心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You've got a remedy for Sanguinare Vampiris, right? I wouldn't want you turning into one of these monsters.
plugin.seed: 你有治疗吸血鬼的药，对吧？我不希望你变成这些怪物。
plugin.target: 你有治療吸血鬼的藥，對吧？我不希望你變成這些怪物。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: These bastards rip our ancestors out of Sovngarde to fight for them instead of doing it themselves. I can't think of anything lower than that.
plugin.seed: 这些混蛋把我们的祖先从松加德召唤出来为他们而战，而不是自己上阵。真无耻。
plugin.target: 這些混蛋把我們的祖先從松加德召喚出來為他們而戰，而不是自己上陣。真無恥。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Wizards. Hmph. They brag about how powerful they are until you run a sword through their gut.
plugin.seed: 法师。嗯。他们总是吹嘘自己有多强大，直到你用剑刺穿他们的内脏。
plugin.target: 法師。嗯。他們總是吹噓自己有多強大，直到你用劍刺穿他們的內臟。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Clever as the ancestors were, they hardly wore any armor. Never understood why.
plugin.seed: 尽管先祖们很聪明，但他们几乎不怎么穿盔甲。想不明白为什么。
plugin.target: 儘管先祖們很聰明，但他們幾乎不怎麼穿盔甲。想不明白為什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's sad... these draugr have been dead for thousands of years and never set foot in Sovngarde.
plugin.seed: 这真悲哀...这些尸鬼已经死了数千年，从未涉足松加德。
plugin.target: 這真悲哀...這些屍鬼已經死了數千年，從未涉足松加德。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Careful in here. I'd hate to see you survive so many battles only to be killed by a trap.
plugin.seed: 小心陷阱。我不想看到你在阴沟翻船。
plugin.target: 小心陷阱。我不想看到你在陰溝翻船。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: There's a civil war being fought as we speak, we'll be at war with the Thalmor in a few years, and yet so many of the province's warriors are brigands.
plugin.seed: 正如我们所说的，天际正在打内战，而几年后我们还可能会与梭默开战，然而这里的许多战士还都是强盗。
plugin.target: 正如我們所說的，天霜正在打內戰，而幾年後我們還可能會與梭默開戰，然而這裡的許多戰士還都是強盜。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's sad to see so many young Nords take up this kind of life, even if it keeps us employed.
plugin.seed: 看到这么多年轻的诺德人过上这种生活真是令人难过，我们应该为他们继续我们的工作。
plugin.target: 看到這麼多年輕的諾德人過上這種生活真是令人難過，我們應該為他們繼續我們的工作。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I lost my mother to bandits like these. Don't leave a single one alive.
plugin.seed: 我就是因为这样失去了我的母亲。别留活口。
plugin.target: 我就是因為這樣失去了我的母親。別留活口。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My father was a Legionnaire and my mother was a Companion, so bandits generally stayed away from us unless they had the numbers... getting them was only a matter of time, unfortunately.
plugin.seed: 我父亲是一名退伍军人，母亲是一名战友，所以土匪们通常会远离我们，除非他们有很多人。。。不幸的是，这只是时间问题。
plugin.target: 我父親是一名退伍軍人，母親是一名戰友，所以土匪們通常會遠離我們，除非他們有很多人。。。不幸的是，這只是時間問題。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Some of these forts date back to the days of Tiber Septim himself.
plugin.seed: 这些堡垒中的一些可以追溯到泰伯·塞普丁的时代。
plugin.target: 這些堡壘中的一些可以追溯到泰伯·塞普丁的時代。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't know what the fact these are falling apart attests to more: Skyrim weather's ability to destroy Imperial construction, or Imperial construction's ability to withstand Skyrim weather for so long.
plugin.seed: 我不知道这些可悲的事实说明了什么：是天际的天气能够摧毁帝国的建筑，或是帝国的建筑居然能在天气的建筑中承受这么长时间。
plugin.target: 我不知道這些可悲的事實說明了什麼：是天霜的天氣能夠摧毀帝國的建築，或是帝國的建築居然能在天氣的建築中承受這麼長時間。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My father told me that not even the Thalmor battlemages could put a dent in forts like this during the great war. Not a big dent, at least.
plugin.seed: 我父亲告诉我，即使是梭默的战斗法师在浩大战争里也没法破化堡垒。至少不能弄出那么大的缺口。
plugin.target: 我父親告訴我，即使是梭默的戰鬥法師在浩大戰爭裡也沒法破化堡壘。至少不能弄出那麼大的缺口。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: There's almost a beauty in what the Dwarves did; without a hint of magic, they built ornate cities that lasted thousands of years.
plugin.seed: 矮人的所作所为毫无疑问带着浪漫色彩：即使没有魔法的帮助，他们的城市也历经了千年的时光。
plugin.target: 矮人的所作所為毫無疑問帶著浪漫色彩：即使沒有魔法的幫助，他們的城市也歷經了千年的時光。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Why do you think they were called "Dwarves" if everyone says they were around the same height as the Dark Elves?
plugin.seed: 如果每个人都认为他们和暗精灵差不多高，你说他们为什么被称为“矮人”？
plugin.target: 如果每個人都認為他們和暗精靈差不多高，你說他們為什麼被稱為“矮人”？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: This is some of the finest metalwork I've ever seen. Imagine what the Dwarves could have done with ebony or malachite.
plugin.seed: 这是我见过的最好的金属制品。想象一下矮人可以用黑檀或孔雀石做什么。
plugin.target: 這是我見過的最好的金屬製品。想像一下矮人可以用黑檀或孔雀石做什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We come accross so many couples that are constantly bickering, and I think I know why. They never take their wife on a romantic trip to a falmer hive like you.
plugin.seed: 我们遇到了很多经常吵架的情侣，我想我知道为什么。他们从来没有带妻子去像这样的沼泽地里浪漫旅行。
plugin.target: 我們遇到了很多經常吵架的情侶，我想我知道為什麼。他們從來沒有帶妻子去像這樣的沼澤地裡浪漫旅行。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If you don't have a light, you can't see where you're going. If you do, people can see you coming. That's why I hate caves.
plugin.seed: 没有灯，你有看不见路。有了灯，却很容易被人发现，这就是我讨厌洞穴的原因。
plugin.target: 沒有燈，你有看不見路。有了燈，卻很容易被人發現，這就是我討厭洞穴的原因。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Not very welcoming, but I doubt that's the point.
plugin.seed: 不太受欢迎啊，但我怀疑这就是重点。
plugin.target: 不太受歡迎啊，但我懷疑這就是重點。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: One fool of a wizard casts a fireball in here, and the whole place could come down on our heads.
plugin.seed: 一个愚蠢的法师在这里扔了一个火球，整个地方都可能坍塌。
plugin.target: 一個愚蠢的法師在這裡扔了一個火球，整個地方都可能坍塌。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They might not be the typical image of true Nords, but the Greybeards deserve equal respect.
plugin.seed: 他们可能不是真正诺德人的典型形象，但灰胡子应该得到同等的尊重。
plugin.target: 他們可能不是真正諾德人的典型形象，但灰鬍子應該得到同等的尊重。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Dark Elves have always seemed so... alien.
plugin.seed: 暗精灵似乎总是那么……不开化。
plugin.target: 暗精靈似乎總是那麼……不開化。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So... what do the Dark Elves eat, apart from ash yams? Netches don't look very appetizing.
plugin.seed: 那么……除了灰烬薯，暗精灵还吃什么？气母看起来不太好吃。
plugin.target: 那麼……除了灰燼薯，暗精靈還吃什麼？氣母看起來不太好吃。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm surprised the Skaal and the Dark Elves get along so well.
plugin.seed: 我很惊讶斯卡尔人能和暗精灵相处得这么好。
plugin.target: 我很驚訝斯卡爾人能和暗精靈相處得這麼好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've heard tales of the mushroom towers of Morrowind. Never thought I'd see one.
plugin.seed: 我以前有听过晨风省的真菌塔。我从没想过能亲眼目睹。
plugin.target: 我以前有聽過晨風省的真菌塔。我從沒想過能親眼目睹。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They say that in the Third Era, Falkreath and the Rift were covered in snow, but the south of Solstheim was warm, even though Red Mountain hadn't erupted. I can't make sense of that.
plugin.seed: 据说在第三纪元，佛克瑞斯和裂痕领都被白雪所覆盖，但索瑟海姆的南部很温暖，那时红山还没有爆发。我无法理解。
plugin.target: 據說在第三紀元，佛克瑞斯和裂痕領都被白雪所覆蓋，但索瑟海姆的南部很溫暖，那時紅山還沒有爆發。我無法理解。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Shor's Bones, I never realized how far the ash from Red Mountain went.
plugin.seed: 朔尔之血啊，我从来没有意识到红山的灰烬飘了多远。
plugin.target: 朔爾之血啊，我從來沒有意識到紅山的灰燼飄了多遠。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If there's ash this far north, Vvardenfell must be... Gods, I'm so sorry.
plugin.seed: 如果在这么远的北方都有火山灰，瓦登费尔一定……天哪，我很抱歉。
plugin.target: 如果在這麼遠的北方都有火山灰，瓦登費爾一定……天哪，我很抱歉。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're getting to be almost as good with a sword and shield as I am. I'm a bit worried.
plugin.seed: 你的剑盾技巧快赶上我了。我有点担心。
plugin.target: 你的劍盾技巧快趕上我了。我有點擔心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You've gotta teach me about your sword and shield techniques sometime. You're one of the few people I've met who's better than me.
plugin.seed: 有时间你得教教我你的剑术和盾术。你是我见过的为数不多的在这方面比我厉害的人。
plugin.target: 有時間你得教教我你的劍術和盾術。你是我見過的為數不多的在這方面比我厲害的人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Getting used to heavy armor, are you? I can help you get your plates adjusted, if you'd like.
plugin.seed: 习惯了重甲，是吗？如果你愿意，我可以帮你调整下防护板。
plugin.target: 習慣了重甲，是嗎？如果你願意，我可以幫你調整下防護板。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Gods, you've got that armor fitted on perfect. Not a single strap or plate out of place.
plugin.seed: 天那，你的盔甲简直完美无缺。每条带子或防护板都这么无暇。
plugin.target: 天那，你的盔甲簡直完美無缺。每條帶子或防護板都這麼無暇。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Archery's a good skill to take up. There's always a good moment between when a foe sees you and when they're close enough to hit you.
plugin.seed: 箭术是一项很好的技能。让箭矢飞会。
plugin.target: 箭術是一項很好的技能。讓箭矢飛會。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're making some impressive shots with that bow of yours. Now there's something I'd like you to teach me about.
plugin.seed: 你用你的那把弓打出了一些惊人的射击。现在我想让你教教我。
plugin.target: 你用你的那把弓打出了一些驚人的射擊。現在我想讓你教教我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Now that you've mastered the smithing trade, I'll be getting a new sword, right? Maybe some new armor, as well?
plugin.seed: 既然你已经掌握了锻造技能，我可以换一把新剑了，对吧？也许还能有一些新盔甲吗？
plugin.target: 既然你已經掌握了鍛造技能，我可以換一把新劍了，對吧？也許還能有一些新盔甲嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So, is real armor too heavy for you? I'll just make sure they don't hit you. In all seriousness, you did good with the fit.
plugin.seed: 那么，真正的盔甲对您来说太笨重了吗？我只是确保他们不会伤害你。说真的，你做得很厉害。
plugin.target: 那麼，真正的盔甲對您來說太笨重了嗎？我只是確保他們不會傷害你。說真的，你做得很厲害。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're awfully fond of claymores and battleaxes, aren't you? My mother would have liked you.
plugin.seed: 你非常喜欢双手剑和战斧，是吗？我妈妈会喜欢你的。
plugin.target: 你非常喜歡雙手劍和戰斧，是嗎？我媽媽會喜歡你的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've got nothing against sneaking around as long as you get in the fight at some point.
plugin.seed: 只要你在某个合适的时候加入战斗，我就不会反对你的潜行。
plugin.target: 只要你在某個合適的時候加入戰鬥，我就不會反對你的潛行。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Look, I know you're more of the sneaky type, so I'm going to apologize in advance because plate armor makes a lot of noise.
plugin.seed: 看，我知道你喜欢潜行，所以我要提前道歉，因为板甲会发出很大的噪音。
plugin.target: 看，我知道你喜歡潛行，所以我要提前道歉，因為板甲會發出很大的噪音。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So... how does Alteration magic work, exactly? You just turn things into other things?
plugin.seed: 那么……变换魔法究竟是如何运行的吗？你真的把一些东西变成其他东西了吗？
plugin.target: 那麼……變換魔法究竟是如何運行的嗎？你真的把一些東西變成其他東西了嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're pretty good at mixing potions, I have to say. This doesn't mean you're going to go live alone in the woods now, right?
plugin.seed: 你很擅长调配药水，我不得不说。但这并不意味着你现在要一个人住在树林里，对吧？
plugin.target: 你很擅長調配藥水，我不得不說。但這並不意味著你現在要一個人住在樹林裡，對吧？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That silver tongue of yours makes me nervous sometimes, honestly. Can't help but wonder what you'll talk me into next.
plugin.seed: 老实说，你那能说会道的嘴巴有时让我感到紧张。让我忍不住想知道接下来你会说服我做什么。
plugin.target: 老實說，你那能說會道的嘴巴有時讓我感到緊張。讓我忍不住想知道接下來你會說服我做什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'll be honest... I thought Illusion magic was two-bit street tricks until I saw you in action.
plugin.seed: 老实说……在我看到你出手前，我认为幻术系魔法只是街头小把戏。
plugin.target: 老實說……在我看到你出手前，我認為幻術系魔法只是街頭小把戲。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Of every school of magic, you chose Conjuration? *Sigh* Just don't reanimate any of my ancestors.
plugin.seed: 在所有魔法派系中，你选择了召唤系？ *叹气*只是不要复活我的任何祖先好吗。
plugin.target: 在所有魔法派系中，你選擇了召喚系？ *嘆氣*只是不要復活我的任何祖先好嗎。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm glad to have a Destruction mage on my side for once. Watching things explode is a lot of fun.
plugin.seed: 我很高兴这一次有一个毁灭法师站在我这边。看着这些东西爆炸很有趣。
plugin.target: 我很高興這一次有一個毀滅法師站在我這邊。看著這些東西爆炸很有趣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Restoration's a great skill to have. I feel safer already, travelling with you.
plugin.seed: 恢复系是一项很棒的技能。和你一起旅行，我感觉更安全了。
plugin.target: 恢復系是一項很棒的技能。和你一起旅行，我感覺更安全了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's amazing how some of the weapons and armor you enchant are better then legendary relics from old stories.
plugin.seed: 令人惊奇的是，您附魔的一些武器和盔甲比古代传说中的传奇遗物更强。
plugin.target: 令人驚奇的是，您附魔的一些武器和盔甲比古代傳說中的傳奇遺物更強。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You don't dabble in magic much, do you? Can't say I blame you. I barely trust any of it myself.
plugin.seed: 你对魔法的了解并不多是吗，这不怪你。我也不太信任这些。
plugin.target: 你對魔法的瞭解並不多是嗎，這不怪你。我也不太信任這些。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're not much of a warrior, are you? We could remedy that at some point, if you'd like. It has me somewhat concerned.
plugin.seed: 你算不上战士，是吗？如果您愿意，我们可以在某个时候补救一下。这让我有些担心。
plugin.target: 你算不上戰士，是嗎？如果您願意，我們可以在某個時候補救一下。這讓我有些擔心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're not good with the... unconventional kind of fighting, are you? Neither am I, but I'll admit that it works better sometimes.
plugin.seed: 你不擅长...非常规的战斗，是吗？我也不是，但我承认它有时效果更好。
plugin.target: 你不擅長...非常規的戰鬥，是嗎？我也不是，但我承認它有時效果更好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I have to ask... you didn't happen to run into my parents in Sovngarde, did you?
plugin.seed: 我不得不问...你不会碰巧在松加德遇到过我的父母吧？
plugin.target: 我不得不問...你不會碰巧在松加德遇到過我的父母吧？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You know, I never really questioned whether Sovngarde was a real place or not... but getting confirmation from you is a satisfying feeling.
plugin.seed: 你知道吗，我虽从未质疑过松加德是否真实存在......但得到你的确认后心中踏实多了。
plugin.target: 你知道嗎，我雖從未質疑過鬆加德是否真實存在......但得到你的確認後心中踏實多了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Shor's bones, it's like Alftand all over again.
plugin.seed: 朔尔的骨头，就像精灵之牙一样。
plugin.target: 朔爾的骨頭，就像精靈之牙一樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: "When the top level was built, eheheh..." Sorry. I associate Dwarven ruins with Septimus now, can't get it out of my head.
plugin.seed: “最后一层建立起来后，哈哈哈……”抱歉。我现在总是将矮人废墟与塞普汀默斯联想在一起，满脑子都是他的话。
plugin.target: “最後一層建立起來後，哈哈哈……”抱歉。我現在總是將矮人廢墟與塞普汀默斯聯想在一起，滿腦子都是他的話。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It seems like the Thalmor just up and left after that run-in in the Ratway, but I'm keeping my eyes open for more than just thieves while we're here.
plugin.seed: 似乎梭默在鼠道发生冲突后就起身离开了，但当我们在这里时，我不仅要睁大眼睛寻找小偷。
plugin.target: 似乎梭默在鼠道發生衝突後就起身離開了，但當我們在這裡時，我不僅要睜大眼睛尋找小偷。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Feels like ages ago since we first made that trek out here.
plugin.seed: 就像很久以前，我们第一次同行一样。
plugin.target: 就像很久以前，我們第一次同行一樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'll admit, I'm always a little disappointed to not find an Akaviri temple at the end of these.
plugin.seed: 我承认，我总是有点失望，因为在这最后也没有找到阿卡维尔神庙。
plugin.target: 我承認，我總是有點失望，因為在這最後也沒有找到阿卡維爾神廟。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm sure your friends at the college would be fawning over this place.
plugin.seed: 我敢肯定你学院里的朋友们一定喜欢这个地方。
plugin.target: 我敢肯定你學院裡的朋友們一定喜歡這個地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If you can, you really ought to change the College's policy on Necromancy. Just look at this place.
plugin.seed: 如果可以的话，你真的应该改变学院关于死灵法术的规则。只要需要看看这个地方。
plugin.target: 如果可以的話，你真的應該改變學院關於死靈法術的規則。只要需要看看這個地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I still can't help but wonder if Ancano went rogue or if the Thalmor wanted him to do all that.
plugin.seed: 我仍然忍不住想知道安卡诺是否会变成无赖，或者梭默是否希望他变得这样。
plugin.target: 我仍然忍不住想知道安卡諾是否會變成無賴，或者梭默是否希望他變得這樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The war's almost over, isn't it? Thank Stendarr for that. It'll be good to see Skyrim come back under Imperial control.
plugin.seed: 战争快结束了，不是吗？感谢斯坦德尔。很高兴看到天际省回到帝国的控制之下。
plugin.target: 戰爭快結束了，不是嗎？感謝斯坦德爾。很高興看到天霜省回到帝國的控制之下。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Empire's nearly gone at this point, aren't they? Well, I won't complain about the shrines to Talos coming back.
plugin.seed: 帝国失败了，不是吗？好吧，我不会对塔洛斯祭坛的回归抱怨。
plugin.target: 帝國失敗了，不是嗎？好吧，我不會對塔洛斯祭壇的迴歸抱怨。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm glad you were able to cure yourself and Kodlak, in the end.
plugin.seed: 我很高兴你最终能够治好了你自己和克拉科。
plugin.target: 我很高興你最終能夠治好了你自己和克拉科。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Thane, you need to get back to Ysgramor's tomb and get yourself cured as soon as possible. Service to a Daedra never ends well.
plugin.seed: 武卫，你需要尽快回到伊斯格拉谟陵墓并治愈自己。为魔族服务永远不会有好下场。
plugin.target: 男爵，你需要儘快回到伊斯格拉謨陵墓並治癒自己。為魔族服務永遠不會有好下場。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Harbinger of the companions, huh? Don't take that lightly, Thane. It's a great honor.
plugin.seed: 战友团先驱，哈？别掉以轻心，武卫。真是莫大的荣誉。
plugin.target: 戰友團先驅，哈？別掉以輕心，男爵。真是莫大的榮譽。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I heard what happened with Harkon. Gods above, what a horker-brain. You'd think he'd know better than to destroy his own food supply after being alive that long.
plugin.seed: 我听说了哈孔身上发生的事情。天哪，聪明反被聪明误。都活了那么久，却试图破坏自己食物的生活环境。
plugin.target: 我聽說了哈孔身上發生的事情。天哪，聰明反被聰明誤。都活了那麼久，卻試圖破壞自己食物的生活環境。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Hunting vampires is a noble cause. Sounds like a good bit of fun, too.
plugin.seed: 猎杀吸血鬼是一项崇高的事业。听起来也很有趣。
plugin.target: 獵殺吸血鬼是一項崇高的事業。聽起來也很有趣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I hear the way Serana talks to you. I swear, she puts one finger on you, I'm putting a silver blade through her gullet.
plugin.seed: 我听到瑟拉娜和你说话的方式了。我发誓，只要她敢把一根手指放在你身上，我就会用一把银剑刺穿他。
plugin.target: 我聽到瑟拉娜和你說話的方式了。我發誓，只要她敢把一根手指放在你身上，我就會用一把銀劍刺穿他。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So... you and Serana? Good for you, Thane. You deserve someone like her.
plugin.seed: 所以…你和瑟拉娜？太好了，武卫。你完全配得上她。
plugin.target: 所以…你和瑟拉娜？太好了，男爵。你完全配得上她。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If you happen to find one of those crossbows just lying around Fort Dawnguard... could I have it? ...Please?
plugin.seed: 如果你碰巧在黎明守卫城堡发现了一把弩。。。能给我吗。。。求你了
plugin.target: 如果你碰巧在黎明守衛城堡發現了一把弩。。。能給我嗎。。。求你了
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: By Ysmir, I have to say; this crossbow is an amazing device. Thank you, Thane.
plugin.seed: 伊斯米尔，我不得不说这把弩真是惊喜。谢谢你，武卫。
plugin.target: 伊斯米爾，我不得不說這把弩真是驚喜。謝謝你，男爵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It was good to see that we could turn things around in Raven Rock. Lots of other places around Tamriel could use that kind of hope.
plugin.seed: 很高兴看到我们能在鸦石镇扭转局面。这会激励泰姆瑞尔的许多人。
plugin.target: 很高興看到我們能在鴉石鎮扭轉局面。這會激勵泰姆瑞爾的許多人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm still concerned about your ties to Hermaeus Mora. The Daedra are evil no two ways about it.
plugin.seed: 我仍然担心你和赫麦尤斯·莫拉的关系。迪德拉都很邪恶。
plugin.target: 我仍然擔心你和赫麥尤斯·莫拉的關係。迪德拉都很邪惡。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Something always felt off about Saadia. I wasn't surprised when the Alik'r showed up. That's one less Thalmor agent in Skyrim, eh?
plugin.seed: 萨蒂亚总是有点不对劲。当阿利克尔人出现时，我并不感到惊讶。天际少了一个梭默特工，嗯？
plugin.target: 薩蒂亞總是有點不對勁。當阿利克爾人出現時，我並不感到驚訝。天霜少了一個梭默特工，嗯？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Thane, I knew Saadia for a while. Something about her always rubbed me the wrong way. Those Alik'r... they might have been right.
plugin.seed: 大人，我认识萨蒂亚一段时间了。她身上总是有让我不舒服的地方。那些阿利克尔人...他们或许是对的。
plugin.target: 大人，我認識薩蒂亞一段時間了。她身上總是有讓我不舒服的地方。那些阿利克爾人...他們或許是對的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Regardless of what side of the war we're on, it was good to help Thorald. The Thalmor are the enemies of both sides.
plugin.seed: 无论我们站在战争的哪一边，都应该帮助索拉德。梭默是双方共同的敌人。
plugin.target: 無論我們站在戰爭的哪一邊，都應該幫助索拉德。梭默是雙方共同的敵人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I had fun clearing out Japhet's Folly. We should fight islands full of pirates more often.
plugin.seed: 我在清理贾菲特堡垒时玩得很开心。我们应该多打打这些海盗。
plugin.target: 我在清理賈菲特堡壘時玩得很開心。我們應該多打打這些海盜。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm glad we dealt with Calixto. I detest Necromancy as is... but I had no idea it could be even more sickening.
plugin.seed: 我很高兴我们能和卡利斯托打交道。我讨厌死灵术…但我不知道它能这么恶心。
plugin.target: 我很高興我們能和卡利斯托打交道。我討厭死靈術…但我不知道它能這麼噁心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'll be honest... I still haven't figured out just what happened with Avanchnzel.
plugin.seed: 老实说。。。我还没有弄清楚阿旺晨泽尔到底发生了什么。
plugin.target: 老實說。。。我還沒有弄清楚阿旺晨澤爾到底發生了什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Oooh, careful, Thane. You crossed the Black-Briars, and now they'll come after us with their *extremely* deadly assassins.
plugin.seed: 哦，小心，谢谢。你刚刚得罪了黑棘，现在他们可能会找刺客来追杀我们。
plugin.target: 哦，小心，謝謝。你剛剛得罪了黑棘，現在他們可能會找刺客來追殺我們。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I heard about what happened in the mine. The Sliver-Bloods are vile, but cutting the head off of the Forsworn serpent was a smart decision.
plugin.seed: 我听说了矿井里发生的事。银血家族虽然邪恶，但砍掉弃誓者的头也是一个明智的决定。
plugin.target: 我聽說了礦井裡發生的事。銀血家族雖然邪惡，但砍掉棄誓者的頭也是一個明智的決定。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't know the details of what happened in Cidhna mine, but by the gods, why would you help the Forsworn kill civilians? How much skooma did they give you?
plugin.seed: 我不知道希讷矿坑里事情的细节，但天啊，你为什么要帮助弃誓者杀害平民？他们给了你多少好处？
plugin.target: 我不知道希訥礦坑裡事情的細節，但天啊，你為什麼要幫助棄誓者殺害平民？他們給了你多少好處？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can't believe those warlocks tried to summon an incomprehensibly powerful madwoman. Might as well just stick your whole face in a campfire while you're at it.
plugin.seed: 我真不敢相信那些术士试图召唤一个难以理解的强大疯女人。当你在篝火旁的时候，不妨把你的整个脸都放进篝火里。
plugin.target: 我真不敢相信那些術士試圖召喚一個難以理解的強大瘋女人。當你在篝火旁的時候，不妨把你的整個臉都放進篝火裡。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: People aren't going to forget about how we saved Solitude from Potema any time soon. Great work, Thane.
plugin.seed: 人们不会忘记我们是如何从波特玛手中拯救孤独的。干得好，武卫。
plugin.target: 人們不會忘記我們是如何從波特瑪手中拯救孤獨的。幹得好，男爵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm not fond of you trying to become a pirate, but at least it ended with us killing a whole grotto full of them.
plugin.seed: 我不喜欢你试图成为一名海盗，但至少最后我们把他们都杀光了。
plugin.target: 我不喜歡你試圖成為一名海盜，但至少最後我們把他們都殺光了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The people here don't look nearly as tired as they used to. Erandur is a good man.
plugin.seed: 这里的人看起来不像以前那么疲倦了。依兰杜尔是个好人。
plugin.target: 這裡的人看起來不像以前那麼疲倦了。依蘭杜爾是個好人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My blood boils every time I think about what happened to Hroggar's wife and daughter. I'm glad we gave Movarth and Alva what they deserved.
plugin.seed: 每当我想到发生在赫鲁加妻女身上的事时，我就怒火中烧。我很高兴我们给了莫瓦斯和阿尔瓦他们应得的代价。
plugin.target: 每當我想到發生在赫魯加妻女身上的事時，我就怒火中燒。我很高興我們給了莫瓦斯和阿爾瓦他們應得的代價。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: This is what us Nords were always meant to do - traverse the province and right wrongs with strength, steel, and resolve.
plugin.seed: 这就是我们诺德人一直想做的事——跨越天际，用力量、钢铁和决心纠正错误。
plugin.target: 這就是我們諾德人一直想做的事——跨越天霜，用力量、鋼鐵和決心糾正錯誤。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's good to see another Imperial living this kind of life. We're not as soft as a lot of Nords would like to believe.
plugin.seed: 很高兴看到另一个帝国人过着这样的生活。我们并不像许多诺德人相信的那样软弱。
plugin.target: 很高興看到另一個帝國人過著這樣的生活。我們並不像許多諾德人相信的那樣軟弱。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Since you're an Imperial, I have to ask... did your parents obsess over making sauce out of tomatoes every Sundas? My father always did.
plugin.seed: 既然你是帝国人，我不得不问......你的父母是否痴迷于每个周日都用西红柿做酱汁？我父亲总是这样。
plugin.target: 既然你是帝國人，我不得不問......你的父母是否痴迷於每個週日都用西紅柿做醬汁？我父親總是這樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We should start thinking about what we're going to have for dinner in two weeks. Oh, don't give me that look. You're an Imperial, too.
plugin.seed: 我们应该开始考虑两周后晚餐吃什么。哦，别用那种眼神看我。你也是帝国人。
plugin.target: 我們應該開始考慮兩週後晚餐吃什麼。哦，別用那種眼神看我。你也是帝國人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I have a lot of respect for Redguards, but is it true you call Akatosh "Tall Papa"? In all fairness, we Nords used call Malacath "Mountain Fart."
plugin.seed: 我非常尊重红卫人，但你称阿卡托什为“至高之父”是真的吗？平心而论，我们诺德人习惯称马拉卡斯为“山屁”。
plugin.target: 我非常尊重紅衛人，但你稱阿卡託什為“至高之父”是真的嗎？平心而論，我們諾德人習慣稱馬拉卡斯為“山屁”。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: High Rock sounds like a beautiful province. You Bretons are underrated, I have to admit.
plugin.seed: 高岩听起来像是一个美丽的省份。我不得不承认，你们布莱顿人被低估了。
plugin.target: 高巖聽起來像是一個美麗的省份。我不得不承認，你們布萊頓人被低估了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: There's a lot of Dark Elves in Skyrim nowadays. The province is sparsely populated, so I don't take much issue with it, but some Nords do. Be careful.
plugin.seed: 如今天际中有很多暗精灵。天际人烟稀少，所以我对此没有太大意见，但一些诺德人却不这么看。当心。
plugin.target: 如今天霜中有很多暗精靈。天霜人煙稀少，所以我對此沒有太大意見，但一些諾德人卻不這麼看。當心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I have to admit, you've disproved a lot of what I thought about Orcs. I'm embarrassed to say it, but I didn't think you bathed regularly.
plugin.seed: 我不得不承认，你纠正了我对兽人的很多看法。有点话不好意思，但我没想到你经常洗澡。
plugin.target: 我不得不承認，你糾正了我對獸人的很多看法。有點話不好意思，但我沒想到你經常洗澡。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You don't buy into all that Thalmor nonsense, right?
plugin.seed: 你不会相信梭默的废话，对吧？
plugin.target: 你不會相信梭默的廢話，對吧？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: A High Elf travelling with a Nord. How about that?
plugin.seed: 与诺德人一起旅行的高精灵。怎么样？
plugin.target: 與諾德人一起旅行的高精靈。怎麼樣？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've heard stories about Valenwood. It doesn't sound like it has anything in common with Skyrim... must have been strange first coming here.
plugin.seed: 我听说过有关威木省的故事。听起来它与天际完全不同……你第一次来到这里一定很难适应。
plugin.target: 我聽說過有關威木省的故事。聽起來它與天霜完全不同……你第一次來到這裡一定很難適應。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What's it like eating only meat? I'd imagine it would cause... imbalances.
plugin.seed: 只吃肉是什么感觉？我想这会导致……营养失衡。
plugin.target: 只吃肉是什麼感覺？我想這會導致……營養失衡。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Even with a natural coat of fur, you still think it's cold up here? Gods, Elsweyr must be warm.
plugin.seed: 就算有了天生的皮毛，你还觉得这里冷吗？天哪，艾斯维尔一定很暖和。
plugin.target: 就算有了天生的皮毛，你還覺得這裡冷嗎？天哪，艾斯維爾一定很暖和。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So... why do Khajiit refer to themselves in the third person?
plugin.seed: 那么……为什么虎人用第三人称来称呼自己？
plugin.target: 那麼……為什麼虎人用第三人稱來稱呼自己？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've heard that only Argonians can survive the depths of Black Marsh. There are places in Skyrim that only a Nord could survive in, but none of them are that expansive.
plugin.seed: 我听说只有亚龙人才能在黑沼泽深处生存。就像天际中有些地方只有诺德人才能生存，但没有一个地方那么广阔。
plugin.target: 我聽說只有亞龍人才能在黑沼澤深處生存。就像天霜中有些地方只有諾德人才能生存，但沒有一個地方那麼廣闊。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Don't you dare ask me to joint the blades. I'm not leaving you for Delphine.
plugin.seed: 你敢叫我加入刀锋卫士吗，我不会离开你去戴尔芬那里去的。
plugin.target: 你敢叫我加入刀鋒衛士嗎，我不會離開你去戴爾芬那裡去的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The day we stood at that altar... it was the best day of my life. Thank you. For everything.
plugin.seed: 我们站在祭坛前的那天...那是我一生中最美好的一天。非常感谢。所有都是。
plugin.target: 我們站在祭壇前的那天...那是我一生中最美好的一天。非常感謝。所有都是。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think my parents always wanted to live like this - roaming around, fighting together - but I was born right after the Great War ended and they came home.
plugin.seed: 我想我的父母一直都想这样生活——四处流浪，一起战斗——但我在浩大战争结束后出生了，他们因此回归了家庭。
plugin.target: 我想我的父母一直都想這樣生活——四處流浪，一起戰鬥——但我在浩大戰爭結束後出生了，他們因此迴歸了家庭。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I couldn't ask for anything more than travelling the world with you, darling.
plugin.seed: 亲爱的，除了和你一起环游世界之外，我再也没有别的要求了。
plugin.target: 親愛的，除了和你一起環遊世界之外，我再也沒有別的要求了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think this is the life I always dreamed of, and it's all thanks to you. You keep that in mind, love.
plugin.seed: 我想这是我一直梦想的生活，这一切都归功于你。亲爱的，你要记得噢。
plugin.target: 我想這是我一直夢想的生活，這一切都歸功於你。親愛的，你要記得噢。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Let me guess... you became a bard so you could tell everyone stories of our travels. Can't wait to see what parts you embellish.
plugin.seed: 让我猜猜...你成为了一名吟游诗人，这样你就可以向每个人讲述我们的冒险故事。我等不及地想看看你编造了哪些。
plugin.target: 讓我猜猜...你成為了一名吟遊詩人，這樣你就可以向每個人講述我們的冒險故事。我等不及地想看看你編造了哪些。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: A lot of people must pass through here on the way to Solitude. That's probably how the town got started, all things considered.
plugin.seed: 这是很多人去独孤城的必经之路。考虑到这些因素，这可能就是这个小镇的起源。
plugin.target: 這是很多人去獨孤城的必經之路。考慮到這些因素，這可能就是這個小鎮的起源。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Dragon Bridge isn't much, but the view of the ravine is really quite impressive. And the view of Solitude and Hjaalmarch.
plugin.seed: 龙桥不大，但峡谷的景色真的很令人印象深刻。以及孤独城和希雅陲领的景色也有独特色彩。
plugin.target: 龍橋不大，但峽谷的景色真的很令人印象深刻。以及孤獨城和希雅陲領的景色也有獨特色彩。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Are you feeling alright? I'd imagine what you saw here was... harrowing.
plugin.seed: 你感觉还好吗？我想你在这里看到景象...令人痛心。
plugin.target: 你感覺還好嗎？我想你在這裡看到景象...令人痛心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I wonder if the view of the lake, the mountain, and Eastmarch is worth the bear attacks.
plugin.seed: 我想知道湖、山和东陲领的景色是否值得让熊发起袭击。
plugin.target: 我想知道湖、山和東陲領的景色是否值得讓熊發起襲擊。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I still can't believe we let Delphine talk us into coming all the way out here.
plugin.seed: 我仍然不敢相信我们真被戴尔芬说服了。
plugin.target: 我仍然不敢相信我們真被戴爾芬說服了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I suppose it's nice to see Nords, Imperials, and Dunmer all getting along this far east.
plugin.seed: 我想很高兴看到诺德人、帝国人和丹莫都来到了这个遥远的东方。
plugin.target: 我想很高興看到諾德人、帝國人和丹莫都來到了這個遙遠的東方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm concerned about staying here overnight - this place doesn't seem safe from Forsworn attacks.
plugin.seed: 我很担心在这里过夜——这个地方似乎不安全，会不会受到弃誓者的袭击。
plugin.target: 我很擔心在這裡過夜——這個地方似乎不安全，會不會受到棄誓者的襲擊。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Strange to think that this is part of Whiterun. I guess Falkreath can't have all the picturesque villages.
plugin.seed: 奇怪的是，这是白漫领的一部分。我想佛克瑞斯领不可能拥有所有风景如画的村庄。
plugin.target: 奇怪的是，這是白漫領的一部分。我想佛克瑞斯領不可能擁有所有風景如畫的村莊。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't think they could have picked a better spot for a village, with the river, the forest, and the mountains around them.
plugin.seed: 我认为他们不会为村庄选择一个更好的地方，周围有河流、森林和群山。
plugin.target: 我認為他們不會為村莊選擇一個更好的地方，周圍有河流、森林和群山。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm going to let you in on a little secret... my family never had that much trouble growing crops on the other side of the hold. I doubt Rorikstead is all that special.
plugin.seed: 我要告诉你一个小秘密......我的家人在领地的另一边种植庄稼时从来没有遇到过那么多麻烦。我怀疑洛利克镇是否有那么特别。
plugin.target: 我要告訴你一個小秘密......我的家人在領地的另一邊種植莊稼時從來沒有遇到過那麼多麻煩。我懷疑洛利克鎮是否有那麼特別。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization
