plugin.source: I was posted in Rorikstead once when I was a guard. Rorik and Jouane started arguing the moment I got here, and then they asked me to go back to Whiterun. Never knew exactly what happened.
plugin.seed: 当我还是一名卫兵时，我曾被派往洛利克镇。我一到这里，洛利克和乔安内就开始吵架，然后他们让我回白漫城去。我一直不知道到底发生了什么。
plugin.target: 當我還是一名衛兵時，我曾被派往洛利克鎮。我一到這裡，洛利克和喬安內就開始吵架，然後他們讓我回白漫城去。我一直不知道到底發生了什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: As far as I know, this is one of the only ebony mines in Skyrim. I'm surprised by how few people there are here.
plugin.seed: 据我所知，这是天际中少有有的黑檀矿之一。我很惊讶这里的人这么少。
plugin.target: 據我所知，這是天霜中少有有的黑檀礦之一。我很驚訝這裡的人這麼少。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: For how small of a town Shor's Stone is, it doesn't seem like a bad place to live.
plugin.seed: 就朔尔之石的小镇而言，它似乎并不是一个糟糕的居住地。
plugin.target: 就朔爾之石的小鎮而言，它似乎並不是一個糟糕的居住地。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's been a long time since I saw the Gildergreen in full bloom. It's beautiful...
plugin.seed: 我已经很久没有看到盛开的镀绿树了。它美丽...
plugin.target: 我已經很久沒有看到盛開的鍍綠樹了。它美麗...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: In hindsight, I'm not surprised that Nettlebane was infused with dark magic. I'm glad we chose the more righteous path.
plugin.seed: 事后看来，我对刺草之祸被注入黑魔法并不感到惊讶。我很高兴我们选择了更正确的道路。
plugin.target: 事後看來，我對刺草之禍被注入黑魔法並不感到驚訝。我很高興我們選擇了更正確的道路。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm a bit upset about Nchuand-Zel - good men and women died for a few Dwarven trinkets.
plugin.seed: 我对楚安德-泽尔有点方案——好儿女们为了一些矮人的小玩具而死。
plugin.target: 我對楚安德-澤爾有點方案——好兒女們為了一些矮人的小玩具而死。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I usually don't mind helping strangers, but Nurelion was remarkably ungrateful...
plugin.seed: 我通常不介意帮助陌生人，但努瑞莱昂非常忘恩负义……
plugin.target: 我通常不介意幫助陌生人，但努瑞萊昂非常忘恩負義……
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: As much as I disliked Nurelion, it's good that he didn't bring his malcontent to the grave.
plugin.seed: 尽管我不喜欢努瑞莱昂，但愿他没有把他的不满带入坟墓。
plugin.target: 儘管我不喜歡努瑞萊昂，但願他沒有把他的不滿帶入墳墓。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: As righteous as the will of the Divines might be, it was sad to see Fjotra taken from her family. I hope she has a good life in the temple.
plugin.seed: 尽管众神的意志是正义的，但看到弗洛特拉从她的家人身边被带走还是令人难过。希望她在神殿里过得快乐。
plugin.target: 儘管眾神的意志是正義的，但看到弗洛特拉從她的家人身邊被帶走還是令人難過。希望她在神殿裡過得快樂。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I really enjoyed what we did for the priests of Mara. It was nice to see people in Skyrim who were happy, for once.
plugin.seed: 我真的很喜欢我们为玛拉祭司所做的一切。很高兴看到天际的人们很开心，至少这一次。
plugin.target: 我真的很喜歡我們為瑪拉祭司所做的一切。很高興看到天霜的人們很開心，至少這一次。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Froki was an interesting fellow - I didn't know there were any people in Skyrim who still preferred the old gods.
plugin.seed: 弗洛基是一个有趣的家伙——我不知道天际还有人仍然喜欢旧神。
plugin.target: 弗洛基是一個有趣的傢伙——我不知道天霜還有人仍然喜歡舊神。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If we're being honest, Thane, I didn't even know Hagravens could speak.
plugin.seed: 老实说，武卫，我什至不知道乌鸦鬼婆会说话。
plugin.target: 老實說，男爵，我什至不知道烏鴉鬼婆會說話。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's not that I don't feel bad about Madresi... but I can certainly tell she was just using us.
plugin.seed: 并不是说我不为玛德希感到难过……但我可以肯定地说她只是在利用我们。
plugin.target: 並不是說我不為瑪德希感到難過……但我可以肯定地說她只是在利用我們。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If you need an example of why I detest mages, look no further than Lu'ah Al-Skaven... tried to raise an army of the dead to terrorize Skyrim because it was being terrorized by the war.
plugin.seed: 如果你要我举例来说明我为什么讨厌法师，看看卢阿·艾尔-斯卡文就知道了……她试图召集一支死者军队来恐吓天际。
plugin.target: 如果你要我舉例來說明我為什麼討厭法師，看看盧阿·艾爾-斯卡文就知道了……她試圖召集一支死者軍隊來恐嚇天霜。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Illia was smart to turn away from the Hags, even if it meant she had to kill her own mother. It's... painful to see that, thought.
plugin.seed: 伊雅远离女巫们是明智的，即使这意味着她必须杀死自己的母亲。看到那个……很痛苦，我想。
plugin.target: 伊雅遠離女巫們是明智的，即使這意味著她必須殺死自己的母親。看到那個……很痛苦，我想。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Even though Valmir decieved us... I think encountering him was a good thing. One more Thalmor agent gone.
plugin.seed: 虽然瓦尔米尔欺骗了我们……但我觉得遇到他是件好事。又一名梭莫特工死了。
plugin.target: 雖然瓦爾米爾欺騙了我們……但我覺得遇到他是件好事。又一名梭莫特工死了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How old was the Pale Lady, anyway? What came first, her name, or the name of the hold?
plugin.seed: 无论如何，苍白女士多大了？究竟是她的名字久远，还是苍原领的名字长？
plugin.target: 無論如何，蒼白女士多大了？究竟是她的名字久遠，還是蒼原領的名字長？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I know it's unusual for me, but Valthume wasn't that bad of an experience. It was interesting to see a ghost ask for our help instead of attacking us.
plugin.seed: 我知道这对我来说很少见，但遇到瓦尔图梅并不是那么糟糕的经历。看到一个鬼魂请求我们的帮助而不是攻击我们这事是很有趣的。
plugin.target: 我知道這對我來說很少見，但遇到瓦爾圖梅並不是那麼糟糕的經歷。看到一個鬼魂請求我們的幫助而不是攻擊我們這事是很有趣的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It seems like treasures hunters always wind up turning on each other. I wasn't surprised by Beem-Ja and Salma being overtaken by greed.
plugin.seed: 似乎寻宝者最终总会自相残杀。我对毕姆-加和萨尔玛因贪婪做出的选择并不惊讶。
plugin.target: 似乎尋寶者最終總會自相殘殺。我對畢姆-加和薩爾瑪因貪婪做出的選擇並不驚訝。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You remember what the Necromancer in Hillgrund's tomb said? "Sovngarde is a myth." Shows what he knew.
plugin.seed: 你还记得潜山之墓中的死灵法师说的话吗？ “松加德是一个神话。”显然他知道些什么。
plugin.target: 你還記得潛山之墓中的死靈法師說的話嗎？ “松加德是一個神話。”顯然他知道些什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So do you think that amulet was worth all the trips around Skyrim? You certainly seem a lot stronger when you have it on.
plugin.seed: 那么你认为那个护符值得戴着在天际冒险吗？不过当你戴上它时，你的确看起来更强壮了。
plugin.target: 那麼你認為那個護符值得戴著在天霜冒險嗎？不過當你戴上它時，你的確看起來更強壯了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's nice what we were able to do for Anska... but I always thought all Nords were descended from Ysgramor.
plugin.seed: 很高兴我们能为安斯卡做些什么……但我一直认为所有诺德人都是伊斯格拉谟的后裔。
plugin.target: 很高興我們能為安斯卡做些什麼……但我一直認為所有諾德人都是伊斯格拉謨的後裔。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're still learning a lot about fighting and travelling, aren't you? Don't worry - I'll help you along the way.
plugin.seed: 你还在学习很多关于战斗和旅行的知识，不是吗？别担心 - 我会一值帮你的。
plugin.target: 你還在學習很多關於戰鬥和旅行的知識，不是嗎？別擔心 - 我會一值幫你的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You've gotten accustomed to Skyrim now, but I still think you need my help with a few things.
plugin.seed: 你现在已经习惯了天际，但我仍然认为你在一些事情上需要我的帮助。
plugin.target: 你現在已經習慣了天霜，但我仍然認為你在一些事情上需要我的幫助。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd say you're fairly competent at this point, but I'm sure I'll still be a great help to you.
plugin.seed: 我想说你在这一点上相当称职，但我相信我仍然会对你有所帮助。
plugin.target: 我想說你在這一點上相當稱職，但我相信我仍然會對你有所幫助。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You've come far since we met. It's hard to keep up.
plugin.seed: 自从我们相遇以来，你已经走得太远。追逐你的脚步真不是容易的事。
plugin.target: 自從我們相遇以來，你已經走得太遠。追逐你的腳步真不是容易的事。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Thane... You realize you're going to be a legend some day, right? Just seeing how much more skilled you are since we met gets you to that point.
plugin.seed: 武卫...你意识到你总有一天会成为传奇，对吧？自从我们相遇以来，看看你学会了这么多技能，这是迟早的事。
plugin.target: 男爵...你意識到你總有一天會成為傳奇，對吧？自從我們相遇以來，看看你學會了這麼多技能，這是遲早的事。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I didn't even know the Skaal could fight anything other than horkers, honestly.
plugin.seed: 老实说，我什至不知道斯卡尔可以与海象以外的其他东西作战。
plugin.target: 老實說，我什至不知道斯卡爾可以與海象以外的其他東西作戰。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So Neloth is a supremely interesting fellow, between the things he says and the fact that he's been around since before the Oblivion Crisis.
plugin.seed: 所以从他所说的话和他在湮灭危机之前就已经存在的事实来看，尼洛施是一个非常有趣的人。
plugin.target: 所以從他所說的話和他在湮滅危機之前就已經存在的事實來看，尼洛施是一個非常有趣的人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Aphia and Crescius just reminded me that by the time I get old, you'll still be young by Elven standards. That's... strange to consider.
plugin.seed: 亚妃雅和克雷修斯提醒了我，当我变老后，按照精灵的标准，你仍然很年轻。这……想起来就很奇怪。
plugin.target: 亞妃雅和克雷修斯提醒了我，當我變老後，按照精靈的標準，你仍然很年輕。這……想起來就很奇怪。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Can I just note how weird it is for an old Imperial to be married to an old Dunmer? The age difference must be... gods.
plugin.seed: 我能不能注意到一个老帝国人嫁给一个老丹莫是多么奇怪？他们的年龄差肯定是……天啊。
plugin.target: 我能不能注意到一個老帝國人嫁給一個老丹莫是多麼奇怪？他們的年齡差肯定是……天啊。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I wish the Empire had treated the Dark Elves better... it's a shame to see them resenting House Hlaalu so much, as the daughter of an Imperial.
plugin.seed: 我希望帝国能更好地对待暗精灵……作为帝国的女儿，看到他们如此憎恨拉鲁家族真是太可惜了。
plugin.target: 我希望帝國能更好地對待暗精靈……作為帝國的女兒，看到他們如此憎恨拉魯家族真是太可惜了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Most Imperial Generals have fought in hundreds of battles... it's a damn shame that Carius has had to wait over 200 years before he goes to Aetherius.
plugin.seed: 大多数帝国军团的将军都参加过数百场战斗……卡里乌斯在前往艾瑟瑞斯之前又不得不多等了 200 多年，真是太可悲了。
plugin.target: 大多數帝國軍團的將軍都參加過數百場戰鬥……卡里烏斯在前往艾瑟瑞斯之前又不得不多等了 200 多年，真是太可悲了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: When we find this Black Book... you'll have to read it, won't you? Please be careful, Thane.
plugin.seed: 当我们找到这本黑暗经书后...你必须得阅读它，对吗？请小心点，武卫。
plugin.target: 當我們找到這本黑暗經書後...你必須得閱讀它，對嗎？請小心點，男爵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Is it just me, or do the Dwarven ruins here look different from the ones back home?
plugin.seed: 是我的问题，还是这里的矮人遗迹和家乡的不太一样？
plugin.target: 是我的問題，還是這裡的矮人遺蹟和家鄉的不太一樣？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So Neloth is a supremely interesting fellow, between the things he says and the fact that he's been around since before the Oblivion Crisis.
plugin.seed: 所以从他所说的话和他在湮灭危机之前就已经存在的事实来看，尼洛施是一个非常有趣的人。
plugin.target: 所以從他所說的話和他在湮滅危機之前就已經存在的事實來看，尼洛施是一個非常有趣的人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I knew it was only a matter of time before Whiterun had to pick a side. It's right on the border, though, so... I even don't want to think about it.
plugin.seed: 我知道白漫城倒向一方只是时间问题。不过，现在已经到了抉择的时候了，所以……我甚至不想去想它。
plugin.target: 我知道白漫城倒向一方只是時間問題。不過，現在已經到了抉擇的時候了，所以……我甚至不想去想它。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's good to see that Nords are still willing to fight for Skyrim's traditions.
plugin.seed: 很高兴看到诺德人仍然愿意为天际的传统而战。
plugin.target: 很高興看到諾德人仍然願意為天霜的傳統而戰。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: This right here is the Legion's greatest strength - they don't disregard other provinces' traditions.
plugin.seed: 这就是军团最大的力量——他们不会无视其他省份的传统。
plugin.target: 這就是軍團最大的力量——他們不會無視其他省份的傳統。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Joining the Stormcloaks? Good. My mother worshipped Talos devoutly, and she made me the woman I am today.
plugin.seed: 加入风暴斗篷？好的。我的母亲对塔洛斯很虔诚，是她造就了今天的我。
plugin.target: 加入風暴斗篷？好的。我的母親對塔洛斯很虔誠，是她造就了今天的我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Good on you for joining the Legion. My father was a Legionnaire, and I wouldn't be the woman I am today without him.
plugin.seed: 你能加入军团真是太好了。我父亲是一名退伍军人，如果没有他，我就不会是今天的我。
plugin.target: 你能加入軍團真是太好了。我父親是一名退伍軍人，如果沒有他，我就不會是今天的我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Thane, please - whatever you do, you have to cure yourself and Kodlak. Nothing good comes out of selling your soul to a Daedra.
plugin.seed: 武卫，拜托——无论你做什么，你都必须治好你自己和克拉科。将你的灵魂出卖给魔族没有任何好处。
plugin.target: 男爵，拜託——無論你做什麼，你都必須治好你自己和克拉科。將你的靈魂出賣給魔族沒有任何好處。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm sorry about Kodlak. He was a good man, and deserved better.
plugin.seed: 我为克拉科感到抱歉。他是个好人，他值得更好的结局。
plugin.target: 我為克拉科感到抱歉。他是個好人，他值得更好的結局。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: By the gods... this is what my mother must have been warning me about. And it must be why she left the Companions in the first place.
plugin.seed: 天哪……这一定是我妈妈警告过我的。这一定是她最初离开战友团的原因。
plugin.target: 天哪……這一定是我媽媽警告過我的。這一定是她最初離開戰友團的原因。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: He's not the sharpest blade in the armory, but he can fight, I'll give him that.
plugin.seed: 他并不是最锋利的刀锋，但他可以战斗，我会协助他的。
plugin.target: 他並不是最鋒利的刀鋒，但他可以戰鬥，我會協助他的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Aela is a good shot... she could do with a bit more modesty in more than one area, though.
plugin.seed: 艾拉是个好手……不过，她应该表现得更谦虚一点。
plugin.target: 艾拉是個好手……不過，她應該表現得更謙虛一點。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Joining the Companions? Not a terrible idea, but my mother did warn me about them.
plugin.seed: 加入战友团？应该不是一个糟糕的主意，但我妈妈的确警告过我。
plugin.target: 加入戰友團？應該不是一個糟糕的主意，但我媽媽的確警告過我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's one more Thalmor madman dead. Not bad.
plugin.seed: 又一个梭默疯子死了。不错。
plugin.target: 又一個梭默瘋子死了。不錯。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I was kind of expecting this place to be an actual Labyrinth...
plugin.seed: 我有点期待这个地方是一个真正的迷城......
plugin.target: 我有點期待這個地方是一個真正的迷城......
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've heard of the Synod before. My father said they're the only guild of mages on Tamriel with a complete ban on Necromancy. That makes them easier to trust
plugin.seed: 我以前听说过希诺会。我父亲说他们是泰姆瑞尔大陆上唯一完全禁止死灵法术的法师公会。对我来说，这意味着我们可以信任他们。
plugin.target: 我以前聽說過希諾會。我父親說他們是泰姆瑞爾大陸上唯一完全禁止死靈法術的法師公會。對我來說，這意味著我們可以信任他們。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That crazy Thalmor sonofabitch is gonna get us all killed!
plugin.seed: 那个疯狂的梭默傻逼会害死我们的！
plugin.target: 那個瘋狂的梭默傻逼會害死我們的！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: This is getting to be too much for me. Elven monks who can freeze the world around them? I'll stick to slashing through draugr, thank you very much.
plugin.seed: 这对我来说太不可思议了。能冻结周围世界的精灵僧侣？我会坚持砍掉尸鬼，非常感谢。
plugin.target: 這對我來說太不可思議了。能凍結周圍世界的精靈僧侶？我會堅持砍掉屍鬼，非常感謝。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They say that wizards are supposed to be wise. Othorn seems like the biggest fool I've ever met.
plugin.seed: 他们说法师应该是很聪明的。 但奥瑟恩似乎是我见过的最大的傻瓜。
plugin.target: 他們說法師應該是很聰明的。 但奧瑟恩似乎是我見過的最大的傻瓜。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Tolfdir seems like an agreeable fellow, especially for a wizard.
plugin.seed: 托夫迪尔似乎是个和蔼的人，尤其是对法师而言。
plugin.target: 托夫迪爾似乎是個和藹的人，尤其是對法師而言。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Interesting place. I hardly see any Nords here, even in their own province.
plugin.seed: 真是有趣的地方。我在这里几乎看不到任何诺德人，即使这是在他们自己的省份。
plugin.target: 真是有趣的地方。我在這裡幾乎看不到任何諾德人，即使這是在他們自己的省份。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: This is amazing! I've never seen Akaviri architecture before.
plugin.seed: 这真太了不起了！我以前从未见过阿卡维尔建筑。
plugin.target: 這真太了不起了！我以前從未見過阿卡維爾建築。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well, if the Thalmor are also looking down here, we know we're on the right track.
plugin.seed: 好吧，如果梭默也看中了这里，我们就知道我们做的事情是对的。
plugin.target: 好吧，如果梭默也看中了這裡，我們就知道我們做的事情是對的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So we can trust Brynjolf because he's a friend of Delphine? Shor's Bones, I don't even trust Delphine!
plugin.seed: 所以我们可以信任布林乔夫，因为他是戴尔芬的朋友？ 朔尔之骨啊，我甚至都不相信戴尔芬！
plugin.target: 所以我們可以信任布林喬夫，因為他是戴爾芬的朋友？ 朔爾之骨啊，我甚至都不相信戴爾芬！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Where to first? Giving the Greybeards back the horn, or back to Riverwood?
plugin.seed: 先去哪里？把号角还给灰胡子，还是回河木镇？
plugin.target: 先去哪裡？把號角還給灰鬍子，還是回河木鎮？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm not sure what to think of this Delphine character... She thinks she would have been able to kill us both if she "didn't like the look of us."
plugin.seed: 我不确定如何看待这个戴尔芬……她认为如果她“不喜欢我们的样子”，她就能杀了我们两个。
plugin.target: 我不確定如何看待這個戴爾芬……她認為如果她“不喜歡我們的樣子”，她就能殺了我們兩個。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Maybe we should take care of the fiasco with the burned down house while we're here.
plugin.seed: 也许我们应该在我们在这里的时候看看被烧毁的房子的废墟。
plugin.target: 也許我們應該在我們在這裡的時候看看被燒燬的房子的廢墟。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Good thinking, this will be the fastest route to High Hrothgar.
plugin.seed: 不错的想法，这将是前往高吼峰的最快路线。
plugin.target: 不錯的想法，這將是前往高吼峰的最快路線。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Taking the scenic route to High Hrothgar? Fair enough.
plugin.seed: 沿着美景一路前往高吼峰？很不错。
plugin.target: 沿著美景一路前往高吼峰？很不錯。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Come on - we need to get that scroll back to the Throat of the World. If anyone can fight Alduin, it's you.
plugin.seed: 来吧——我们需要把那个卷轴带回世界之喉。如果有人能与奥杜因一战，那一定就是你。
plugin.target: 來吧——我們需要把那個卷軸帶回世界之喉。如果有人能與奧杜因一戰，那一定就是你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: This place seems to go on forever. You sure we can trust that Septimus fellow? He was as mad as a drunken Argonian mystic.
plugin.seed: 这个地方似乎永远持续下去。你确定我们可以信塞普汀默斯·希格诺斯那家伙？他像醉酒的亚龙人神秘主义者一样疯狂。
plugin.target: 這個地方似乎永遠持續下去。你確定我們可以信塞普汀默斯·希格諾斯那傢伙？他像醉酒的亞龍人神秘主義者一樣瘋狂。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So this is Raven Rock, eh? I can see why the High King gave it up to the Dark Elves so easily.
plugin.seed: 所以这是鸦石镇，嗯？我明白为什么至高王如此轻易地把它交给了暗精灵。
plugin.target: 所以這是鴉石鎮，嗯？我明白為什麼至高王如此輕易地把它交給了暗精靈。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Gods, that might just be the most impressive fortress I've ever seen.
plugin.seed: 天哪，那可能是我见过的最令人印象深刻的堡垒。
plugin.target: 天哪，那可能是我見過的最令人印象深刻的堡壘。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've only heard a little bit about the Moth Priests. Never thought we'd be looking for one in northern Skyrim.
plugin.seed: 我只听说过一点关于先祖蛾祭司的事。从没想过我们会在天际北部找到一个。
plugin.target: 我只聽說過一點關於先祖蛾祭司的事。從沒想過我們會在天霜北部找到一個。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: King Olaf's story is a classic tale, especially back home in Whiterun. I never thought he'd have a restless tomb, though.
plugin.seed: 奥拉夫国王的故事很是经典，尤其是在他的故乡白漫。不过，我从没想过他会有一座如此不安分的坟墓。
plugin.target: 奧拉夫國王的故事很是經典，尤其是在他的故鄉白漫。不過，我從沒想過他會有一座如此不安分的墳墓。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We always regarded King Olaf as a hero back home... this whole festival is kind of unnerving.
plugin.seed: 我们一直将奥拉夫国王视为家乡的英雄……整个节日都让人不安。
plugin.target: 我們一直將奧拉夫國王視為家鄉的英雄……整個節日都讓人不安。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You know, if you didn't like squeezing into the same bedroll and having me hold onto you as tightly as I can, maybe you wouldn't bring me up here so much.
plugin.seed: 你知道，如果你不喜欢挤在同一个铺盖卷里，让我尽可能紧紧地抓住你，那么也许你不会把我带到这里来。
plugin.target: 你知道，如果你不喜歡擠在同一個鋪蓋卷裡，讓我儘可能緊緊地抓住你，那麼也許你不會把我帶到這裡來。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I make you feel safe. *I* make *you* feel safe. You can't imagine how excited I was to hear you say that.
plugin.seed: 我让你感到安全。*我*让你感到安全。你无法想象听到你这么说我有多激动。
plugin.target: 我讓你感到安全。*我*讓你感到安全。你無法想像聽到你這麼說我有多激動。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: For what it's worth, Thane, I feel really bad that I blamed you for the people we lost at the Western Watchtower.
plugin.seed: 不管怎么说，大人，我真的抱歉，我把我们在西部哨塔失去的人归咎于你。
plugin.target: 不管怎麼說，大人，我真的抱歉，我把我們在西部哨塔失去的人歸咎於你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Travelling with you is making me realize how much Jorving didn't tell me. Not to his discredit, of course.
plugin.seed: 和你一起旅行让我意识到乔文有多少事情没有告诉我。当然，这不会让他丢脸。
plugin.target: 和你一起旅行讓我意識到喬文有多少事情沒有告訴我。當然，這不會讓他丟臉。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Sometimes I wish I hadn't cut myself off from everyone else in Whiterun so much. Hroki was willing to teach me a lot.
plugin.seed: 有时我真希望自己没有和白漫的其他人如此隔绝。赫罗基愿意教我很多。
plugin.target: 有時我真希望自己沒有和白漫的其他人如此隔絕。赫羅基願意教我很多。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can't believe Asvald grew up on the streets in this weather.
plugin.seed: 我不敢相信阿斯瓦德在这样天气的街道里长大。
plugin.target: 我不敢相信阿斯瓦德在這樣天氣的街道里長大。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Truthfully, I don't drink very much. Last time I did, it was with Thor and some of the other guards.
plugin.seed: 实话实说，我喝的不是很多。上次我喝酒的时候，是和托尔和其他几个卫兵一起的。
plugin.target: 實話實說，我喝的不是很多。上次我喝酒的時候，是和托爾和其他幾個衛兵一起的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I hope Faldir's family is doing okay.
plugin.seed: 我希望法迪尔的家人一切都好。
plugin.target: 我希望法迪爾的家人一切都好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I want to thank you for being so... patient with me, darling. I had really gotten in the habit of pushing everyone away.
plugin.seed: 我想感谢你对我如此...耐心，亲爱的。我真的养成了把所有人都推开的习惯。
plugin.target: 我想感謝你對我如此...耐心，親愛的。我真的養成了把所有人都推開的習慣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Would you like to be the Steward for my homestead?
plugin.seed: 你愿意做我家的管家吗？
plugin.target: 你願意做我家的管家嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: With respect, Thane, I think that managing your household would detract from my focus on protecting it - and protecting you.
plugin.seed: 恕我直言，武卫，我认为管理你的家庭会让我很难再完成关于保护你和你的家人的职责。
plugin.target: 恕我直言，男爵，我認為管理你的家庭會讓我很難再完成關於保護你和你的家人的職責。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: "Lydia, I love you, let's get married and travel all over the province together. Alright, just stick around my house now, thanks."
plugin.seed: “莱迪亚，我爱你，让我们结婚，一起环游全省。好吧，现在就呆在我家里，谢谢。”
plugin.target: “萊迪亞，我愛你，讓我們結婚，一起環遊全省。好吧，現在就呆在我家裡，謝謝。”
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Can't you find someone else to do that? It defeats the point of us having gotten married and me having taken an oath to protect you.
plugin.seed: 你就不能找其他人来做吗？这违背了我们结婚时我发誓要保护你的初衷。
plugin.target: 你就不能找其他人來做嗎？這違背了我們結婚時我發誓要保護你的初衷。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Oh, don't give me that look. You know I'm only saying that because I want to spend as much time with you as I can, love.
plugin.seed: 哦，别那样看我。亲爱的，你知道我这么说只是因为我想尽可能多地和你在一起。
plugin.target: 哦，別那樣看我。親愛的，你知道我這麼說只是因為我想盡可能多地和你在一起。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Can you help adjust my armor plates?
plugin.seed: 你能帮我整理下装甲板吗？
plugin.target: 你能幫我整理下裝甲板嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They look fine. Jump up and down for me... Yeah, it doesn't look like there's anything I can fix for you.
plugin.seed: 他们看起来没什么问题。你随便跳下试试……是啊，看来我没有什么可以帮你解决的。
plugin.target: 他們看起來沒什麼問題。你隨便跳下試試……是啊，看來我沒有什麼可以幫你解決的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Everything is exactly where it should be, by the looks of it.
plugin.seed: 看起来，一切都没问题。
plugin.target: 看起來，一切都沒問題。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Sure thing. Just hold still, I'll get them fixed up for you.
plugin.seed: 当然可以。别动，我会帮你把它们弄好。
plugin.target: 當然可以。別動，我會幫你把它們弄好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You definitely need it... gods, you're going to get yourself hurt like that. Come over here.
plugin.seed: 你绝对需要……天啊，那样你会受伤的。过来。
plugin.target: 你絕對需要……天啊，那樣你會受傷的。過來。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You feel the two bones at the base of your neck? The top of your breastplate should be directly over them. Here, let me show you.
plugin.seed: 你感觉到脖子底部的两根骨头了吗？胸甲的顶部应该直接在它们上面护着。来这儿，我来帮你弄。
plugin.target: 你感覺到脖子底部的兩根骨頭了嗎？胸甲的頂部應該直接在它們上面護著。來這兒，我來幫你弄。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Don't tell me you actually tried to put your breasts in those inserts... they're just for decoration.
plugin.seed: 别告诉我你真的想把你的胸放在那些衬垫中……那只是装饰。
plugin.target: 別告訴我你真的想把你的胸放在那些襯墊中……那只是裝飾。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You know, sometimes I think you do this just because you like me putting my hands all over you. "Oh, let me mess up my plates so Lydia has to come adjust them and grab my thigh."
plugin.seed: 你知道吗，有时我认为你这样做只是因为你喜欢我把手放在你身上。 “哦，我先把装甲板弄乱，莱迪亚帮我调整时就可以摸到我的腿。”
plugin.target: 你知道嗎，有時我認為你這樣做只是因為你喜歡我把手放在你身上。 “哦，我先把裝甲板弄亂，萊迪亞幫我調整時就可以摸到我的腿。”
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You know, sometimes I think you do this just because you like me putting my hands all over you. "Oh, let me mess up my plates so Lydia has to come adjust them and grab my thigh."
plugin.seed: 你知道吗，有时我认为你这样做只是因为你喜欢我把手放在你身上。 “哦，我先把装甲板弄乱，莱迪亚帮我调整时就可以摸到我的腿。”
plugin.target: 你知道嗎，有時我認為你這樣做只是因為你喜歡我把手放在你身上。 “哦，我先把裝甲板弄亂，萊迪亞幫我調整時就可以摸到我的腿。”
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't see anyth-Oh, I get it. If you want to get intimate, can you not be weird about it? I'm happy to help get that armor off you, though.
plugin.seed: 我什么都没看出-哦，我明白了。想要和亲热一下，能别这样表达吗？不过，我很乐意帮助你脱掉盔甲。
plugin.target: 我什麼都沒看出-哦，我明白了。想要和親熱一下，能別這樣表達嗎？不過，我很樂意幫助你脫掉盔甲。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd like to turn you into a vampire.
plugin.seed: 我想把你变成吸血鬼。
plugin.target: 我想把你變成吸血鬼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm... not even going to address what you just asked me. Seriously, I thought you knew me better than that.
plugin.seed: 我... 甚至都不打算回答你刚才问我的问题。说真的，我以为你很了解我。
plugin.target: 我... 甚至都不打算回答你剛才問我的問題。說真的，我以為你很瞭解我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And I'd like you stop making bats appear out of thin air - they're full of disease, and they shit all over the house. But we can't all get what we want.
plugin.seed: 并且我希望你不要让蝙蝠凭空出现——它们到处传播疾病，还会在屋子里到处拉屎。但我们可能无法得到自己想要的。
plugin.target: 並且我希望你不要讓蝙蝠憑空出現——它們到處傳播疾病，還會在屋子裡到處拉屎。但我們可能無法得到自己想要的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Are you alright, Thane? We've dealt with assassins before, but... that one seemed more capable than usual.
plugin.seed: 你还好吗，大人？我们以前对付过刺客，但是...那个人似乎比平时更有能力。
plugin.target: 你還好嗎，大人？我們以前對付過刺客，但是...那個人似乎比平時更有能力。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Hold on a moment - Kolgar mentioned at least one thing that can't possibly be a concidence.
plugin.seed: 等一下 - 科尔加至少提到了一件不确定的事情。
plugin.target: 等一下 - 科爾加至少提到了一件不確定的事情。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I hope you don't mind us stopping for a moment, Thane.
plugin.seed: 我希望你不介意我们停一下，武卫。
plugin.target: 我希望你不介意我們停一下，男爵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's... hard to see all this again. *Sigh*. Coming back here was a mistake.
plugin.seed: 以后...就很难看到这儿了。 *叹*。回到这里就是个错误。
plugin.target: 以後...就很難看到這兒了。 *嘆*。回到這裡就是個錯誤。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Wow... this is a lot more than what I was expecting. It's almost like the fort takes up the whole canyon.
plugin.seed: 哇...这比我预期的要多得多。这几乎就像堡垒占据了整个峡谷。
plugin.target: 哇...這比我預期的要多得多。這幾乎就像堡壘佔據了整個峽谷。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Gods above, is that... that's my mother's axe!
plugin.seed: 天哪，那不是……那是我妈妈的斧头！
plugin.target: 天哪，那不是……那是我媽媽的斧頭！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Looks like I owe you an apology once again, Thane.
plugin.seed: 看来我又要向你道歉了，武卫。
plugin.target: 看來我又要向你道歉了，男爵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: There something you want from me, or is bothering strangers a passtime of yours?
plugin.seed: 有什么事吗，或者你只是在消遣我？
plugin.target: 有什麼事嗎，或者你只是在消遣我？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You might have gotten this far, but we've got reinforcements on the outside of this building. You've boxed yourselves in.
plugin.seed: 即使你能走到这里来，但一切也都结束了，我们在外面还有增援不断抵达，你被包围了。
plugin.target: 即使你能走到這裡來，但一切也都結束了，我們在外面還有增援不斷抵達，你被包圍了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You made it far. Killing you might bring a bit of my honor back.
plugin.seed: 你走远了。也许杀了你能让我恢复部分荣誉。
plugin.target: 你走遠了。也許殺了你能讓我恢復部分榮譽。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Jarl's men have found that what you said about Vonjar was true. Please, forgive us for this severe inconvenience.
plugin.seed: 领主的人已经发现你所说的关于冯贾尔的话是真的。请原谅这给我们带来的严重不便。
plugin.target: 領主的人已經發現你所說的關於馮賈爾的話是真的。請原諒這給我們帶來的嚴重不便。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Is there still something you want from us?
plugin.seed: 你还想从我们这得到什么吗？
plugin.target: 你還想從我們這得到什麼嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I thought you were going to Coldspire Canyon?
plugin.seed: 我以为你要去冷塔峡谷？
plugin.target: 我以為你要去冷塔峽谷？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So... you've handled your business with Vonjar?
plugin.seed: 那么...您已经处理过冯贾尔的事情了？
plugin.target: 那麼...您已經處理過馮賈爾的事情了？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Thanks for not involving Eorald and I in that. You need anything from us, just ask.
plugin.seed: 感谢您没有让埃拉尔德和我卷入其中。您需要我们的任何帮助，尽管开口。
plugin.target: 感謝您沒有讓埃拉爾德和我捲入其中。您需要我們的任何幫助，儘管開口。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm fine, Lydia. Relax, it's hardly the first time someone's tried to kill me.
plugin.seed: 我很好，莱迪亚。放轻松，这不是第一次有人想杀我。
plugin.target: 我很好，萊迪亞。放輕鬆，這不是第一次有人想殺我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: In case you're forgetting, your safety is my responsibility.
plugin.seed: 以防你忘了：守卫你的安全是我的责任。
plugin.target: 以防你忘了：守衛你的安全是我的責任。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That assassin was more skilled than most of the people we fight, and he was carrying a note that might have a lead.
plugin.seed: 那个刺客比我们战斗的大多数人都更熟练，他带着一张可能有线索的纸条。
plugin.target: 那個刺客比我們戰鬥的大多數人都更熟練，他帶著一張可能有線索的紙條。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm "advising" you to follow that lead. For your safety and my sanity.
plugin.seed: 我“建议”你顺着这条线索继续。为了你的安全和我的理智。
plugin.target: 我“建議”你順著這條線索繼續。為了你的安全和我的理智。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...What if I don't want to bother with a wild goose chase?
plugin.seed: ...如果我不想白费心思呢？
plugin.target: ...如果我不想白費心思呢？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I could think of a few ways to persuade you.
plugin.seed: 我可以想出好几种方法来说服你。
plugin.target: 我可以想出好幾種方法來說服你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm "advising" you to.
plugin.seed: 我“建议”你这样做。
plugin.target: 我“建議”你這樣做。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: His note mentioned someone named Kolgar, in Rorikstead.
plugin.seed: 他的笔记提到了洛利克镇的一个名叫科尔加的人。
plugin.target: 他的筆記提到了洛利克鎮的一個名叫科爾加的人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well, I guess we're off to Rorikstead, then. Right?
plugin.seed: 好吧，那我想我们要去洛利克镇了。对吗？
plugin.target: 好吧，那我想我們要去洛利克鎮了。對嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I appreciate your concern, but there are things we need to do first.
plugin.seed: 感谢你的关心，但有些事情需要我们先做。
plugin.target: 感謝你的關心，但有些事情需要我們先做。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Just get to Rorikstead at some point. Please.
plugin.seed: 只要记得在某个时候去一下洛利克镇。走吧。
plugin.target: 只要記得在某個時候去一下洛利克鎮。走吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Anything for you.
plugin.seed: 都听你的。
plugin.target: 都聽你的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Didn't expect to hear you of all people say something like that.
plugin.seed: 没想到这是你会说出的话。
plugin.target: 沒想到這是你會說出的話。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Always the sweetheart.
plugin.seed: 你真一直都是我的甜心。
plugin.target: 你真一直都是我的甜心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Since when do housecarls give orders to thanes?
plugin.seed: 侍卫什么时候能给武卫发号施令了？
plugin.target: 侍衛什麼時候能給男爵發號施令了？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What, are you saying you don't see me as a friend after all we've been through?
plugin.seed: 什么，你是说在我们经历了那么多之后你都不把我当朋友了吗？
plugin.target: 什麼，你是說在我們經歷了那麼多之後你都不把我當朋友了嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Might I remind you that I'm your wife? For Shor's sake...
plugin.seed: 我可以提醒你一下，我是你的妻子吗？我的朔尔啊...
plugin.target: 我可以提醒你一下，我是你的妻子嗎？我的朔爾啊...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're right. I'm probably in serious danger right now.
plugin.seed: 你说得对。我现在可能处境很危险。
plugin.target: 你說得對。我現在可能處境很危險。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Glad you can see that.
plugin.seed: 很高兴你能看到这点。
plugin.target: 很高興你能看到這點。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Can you explain this? (Show note)
plugin.seed: 你能解释一下吗？ （显示笔记）
plugin.target: 你能解釋一下嗎？ （顯示筆記）
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Leave me alone. If there's a plot to kill you, I don't have any part in it. For all I know, you could have forged that.
plugin.seed: 别怀疑到我身上，我可没密谋杀你。而且这些都是可以伪造的。
plugin.target: 別懷疑到我身上，我可沒密謀殺你。而且這些都是可以偽造的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Why so hostile...?
plugin.seed: 怎么这么冲……？
plugin.target: 怎麼這麼衝……？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Because I'd like to be left alone. It's that simple.
plugin.seed: 因为我想一个人呆着。就这么简单。
plugin.target: 因為我想一個人待著。就這麼簡單。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If my life is at risk, I'm not just going to leave you be.
plugin.seed: 有人想要我的名，我是不会就这样离开的。
plugin.target: 有人想要我的名，我是不會就這樣離開的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well, I'm not going to put my life at risk helping you. You're just a stranger to me.
plugin.seed: 也行，反正我是不会冒着生命危险来帮助你的。你对我来说只是个陌生人。
plugin.target: 也行，反正我是不會冒著生命危險來幫助你的。你對我來說只是個陌生人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (Combat Skills) You're putting yourself in danger by not helping me, as well.
plugin.seed: （战斗技能）如果你不愿帮助我，那你现在可就危险了。
plugin.target: （戰鬥技能）如果你不願幫助我，那你現在可就危險了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Alright, alright, settle down...
plugin.seed: 好吧，好吧，冷静……
plugin.target: 好吧，好吧，冷靜……
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (Illusion) You will tell me who sent that assassin after me.
plugin.seed: （幻术系）告诉我是谁要杀我。
plugin.target: （幻術系）告訴我是誰要殺我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I will tell you who sent that assassin after you.
plugin.seed: 我会告诉你幕后黑手是谁的。
plugin.target: 我會告訴你幕後黑手是誰的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (Persuade) Don't worry about the reprocussions. I'll take care of them.
plugin.seed: （说服）不要担心。我会解决他们的。
plugin.target: （說服）不要擔心。我會解決他們的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Alright. I figure you could help if things go awry...
plugin.seed: 好吧。我想如果事情出了差错你可以帮忙...
plugin.target: 好吧。我想如果事情出了差錯你可以幫忙...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (200 Gold) Perhaps this will get you to talk?
plugin.seed: （200 金币） 也许这会让你透露点风声？
plugin.target: （200 金幣） 也許這會讓你透露點風聲？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It certainly will.
plugin.seed: 当然可以。
plugin.target: 當然可以。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Look, I just want to know who sent you to meet with that assassin.
plugin.seed: 你看，我只想知道是谁派你去见那个刺客的。
plugin.target: 你看，我只想知道是誰派你去見那個刺客的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Like I said, I'm not betraying my associates.
plugin.seed: 就像我说的，我不会背叛我的同僚。
plugin.target: 就像我說的，我不會背叛我的同僚。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm not going to ask as nicely as my friend here just did. Who sent you to pay that assassin?
plugin.seed: 我可不会像我的朋友一样温和，我只问一遍。谁派你来雇佣那个刺客的？
plugin.target: 我可不會像我的朋友一樣溫和，我只問一遍。誰派你來僱傭那個刺客的？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What makes you think you can intimidate me, lass?
plugin.seed: 是什么让你认为你可以恐吓我，姑娘？
plugin.target: 是什麼讓你認為你可以恐嚇我，姑娘？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Because my friend and I are part of the court of Whiterun. The guards won't intervene if we decide to bash in that soup-pot-metal armor of yours.
plugin.seed: 因为我和我的朋友是白漫城宫廷的成员。如果我们决定干掉你，守卫是不会管的。
plugin.target: 因為我和我的朋友是白漫城宮廷的成員。如果我們決定幹掉你，守衛是不會管的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And I'm Uriel Septim VII. Just leave me alone, for Ysmir's sake.
plugin.seed: 我还是尤瑞尔·塞普汀七世呢。看在伊斯米尔的份上，离我远点。
plugin.target: 我還是尤瑞爾·塞普汀七世呢。看在伊斯米爾的份上，離我遠點。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Sigh*. Since you're so unconcerned about dying, I'll put it this way: If you tell us who hired the assassin, you can keep the money you were supposed to pay him.
plugin.seed: *叹*。既然你这么不怕死，那我就这么说吧：如果你告诉我们是谁雇了刺客，你就可以把你本应交付的钱留着。
plugin.target: *嘆*。既然你這麼不怕死，那我就這麼說吧：如果你告訴我們是誰僱了刺客，你就可以把你本應交付的錢留著。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's... actually a good point. He was paying that assassin quite a bit, after all.
plugin.seed: 那……确实是一个好点子。毕竟，他付给那个刺客不少钱。
plugin.target: 那……確實是一個好點子。畢竟，他付給那個刺客不少錢。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've been working for a warrior named Vonjar Red-Tundra. He's trying to build an army of deserters from the Stormcloaks and Imperial Legion.
plugin.seed: 我一直在为一个名叫冯贾尔·红苔的战士工作。他四处招兵买马，跟随他的大多是风暴斗篷和帝国军团的逃兵。
plugin.target: 我一直在為一個名叫馮賈爾·紅苔的戰士工作。他四處招兵買馬，跟隨他的大多是風暴斗篷和帝國軍團的逃兵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't know much else about him. He's always covered from neck to toe in heavy armor, and carries an fancy-looking battleaxe. Says its an heirloom.
plugin.seed: 我对他了解不多。他总是从头到脚都穿着厚重的盔甲，手里拿着一把看起来很花哨的战斧。说这是传家宝。
plugin.target: 我對他了解不多。他總是從頭到腳都穿著厚重的盔甲，手裡拿著一把看起來很花哨的戰斧。說這是傳家寶。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I was supposed to meet him on some old farm in the eastern plains. Said he was certain it was abandoned, and he used it to move soldiers through the region.
plugin.seed: 我本该在东部平原的一个旧农场见他的。他说，他确信它被遗弃了，他用它来运送士兵穿过该地区。
plugin.target: 我本該在東部平原的一箇舊農場見他的。他說，他確信它被遺棄了，他用它來運送士兵穿過該地區。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Your cooperation is appreciated.
plugin.seed: 感谢你的合作。
plugin.target: 感謝你的合作。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Uh-huh.
plugin.seed: 嗯哼。
plugin.target: 嗯哼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Cooperating isn't so hard, now, is it?
plugin.seed: 合作并没那么难，不是吗？
plugin.target: 合作並沒那麼難，不是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Was that so hard?
plugin.seed: 有那么难吗？
plugin.target: 有那麼難嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Just leave me alone.
plugin.seed: 别管我。
plugin.target: 別管我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Coincidence? How so?
plugin.seed: 巧合？怎么巧合了？
plugin.target: 巧合？怎麼巧合了？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: First of all, the farm I grew up on was in eastern Whiterun. I haven't been back there in 10 years, now.
plugin.seed: 首先，我长大的农场在白漫东部。我已经10年没回过那里了。
plugin.target: 首先，我長大的農場在白漫東部。我已經10年沒回過那裡了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Second... I remember the name Red-Tundra.
plugin.seed: 其次...我记得红苔这个名字。
plugin.target: 其次...我記得紅苔這個名字。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They were the bandit clan that killed my mother. I thought they'd been taken care of, but apparently, I was mistaken.
plugin.seed: 他们是杀害我母亲的强盗家族。我以为他们已经得到了报应，但显然，我错了。
plugin.target: 他們是殺害我母親的強盜家族。我以為他們已經得到了報應，但顯然，我錯了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Remind me what happened to your parents.
plugin.seed: 给我说说你父母的遭遇。
plugin.target: 給我說說你父母的遭遇。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Okay, you should know this, I bring them up a lot. But if you need me to jog your memory...
plugin.seed: 好吧，你应该知道，我经常提起他们。但如果你需要我唤起你的记忆...
plugin.target: 好吧，你應該知道，我經常提起他們。但如果你需要我喚起你的記憶...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: When I was 10 years old, there was a bandit clan harassing my family's farmstead. They'd come by every few days and demand something from us.
plugin.seed: 当我10岁的时候，有一个强盗团伙骚扰我家的农场。他们每隔几天就会来，向我们索取一些东西。
plugin.target: 當我10歲的時候，有一個強盜團伙騷擾我家的農場。他們每隔幾天就會來，向我們索取一些東西。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My father was a soldier and my mother was a companion, so they always refused. Too much pride between the two of them - and no, that's not a detriment.
plugin.seed: 我父亲是一名士兵，母亲是一名战友团成员，所以他们总是拒绝。他们两个太过自傲了——不，这并不是坏事。
plugin.target: 我父親是一名士兵，母親是一名戰友團成員，所以他們總是拒絕。他們兩個太過自傲了——不，這並不是壞事。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: One day, the bandits got sick and tired of their resistance. A group of them attacked my father while he was telling them to piss off. He cut most of them down like wheat.
plugin.seed: 一天，强盗们厌倦了抵抗。当我父亲叫他们撒尿的时候，一群人袭击了我父亲。他像割小麦一样把他们大部分砍倒了。
plugin.target: 一天，強盜們厭倦了抵抗。當我父親叫他們撒尿的時候，一群人襲擊了我父親。他像割小麥一樣把他們大部分砍倒了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: One of them managed to sweep through his legs with a claymore from behind, and he buckled right over. My mother went running out to help him.
plugin.seed: 其中一个用双刃大刀从后面扫过了他的腿，他马上就倒下了。我妈妈跑出去帮助他。
plugin.target: 其中一個用雙刃大刀從後面掃過了他的腿，他馬上就倒下了。我媽媽跑出去幫助他。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: More bandits showed up, and they... they were too much for my ma to handle.
plugin.seed: 更多的强盗出现了，他们...他们人太多了，我母亲无法处理。
plugin.target: 更多的強盜出現了，他們...他們人太多了，我母親無法處理。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I took off running, trying to see if any of the Jarl's men were patrolling the area, while the bandits ransacked our house.
plugin.seed: 当强盗洗劫我们的房子时，我开始逃跑，试图看看是否有领主的人在该地区巡逻。
plugin.target: 當強盜洗劫我們的房子時，我開始逃跑，試圖看看是否有領主的人在該地區巡邏。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Wasn't much left when I got back.
plugin.seed: 我回来的时候已经所剩无几了。
plugin.target: 我回來的時候已經所剩無幾了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What happened to the farm?
plugin.seed: 农场后来怎么了？
plugin.target: 農場後來怎麼了？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: After my father died, I was the only one there. I thought about selling it, but I didn't know where to go for that. Wasn't even sure how much it was worth.
plugin.seed: 我父亲去世后，那里只有我一个人。我想过卖掉它，但我不知道该去哪里买。甚至不知道它值多少钱。
plugin.target: 我父親去世後，那裡只有我一個人。我想過賣掉它，但我不知道該去哪裡買。甚至不知道它值多少錢。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Plus, the Red-Tundra bandits were still salivating over it... and they probably intended to take me, too.
plugin.seed: 另外，红苔的强盗们依旧虎视眈眈……而且他们可能也打算带走我。
plugin.target: 另外，紅苔的強盜們依舊虎視眈眈……而且他們可能也打算帶走我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I took what I could carry, and went to the city to join the guard.
plugin.seed: 我带着我能带的东西，进城去参加警卫。
plugin.target: 我帶著我能帶的東西，進城去參加警衛。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What did you think happened to the Red-Tundra bandits?
plugin.seed: 你认为红苔强盗团发生了什么事？
plugin.target: 你認為紅苔強盜團發生了什麼事？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My father had been whittling them down in the plains for the six years before he died. While I was a guard, they attacked the city more than once.
plugin.seed: 我父亲在去世前的六年里一直在平原上讨伐它们。当我担任警卫时，他们不止一次袭击这座城市。
plugin.target: 我父親在去世前的六年裡一直在平原上討伐它們。當我擔任警衛時，他們不止一次襲擊這座城市。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: In fact, the first person I ever got into a real fight with was a Red-Tundra bandit. Made the experience much less revolting than it could have been.
plugin.seed: 事实上，我第一次交手的人就是一名红苔的强盗，这让我觉得更反感。
plugin.target: 事實上，我第一次交手的人就是一名紅苔的強盜，這讓我覺得更反感。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I guess there were more of them than I thought.
plugin.seed: 我猜他们比我想象的要多。
plugin.target: 我猜他們比我想像的要多。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I suppose we should head over there, then.
plugin.seed: 我想我们应该去那儿，然后。
plugin.target: 我想我們應該去那兒，然後。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: This'll be... interesting, to say the least.
plugin.seed: 这会……至少可以说会很有趣。
plugin.target: 這會……至少可以說會很有趣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Who are you two? Did Vonjar send you here as well?
plugin.seed: 你们两个是谁？ 也是冯贾尔派来的吗？
plugin.target: 你們兩個是誰？ 也是馮賈爾派來的嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I told you, we should have ditched the uniforms...
plugin.seed: 我早说过，我们应该放弃那些制服...
plugin.target: 我早說過，我們應該放棄那些制服...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd rather not be running around unprotected...
plugin.seed: 我宁愿不要在没有保护的情况下到处乱跑......
plugin.target: 我寧願不要在沒有保護的情況下到處亂跑......
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I grew up on this farm. It was ransacked by the Red-Tundras 16 years ago, and now Vonjar sent an assassin after my friend, here.
plugin.seed: 我就是在这个农场长大的。它在十六年前被红苔洗劫一空，而现在冯贾尔在这里派出刺客追杀我的朋友。
plugin.target: 我就是在這個農場長大的。它在十六年前被紅苔洗劫一空，而現在馮賈爾在這裡派出刺客追殺我的朋友。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Bandits? Red-Tundra's a mercenary, not a bandit.
plugin.seed: 强盗？红苔是一群佣兵，不是强盗。
plugin.target: 強盜？紅苔是一群傭兵，不是強盜。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't know anything about this Vonjar character, but I do know his family killed my mother. Just a few steps from where we're standing, out in the yard.
plugin.seed: 我对冯贾尔这个角色一无所知，但我知道他的家人杀了我的母亲。离我们站的地方只有几步之遥，就在院子里。
plugin.target: 我對馮賈爾這個角色一無所知，但我知道他的家人殺了我的母親。離我們站的地方只有幾步之遙，就在院子裡。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Is he here? His friend, Kolgar, said he'd be.
plugin.seed: 他在这里吗？他的朋友科尔加说他会的。
plugin.target: 他在這裡嗎？他的朋友科爾加說他會的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Nah. Red-Tundra's got a fortress out in the mountains. He stays there with the other deserters he's collected.
plugin.seed: 不。红苔在山上有一座堡垒。他和他手下的其他逃兵一起呆在那里。
plugin.target: 不。紅苔在山上有一座堡壘。他和他手下的其他逃兵一起呆在那裡。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You shouldn't be telling them all that, you oaf!
plugin.seed: 你不应该告诉他们这些，你这个笨蛋！
plugin.target: 你不應該告訴他們這些，你這個笨蛋！
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What's it matter? They already walked in on a Stormcloak and an Imperial sharing a house. And I'm starting to get skeptical of this Vonjar fellow.
plugin.seed: 有什么关系？帝国士兵都能和风暴斗篷们共处一室了。我也开始怀疑起这个叫冯贾尔的家伙了。
plugin.target: 有什麼關係？帝國士兵都能和風暴斗篷們共處一室了。我也開始懷疑起這個叫馮賈爾的傢伙了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We can't be certain he's a bandit based on her word alone...
plugin.seed: 我们不能仅凭她的一面之词就判定他是强盗……
plugin.target: 我們不能僅憑她的一面之詞就判定他是強盜……
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Sigh* Listen to me. I saw members of his family cripple my father and kill my mother right outside that door.
plugin.seed: *叹气*听我说。我看到他家的人在门外把我父亲打成残废，还杀了我母亲。
plugin.target: *嘆氣*聽我說。我看到他家的人在門外把我父親打成殘廢，還殺了我母親。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: He sent an assassin after my friend. We have a letter from "V" right here.
plugin.seed: 他派了一名刺客追捕我的朋友。我们这里有一封来自“V”的信。
plugin.target: 他派了一名刺客追捕我的朋友。我們這裡有一封來自“V”的信。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: There are a lot of V's in this world. Have you been to Morrowind?
plugin.seed: 这个世界上有很多“V”。你去过晨风吗？
plugin.target: 這個世界上有很多“V”。你去過晨風嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think she's telling the truth. Let it go, Eselda.
plugin.seed: 我认为她说的是实话。放手吧，埃塞尔达。
plugin.target: 我認為她說的是實話。放手吧，埃塞爾達。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Vonjar's fortress is in the Southern Dragontails, in a place called Coldspire Canyon.
plugin.seed: 冯贾尔的堡垒位于南龙尾，一个叫冷塔峡谷的地方。
plugin.target: 馮賈爾的堡壘位於南龍尾，一個叫冷塔峽谷的地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: From what I hear, he already has a decent number of men there. It won't be an easy fight.
plugin.seed: 据我所知，他在那里已经聚集了相当多的人马。这不是一场容易的战斗。
plugin.target: 據我所知，他在那裡已經聚集了相當多的人馬。這不是一場容易的戰鬥。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Sigh* You're right, Fenrar.
plugin.seed: *叹气你说得对，芬拉尔。
plugin.target: *嘆氣你說得對，芬拉爾。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm sorry about everything that's happened to you, kinsman. Do you need some time alone here?
plugin.seed: 我对发生在你身上的一切感到抱歉，同胞。你需要一个人呆在这里吗？
plugin.target: 我對發生在你身上的一切感到抱歉，同胞。你需要一個人呆在這裡嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd appreciate that.
plugin.seed: 我很感激你们。
plugin.target: 我很感激你們。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Of course, Lydia. Take all the time you need.
plugin.seed: 当然。莱迪亚，想多久就多久。
plugin.target: 當然。萊迪亞，想多久就多久。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I appreciate that.
plugin.seed: 非常感谢。
plugin.target: 非常感謝。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: It isn't easy to look at all this again... but I'm glad you're hear with me, dear.
plugin.seed: 回忆过去的灾难并不容易...但我很高兴你还能给我讲述，亲爱的。
plugin.target: 回憶過去的災難並不容易...但我很高興你還能給我講述，親愛的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think it would be best if we got underway.
plugin.seed: 我觉得我们是时候出发了。
plugin.target: 我覺得我們是時候出發了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Maybe you're right. Maybe this is just a wound that doesn't need to be opened.
plugin.seed: 也许你是对的。也许这只是一个不需要打开的伤口。
plugin.target: 也許你是對的。也許這只是一個不需要打開的傷口。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Let's get going. We'll need to be ready for whatever's waiting out west.
plugin.seed: 我们开始吧。我们需要为在西部等着我们的一切做好准备。
plugin.target: 我們開始吧。我們需要為在西部等著我們的一切做好準備。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My parents were always happy with a boring life. They'd seen enough action during the war.
plugin.seed: 我的父母总是对无聊的生活感到自足。他们在战争期间目睹了太多事情。
plugin.target: 我的父母總是對無聊的生活感到自足。他們在戰爭期間目睹了太多事情。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They still practiced, every now and then. I guess that's why I never heard them argue. Sparring took away all their energy.
plugin.seed: 他们仍然不时地练习。我想这就是为什么我从来没有听过他们争论。争吵会夺走他们所有的精力。
plugin.target: 他們仍然不時地練習。我想這就是為什麼我從來沒有聽過他們爭論。爭吵會奪走他們所有的精力。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd swing a wooden sword around down here from time to time - always wanted to be like them. I didn't really start training until my mother died.
plugin.seed: 我时不时会在这里拿着木剑练习————我一直想成为他们那样的人。但直到我母亲去世，我才真正开始训练。
plugin.target: 我時不時會在這裡拿著木劍練習————我一直想成為他們那樣的人。但直到我母親去世，我才真正開始訓練。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's... it's still here. My father taught me so much of what I knew with this thing.
plugin.seed: 过……过去的阴影依旧没有消失。我父亲告诉了我很多，让我知道了更多的事。
plugin.target: 過……過去的陰影依舊沒有消失。我父親告訴了我很多，讓我知道了更多的事。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I cried my eyes out here when I found out my mother died... realizing your parents aren't immortal hurts.
plugin.seed: 当我发现我母亲去世时，我哭了...意识到你的父母不是不朽的，很悲痛。
plugin.target: 當我發現我母親去世時，我哭了...意識到你的父母不是不朽的，很悲痛。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I was more prepared when I lost my father... and I just got angry. He'd been through so much, only to be taken by fever.
plugin.seed: 当我失去父亲时，我更有准备...我只是很愤怒。他经历了这么多，结果却死于流感。
plugin.target: 當我失去父親時，我更有準備...我只是很憤怒。他經歷了這麼多，結果卻死於流感。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That stag was my father's proudest kill. And the wolf was my first.
plugin.seed: 那只雄鹿是我父亲最骄傲的猎物。那只狼是我的第一只。
plugin.target: 那隻雄鹿是我父親最驕傲的獵物。那隻狼是我的第一隻。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: A 30-pound bow when I was 12 years old, at about 35 yards. I wish my mother could've been there to see.
plugin.seed: 当我12岁的时候，用的一把30磅重的弓，大约35码远。我真希望我妈妈能在那里看到我。
plugin.target: 當我12歲的時候，用的一把30磅重的弓，大約35碼遠。我真希望我媽媽能在那裡看到我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My parents were always happy with a boring life. They'd seen enough action in the war.
plugin.seed: 我的父母总是对无聊的生活感到自足。他们在战争中目睹了太多事情。
plugin.target: 我的父母總是對無聊的生活感到自足。他們在戰爭中目睹了太多事情。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They still practiced from time to time, though. I guess that's why I never heard them argue. They took out all their energy sparring.
plugin.seed: 尽管如此，他们还是不时地训练。我想这就是为什么我从来没有听过他们争论。他们用尽全力训练。
plugin.target: 儘管如此，他們還是不時地訓練。我想這就是為什麼我從來沒有聽過他們爭論。他們用盡全力訓練。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd swing a wooden sword around down here a lot. Always wanted to be like my parents.
plugin.seed: 我会经常在这里挥舞木剑。一直想和我父母一样。
plugin.target: 我會經常在這裡揮舞木劍。一直想和我父母一樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I didn't really start training until I lost my mother.
plugin.seed: 直到我失去母亲，我才真正开始训练。
plugin.target: 直到我失去母親，我才真正開始訓練。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: A mistake?
plugin.seed: 一个错误？
plugin.target: 一個錯誤？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I haven't been back here in 10 years. To see it now, in the heat of the Dragon Crisis and this whole affair with Vonjar...
plugin.seed: 我已经10年没回过这里了。现在来看，这里正在在巨龙危机和与冯贾尔有关的整个事件中心...
plugin.target: 我已經10年沒回過這裡了。現在來看，這裡正在在巨龍危機和與馮賈爾有關的整個事件中心...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's not the right time to re-open the wound. I'm sorry I roped you into this.
plugin.seed: 现在不是重新撕破伤口的合适时机。很抱歉我把你牵扯进来了。
plugin.target: 現在不是重新撕破傷口的合適時機。很抱歉我把你牽扯進來了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How many times have you saved my life now? I owe you this much, as a friend.
plugin.seed: 你现在救过我多少次了？作为朋友，我欠了你这么多。
plugin.target: 你現在救過我多少次了？作為朋友，我欠了你這麼多。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I appreciete the fact that you feel that way, but I can't let you.
plugin.seed: 我理解你的这种感觉，但我不能让你这么做。
plugin.target: 我理解你的這種感覺，但我不能讓你這麼做。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My duty above all else is to keep you safe. Letting my past distract me could hinder that.
plugin.seed: 我的首要职责是保护你的安全。让我的过去分散我的注意力可能会阻碍这一点。
plugin.target: 我的首要職責是保護你的安全。讓我的過去分散我的注意力可能會阻礙這一點。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: No. This is exactly what I was worried about.
plugin.seed: 不，这正是我所担心的。
plugin.target: 不，這正是我所擔心的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Don't you remember what I told you that day on the Throat of the World?
plugin.seed: 你不记得那天我在世界之喉上对你说了什么吗？
plugin.target: 你不記得那天我在世界之喉上對你說了什麼嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We can't let our personal feelings for each other, strong as they may be, get in the way of our obligations.
plugin.seed: 我们不能让我们对彼此的个人感情，尽管它们可能很强烈，妨碍我们履行义务。
plugin.target: 我們不能讓我們對彼此的個人感情，儘管它們可能很強烈，妨礙我們履行義務。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I know it's not an ideal romance, but that's what ours has to be. I love you and all the passion you have for me, but duty is important to me.
plugin.seed: 我知道这不是一段理想的爱情，但这就是我们的爱情。我爱你，爱你对我的热情，但责任对我来说很重要。
plugin.target: 我知道這不是一段理想的愛情，但這就是我們的愛情。我愛你，愛你對我的熱情，但責任對我來說很重要。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't think I'd be a very good lover if I didn't know these things about you, Lydia.
plugin.seed: 如果我不了解你的这些事情，我认为我不配成为一个合格爱人，莱迪亚。
plugin.target: 如果我不瞭解你的這些事情，我認為我不配成為一個合格愛人，萊迪亞。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Maybe that isn't what I want from you, Lydia. Maybe I just want normal love.
plugin.seed: 也许这不是我想要的，莱迪亚。也许我只是想要普通的爱。
plugin.target: 也許這不是我想要的，萊迪亞。也許我只是想要普通的愛。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well maybe you're the only person who's given a damn about me since my father died.
plugin.seed: 也许你是我父亲去世后唯一一个在乎我的人。
plugin.target: 也許你是我父親去世後唯一一個在乎我的人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Maybe there's a reason I'm so intent on protecting you. I was helpless when my mother died to bandits and when my father died to illness.
plugin.seed: 也许我这么想保护你是有原因的。当我的母亲死于强盗，当我的父亲死于疾病时，我很无助。
plugin.target: 也許我這麼想保護你是有原因的。當我的母親死於強盜，當我的父親死於疾病時，我很無助。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I won't lose you helplessly. My thane, my lover, and the closest friend I've ever had, all in one. Do you understand how important to me you are now?
plugin.seed: 我不会眼睁睁地失去你。我的丈夫，我的爱人，还有我有过的最亲密的朋友，都是一体的。你明白你现在对我有多重要吗？
plugin.target: 我不會眼睜睜地失去你。我的丈夫，我的愛人，還有我有過的最親密的朋友，都是一體的。你明白你現在對我有多重要嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: This can't be "normal love". Not with someone like you.
plugin.seed: 这并不能是"普通的爱"。同你来说并不是。
plugin.target: 這並不能是"普通的愛"。同你來說並不是。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I understand. I'm sorry I forgot how important to you this is, Lydia.
plugin.seed: 我明白。对不起，我忘了这对你有多重要，莱迪亚。
plugin.target: 我明白。對不起，我忘了這對你有多重要，萊迪亞。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I took two oaths to you. One in Dragonsreach, the other on the altar at the temple of Mara.
plugin.seed: 我向你宣誓了两次。一次在龙临堡，另一次对着玛拉神殿的祭坛。
plugin.target: 我向你宣誓了兩次。一次在龍臨堡，另一次對著瑪拉神殿的祭壇。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't intend to ever break either one.
plugin.seed: 我不打算打破任何一个。
plugin.target: 我不打算打破任何一個。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're still human, Lydia. I can't let you keep things like this under the rug.
plugin.seed: 你还是只是个人类，莱迪亚。我不能让你一个人藏着心事。
plugin.target: 你還是隻是個人類，萊迪亞。我不能讓你一個人藏著心事。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I wasn't keeping it under the rug, I mentioned my parents to you plenty of times. I just didn't need to come back here and see it all again.
plugin.seed: 我没有隐瞒，我多次向你提到过我的父母。我只是不需要回到这里再看一遍。
plugin.target: 我沒有隱瞞，我多次向你提到過我的父母。我只是不需要回到這裡再看一遍。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm sorry. I should've been more considerate of the way you feel.
plugin.seed: 对不起。我应该多考虑一下你的感受。
plugin.target: 對不起。我應該多考慮一下你的感受。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's alright. It wouldn't be right to get mad at you for caring about me.
plugin.seed: 没关系。我不会因为你的关心而生气。
plugin.target: 沒關係。我不會因為你的關心而生氣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It wasn't a mistake. It was important I learned all this about you.
plugin.seed: 这不是一个错误。重要的是我了解了关于你的这一切。
plugin.target: 這不是一個錯誤。重要的是我瞭解了關於你的這一切。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Was it?
plugin.seed: 是吗？
plugin.target: 是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think we should leave.
plugin.seed: 我想我们应该离开了。
plugin.target: 我想我們應該離開了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I agree. Let's go find Vonjar.
plugin.seed: 我同意。我们去找冯贾尔吧。
plugin.target: 我同意。我們去找馮賈爾吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Should we get underway?
plugin.seed: 我们应该行动了吗？
plugin.target: 我們應該行動了嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah. I think so.
plugin.seed: 是的。我想是这样。
plugin.target: 是的。我想是這樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: There's clearly a problem here that you haven't resolved. I intend to help you with it.
plugin.seed: 显然你并没有解决掉这些问题，我打算帮你一把。
plugin.target: 顯然你並沒有解決掉這些問題，我打算幫你一把。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're only proving my point more. I don't deserve you.
plugin.seed: 你只是在进一步证明我的观点。我不配得到你。
plugin.target: 你只是在進一步證明我的觀點。我不配得到你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Let's go find Vonjar.
plugin.seed: 我们去找冯贾尔吧。
plugin.target: 我們去找馮賈爾吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well, it looks like this will take us higher into the mountains. Probably better than trying to trek through them to find the canyon.
plugin.seed: 好吧，看起来这里通往更高的山区。站得高看得远。
plugin.target: 好吧，看起來這裡通往更高的山區。站得高看得遠。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's certainly one of the bigger bandit holdouts I've seen.
plugin.seed: 这肯定是我见过的最大的强盗团之一。
plugin.target: 這肯定是我見過的最大的強盜團之一。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Vonjar must have a good number of people here, between his original clan and the deserters he poached.
plugin.seed: 冯贾尔在这里一定有很多人，包括他原来的氏族和他偷猎的逃兵。
plugin.target: 馮賈爾在這裡一定有很多人，包括他原來的氏族和他偷獵的逃兵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Wait... look over there. There's a trail that runs alongside the edge of the canyon, away from the fort.
plugin.seed: 等等...看那边。峡谷边缘有一条小路，远离堡垒。
plugin.target: 等等...看那邊。峽谷邊緣有一條小路，遠離堡壘。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We could use it to get a better view of the area.
plugin.seed: 我们可以借助它更好地看到这个地区。
plugin.target: 我們可以藉助它更好地看到這個地區。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It probably just winds off into the mountains. I'd rather not get lost out here.
plugin.seed: 它可能通往山区。我可不想在这里迷路。
plugin.target: 它可能通往山區。我可不想在這裡迷路。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Fair enough. I guess it's you and me against whatever we find in there. Just like always.
plugin.seed: 很公平。我猜是你和我不喜欢我们在那里找到的任何东西。就像往常一样。
plugin.target: 很公平。我猜是你和我不喜歡我們在那裡找到的任何東西。就像往常一樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Good call. Let's head up there and figure out what we're up against.
plugin.seed: 好注意。让我们去那里看看我们要面对的是什么。
plugin.target: 好注意。讓我們去那裡看看我們要面對的是什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'll try not to make too much noise.
plugin.seed: 我尽量不会发出太大的声音。
plugin.target: 我儘量不會發出太大的聲音。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Looks like there are about as many as you thought. A mix of bandits and deserters.
plugin.seed: 看起来和你想象的一样。土匪和逃兵蛇鼠一窝。
plugin.target: 看起來和你想像的一樣。土匪和逃兵蛇鼠一窩。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Y'know, all things considered, we might be able to reason with the deserters.
plugin.seed: 你知道，综合考虑，我们也许可以和逃兵讲道理。
plugin.target: 你知道，綜合考慮，我們也許可以和逃兵講道理。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They're obviously a desperate lot, but they might be willing to not go off raiding villages.
plugin.seed: 他们显然是一群绝望的人，但他们可能不愿意去袭击村庄。
plugin.target: 他們顯然是一群絕望的人，但他們可能不願意去襲擊村莊。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're the last person I'd ever expect to want to help people who fled their army...
plugin.seed: 你可不像是一个想帮助逃兵的人......
plugin.target: 你可不像是一個想幫助逃兵的人......
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Hmph. What made you think that?
plugin.seed: 嗯。为什么你这样想呢？
plugin.target: 嗯。為什麼你這樣想呢？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You know what I think about this war. It's about as sensible of a debate as two drunkards trying to figure out who can keep pissing for longer.
plugin.seed: 你知道我对这场战争的看法。这场辩论就像两个醉汉试图弄清楚谁能继续小便更长时间一样明智。
plugin.target: 你知道我對這場戰爭的看法。這場辯論就像兩個醉漢試圖弄清楚誰能繼續小便更長時間一樣明智。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If we let them stay here and keep training, they can become an asset in a future conflict.
plugin.seed: 如果我们让他们留在这里继续训练，他们可能会成为未来冲突中的一笔财富。
plugin.target: 如果我們讓他們留在這裡繼續訓練，他們可能會成為未來衝突中的一筆財富。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What future conflict would we use these people in?
plugin.seed: 我们未来和谁打仗需要用到他们？
plugin.target: 我們未來和誰打仗需要用到他們？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Do I even have to say it out loud?
plugin.seed: 我还要大声说出来吗？
plugin.target: 我還要大聲說出來嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The one with the Thalmor.
plugin.seed: 梭默的那个。
plugin.target: 梭默的那個。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Those cowards aren't worth it.
plugin.seed: 那些胆小鬼不值得。
plugin.target: 那些膽小鬼不值得。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If that's your verdict...
plugin.seed: 如果那是你的决定的话...
plugin.target: 如果那是你的決定的話...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're right. Let's see if we can work something out with the deserters.
plugin.seed: 你说得对。让我们看看能不能和那些逃兵一起解决这个问题。
plugin.target: 你說得對。讓我們看看能不能和那些逃兵一起解決這個問題。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We might have to fight a few of them, but I think we can get a few to come around.
plugin.seed: 我们可能无法避免的和他们中的一些人战斗，但我认为我们可以让一些人站在我们这边。
plugin.target: 我們可能無法避免的和他們中的一些人戰鬥，但我認為我們可以讓一些人站在我們這邊。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Maybe we should check to see what's inside that cave. It could get us to an even better vantage point on them.
plugin.seed: 也许我们应该去看看那个山洞里有什么。也许能找到什么东西让我们更有优势。
plugin.target: 也許我們應該去看看那個山洞裡有什麼。也許能找到什麼東西讓我們更有優勢。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Looks like they might have spotted us... this is where the fun begins.
plugin.seed: 看起来他们可能已经发现了我们……好戏开场了。
plugin.target: 看起來他們可能已經發現了我們……好戲開場了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: A bunch of weak-necked cowards who ran from battle don't scare me.
plugin.seed: 一群从战场上逃跑的胆小鬼而已，吓不倒我。
plugin.target: 一群從戰場上逃跑的膽小鬼而已，嚇不倒我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...If that's what you think of us, imagine how humiliating it will be when we kill you.
plugin.seed: ......我这么看我们的吗，待会被杀掉可就没机会丢脸了。
plugin.target: ......我這麼看我們的嗎，待會被殺掉可就沒機會丟臉了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Our quarrel isn't with you, just Vonjar.
plugin.seed: 我们要找的对象的不是你，而是冯贾尔。
plugin.target: 我們要找的對象的不是你，而是馮賈爾。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And you expect me to turn my back on an associate that quickly?
plugin.seed: 你指望我这么快就背叛同僚？
plugin.target: 你指望我這麼快就背叛同僚？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (Restoration) Will fighting for a bandit bring you back under Stendarr's fold?
plugin.seed: （恢复系）为强盗而战，斯坦德尔会认可你吗？
plugin.target: （恢復系）為強盜而戰，斯坦德爾會認可你嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Stendarr had us fighting in an utterly pointless conflict-
plugin.seed: 斯坦德尔让我们加入一场没有意义的战争——
plugin.target: 斯坦德爾讓我們加入一場沒有意義的戰爭——
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The civil war was not Stendarr's will. Fighting steadfast among your comrades was, and you failed.
plugin.seed: 内战并非斯坦德尔的意志。与你的同胞并肩作战才是，你辜负了斯坦德尔。
plugin.target: 內戰並非斯坦德爾的意志。與你的同胞並肩作戰才是，你辜負了斯坦德爾。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Sigh* I shouldn't have beesmirched the name of a divine. We do have something to prove, don't we?
plugin.seed: *叹气*我不应该玷污神之名。我们确实有一些东西要洗刷，不是吗？
plugin.target: *嘆氣*我不應該玷汙神之名。我們確實有一些東西要洗刷，不是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (Heavy Armor) I had no trouble fighting outside. The confined space will make it easier.
plugin.seed: （重甲）我在开阔战斗毫无问题，在狭窄空间也绝不会输。
plugin.target: （重甲）我在開闊戰鬥毫無問題，在狹窄空間也絕不會輸。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I suppose Vonjar is even less worth dying over than the legion was.
plugin.seed: 我想冯贾尔比帝国军团更不值得我为之牺牲。
plugin.target: 我想馮賈爾比帝國軍團更不值得我為之犧牲。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (Persuade) Vonjar isn't worth fighting for. He's a bandit - you're not.
plugin.seed: （说服）冯贾尔不值得你为之而战。他是强盗——你不是。
plugin.target: （說服）馮賈爾不值得你為之而戰。他是強盜——你不是。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're right. I suppose it's time we forged our own path.
plugin.seed: 你说得对。我想是时候我们开辟自己的道路了。
plugin.target: 你說得對。我想是時候我們開闢自己的道路了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We'll let you go about your business with Vonjar unmolested. I intend to talk to you afterwards, though.
plugin.seed: 我们会保证你在解决和冯贾尔的事情时不会受到任何干扰。不过我打算之后再和你谈谈。
plugin.target: 我們會保證你在解決和馮賈爾的事情時不會受到任何干擾。不過我打算之後再和你談談。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I guess that means this ends with one of us dead.
plugin.seed: 我想最终我们得战得你死我活了。
plugin.target: 我想最終我們得戰得你死我活了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It certainly does.
plugin.seed: 确实如此。
plugin.target: 確實如此。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Looks like you'll die without honor, then.
plugin.seed: 看来你会毫无荣誉地死去了，那么接招。
plugin.target: 看來你會毫無榮譽地死去了，那麼接招。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That remains to be seen.
plugin.seed: 话别说得太早。
plugin.target: 那就不得而知了。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: I'm here for Vonjar, not you.
plugin.seed: 我是来找冯贾尔的，不是来找你的。
plugin.target: 我是來找馮賈爾的，不是來找你的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Vonjar doesn't deserve the same dishonor that the war did.
plugin.seed: 冯贾尔不应该受到战争带来的耻辱。
plugin.target: 馮賈爾不應該受到戰爭帶來的恥辱。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (Destruction) I could easily bring this keep down around you all and escape in time.
plugin.seed: （破坏系）我可以毫发无伤干掉你们。
plugin.target: （破壞系）我可以毫髮無傷幹掉你們。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I suppose we've lost the advantage in battle. *Sigh*
plugin.seed: 我想我们完全没得打。 *叹*
plugin.target: 我想我們完全沒得打。 *嘆*
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (Two-Handed) In an open space like this, I'll have no problem cutting through you.
plugin.seed: （双手武器）在这种开阔的空间里，我毫无问题可以把你一下切开。
plugin.target: （雙手武器）在這種開闊的空間裡，我毫無問題可以把你一下切開。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I guess this fight would be even more foolish than the war.
plugin.seed: 我想这场和你战斗会比这场战争还要愚蠢。
plugin.target: 我想這場和你戰鬥會比這場戰爭還要愚蠢。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: (Persuade) What makes Vonjar a more worthy leader than Ulfric?
plugin.seed: (说服) 是什么让冯贾尔还能比乌弗瑞克更值得当领导呢？
plugin.target: (說服) 是什麼讓馮賈爾還能比烏弗瑞克更值得當領導呢？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization
