plugin.source: Apart from the fact that he's not sending us into a pointless civil war against our kin? Not much.
plugin.seed: 除了他不会让我们陷入一场针对我们同胞的毫无意义的内战之外？也没啥了。
plugin.target: 除了他不會讓我們陷入一場針對我們同胞的毫無意義的內戰之外？也沒啥了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I suppose you have a point. If you have some quarrel with him that doesn't involve me, I'll let you go about it.
plugin.seed: 我想你说得有道理。如果你和他有什么矛盾，与我无关，我会让你去的。
plugin.target: 我想你說得有道理。如果你和他有什麼矛盾，與我無關，我會讓你去的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If I had to guess, Vonjar is holding out in that tower. I don't intend to keep him waiting.
plugin.seed: 如果要我说，冯贾尔就在那座塔楼里。我不想让他久等。
plugin.target: 如果要我說，馮賈爾就在那座塔樓裡。我不想讓他久等。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So, you're the two warriors who've been tearing through my fort. Surprised you made it this far.
plugin.seed: 所以，你们是两个一直在攻击我堡垒的战士。很惊讶你能走到这么远。
plugin.target: 所以，你們是兩個一直在攻擊我堡壘的戰士。很驚訝你能走到這麼遠。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I suppose that's what happens when you build an army of cowards.
plugin.seed: 我想，当你组建一支懦夫军队时，就会发生这种情况。
plugin.target: 我想，當你組建一支懦夫軍隊時，就會發生這種情況。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...who are you, anyway?
plugin.seed: ...你到底是谁?
plugin.target: ...你到底是誰?
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm the daughter of a woman who was killed by clan Red-Tundra 16 years ago.
plugin.seed: 我是十六年前被红苔强盗杀死的那个女人的女儿。
plugin.target: 我是十六年前被紅苔強盜殺死的那個女人的女兒。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I was a guard in Whiterun during the years the clan harassed the city.
plugin.seed: 在氏族骚扰城市的那些年里，我是白漫城的一名警卫。
plugin.target: 在氏族騷擾城市的那些年裡，我是白漫城的一名警衛。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And now, I'm sworn to defend someone that the last surviving member of clan Red-Tundra sent an assassin to kill.
plugin.seed: 而现在，我是红苔的唯一漏网之鱼试图寻找刺客刺杀之人的忠实侍卫。
plugin.target: 而現在，我是紅苔的唯一漏網之魚試圖尋找刺客刺殺之人的忠實侍衛。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Ah, so you're one of Whiterun's myriad of misguided children.
plugin.seed: 啊，所以你是白漫无数误入歧途的孩子中的一个。
plugin.target: 啊，所以你是白漫無數誤入歧途的孩子中的一個。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We raided so many farms back in the 180s. I was still young back then. I never realized how cowardly so many people were.
plugin.seed: 早在180年代，我们就突袭了很多农场。那时我还年轻。我从来没有意识到这么多人是如此懦弱。
plugin.target: 早在180年代，我們就突襲了很多農場。那時我還年輕。我從來沒有意識到這麼多人是如此懦弱。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So many gave in to us. If your mother died, she must have resisted. Good for her.
plugin.seed: 这么多人向我们屈服。如果你母亲死了，她一定会反抗的。这对她很好。
plugin.target: 這麼多人向我們屈服。如果你母親死了，她一定會反抗的。這對她很好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You don't even deserve to praise her, you arrogant snow-backed cutthroat.
plugin.seed: 你甚至不配赞美她，你这个傲慢的雪背杀手。
plugin.target: 你甚至不配讚美她，你這個傲慢的雪背殺手。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Your reign as king of the cowards is over.
plugin.seed: 你们作为懦夫之王的统治结束了。
plugin.target: 你們作為懦夫之王的統治結束了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Heh. "King of the cowards." That's not bad.
plugin.seed: 呵呵。"懦夫之王"。听起来不赖。
plugin.target: 呵呵。"懦夫之王"。聽起來不賴。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Seems that this is what I get for employing soldiers who ran from battle.
plugin.seed: 似乎这就是我雇佣从战场上逃跑的士兵所得到的。
plugin.target: 似乎這就是我僱傭從戰場上逃跑的士兵所得到的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Then I suppose your mother is avenged.
plugin.seed: 那我想你为你的妈妈报仇了。
plugin.target: 那我想你為你的媽媽報仇了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I... I never thought I'd come face to face with one of her killers.
plugin.seed: 我...我从没想过我会直面杀害她的凶手。
plugin.target: 我...我從沒想過我會直面殺害她的兇手。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Justice is served. I was always taught that revenge isn't satisfying, but I feel pretty content right now, seeing that bastard's armor bashed into his ribcage.
plugin.seed: 正义得到伸张。我一直被教导复仇是不对的，但看到那个混蛋的盔甲被打到胸腔里，我现在感到很满足。
plugin.target: 正義得到伸張。我一直被教導復仇是不對的，但看到那個混蛋的盔甲被打到胸腔裡，我現在感到很滿足。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's... crass. Even if he killed your mother.
plugin.seed: 那是……真残暴。哪怕他杀了你母亲。
plugin.target: 那是……真殘暴。哪怕他殺了你母親。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Maybe it is. But I don't find it to be a revolting sight, so why worry about it? Why be disgusted about the fact that I'm not disgusted?
plugin.seed: 也许吧。但我不觉得这场景令人反感，所以为什么要担心呢？为什么会对此感到反感？
plugin.target: 也許吧。但我不覺得這場景令人反感，所以為什麼要擔心呢？為什麼會對此感到反感？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm glad this worked out for you.
plugin.seed: 我很高兴这对你有用。
plugin.target: 我很高興這對你有用。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah... so am I. It's been a long time coming for clan Red-Tundra. Let's hope this is really the end.
plugin.seed: 是的...我也是。红苔强盗们已经来这已经很长时间了。让我们希望这真的结束了。
plugin.target: 是的...我也是。紅苔強盜們已經來這已經很長時間了。讓我們希望這真的結束了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Does this really make things better?
plugin.seed: 这真的会让事情变得更好吗？
plugin.target: 這真的會讓事情變得更好嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm well aware that it won't bring my mother back, but it's one less dangerous individual with sway in Whiterun Hold.
plugin.seed: 我很清楚这不会让我的母亲回来，但在白漫领，这是一个不那么危险的人。
plugin.target: 我很清楚這不會讓我的母親回來，但在白漫領，這是一個不那麼危險的人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...Not to mention that my mother's axe is back where it belongs.
plugin.seed: ……更不用说我母亲的斧头又回到了原处。
plugin.target: ……更不用說我母親的斧頭又回到了原處。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That axe cleaved through Aldmeri ranks at the battle of Red Ring. My mother had it since before the war had even started.
plugin.seed: 在红环战役中，那把斧头劈穿了先祖神州的队伍。我母亲在战争开始前就已经有它了。
plugin.target: 在紅環戰役中，那把斧頭劈穿了先祖神州的隊伍。我母親在戰爭開始前就已經有它了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm... happy to see it back where it belongs. In fact, why don't you hold onto it?
plugin.seed: 我...很高兴看到它回到原来的地方。事实上，你为什么不用它？
plugin.target: 我...很高興看到它回到原來的地方。事實上，你為什麼不用它？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I wouldn't have pulled this off without your help, and I perfer arming swords either way.
plugin.seed: 如果没有你的帮助，我是不会成功的，而且无论哪种方式，我都会双手备剑。
plugin.target: 如果沒有你的幫助，我是不會成功的，而且無論哪種方式，我都會雙手備劍。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think we're about done here. Let's head home.
plugin.seed: 我想我们快结束了。我们回家吧。
plugin.target: 我想我們快結束了。我們回家吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think we should probably tell the Jarl about what happened here.
plugin.seed: 我想我们应该把这里发生的事情告诉领主。
plugin.target: 我想我們應該把這裡發生的事情告訴領主。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Are you familiar with a bandit named Vonjar Red-Tundra?
plugin.seed: 你认识一个名叫冯贾尔·红苔的强盗吗？
plugin.target: 你認識一個名叫馮賈爾·紅苔的強盜嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Red-Tundra... it's been a long time since I heard that name.
plugin.seed: 红苔...我已经很久没听到这个名字了。
plugin.target: 紅苔...我已經很久沒聽到這個名字了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: About 8 years back, those bastards battered our city every few days for months.
plugin.seed: 大概八年前，这些强盗每隔几天就侵扰我们的城市，一直持续了几个月。
plugin.target: 大概八年前，這些強盜每隔幾天就侵擾我們的城市，一直持續了幾個月。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I believe Lydia here was still a guard at that time. She was in the fight herself.
plugin.seed: 我相信莱迪亚当时还是一位卫兵。她曾经也在那场战斗中。
plugin.target: 我相信萊迪亞當時還是一位衛兵。她曾經也在那場戰鬥中。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It seemed like he was trying to build an army of deserters from the war.
plugin.seed: 他似乎在试图组建一支由战争逃兵组成的军队。
plugin.target: 他似乎在試圖組建一支由戰爭逃兵組成的軍隊。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Gods... he intends to try again, doesn't he?
plugin.seed: 天啊。他打算再试一次，不是吗？
plugin.target: 天啊。他打算再試一次，不是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Our walls aren't what they were back then.
plugin.seed: 我们的城墙已今非昔比。
plugin.target: 我們的城牆已今非昔比。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: He's dead. Lydia here told me all about what the Red-Tundras used to do.
plugin.seed: 他死了。莱迪亚在这里告诉了我所有关于红苔过去所做的事情。
plugin.target: 他死了。萊迪亞在這裡告訴了我所有關於紅苔過去所做的事情。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I... I'd like to verify that.
plugin.seed: 我...我想确定一下。
plugin.target: 我...我想確定一下。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Do you mind staying here in Whiterun for a bit? If what you've told me is true, you'll be rewarded.
plugin.seed: 你介意在这里呆一段时间吗？如果你告诉我的是真的，你会得到奖励的。
plugin.target: 你介意在這裡呆一段時間嗎？如果你告訴我的是真的，你會得到獎勵的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Jarl Balgruuf, Vonjar sent an assassin after our Thane here, and we met two deserters squatting in my childhood home.
plugin.seed: 巴尔古夫领主，冯贾尔曾派出刺客刺杀我们的武卫，我们在我儿时的家里遇到了两个逃兵。
plugin.target: 巴爾古夫領主，馮賈爾曾派出刺客刺殺我們的男爵，我們在我兒時的家裡遇到了兩個逃兵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Jarl Vignar, Vonjar sent an assassin after our Thane here, and we met two deserters squatting in my childhood home.
plugin.seed: 巴尔古夫领主，冯贾尔曾派出刺客刺杀我们的武卫，我们在我儿时的家里遇到了两个逃兵。
plugin.target: 巴爾古夫領主，馮賈爾曾派出刺客刺殺我們的男爵，我們在我兒時的家裡遇到了兩個逃兵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: He knew that house was empty because it was one of the farms he'd raided back when the Red-Tundras were more active.
plugin.seed: 他知道那所房子是空的，因为这是他在红苔活跃时期时袭击过的农场之一。
plugin.target: 他知道那所房子是空的，因為這是他在紅苔活躍時期時襲擊過的農場之一。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Those deserters directed us to a fortress in the Dragontails, where Vonjar had a whole army holed up.
plugin.seed: 那些逃兵把我们带到龙尾的一个堡垒，冯贾尔在那里藏了一整支军队。
plugin.target: 那些逃兵把我們帶到龍尾的一個堡壘，馮賈爾在那裡藏了一整支軍隊。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I believe what you're saying, Housecarl. But I can't take this at face value - a Thane murdered someone who I believed was a loyal subject.
plugin.seed: 我相信你说的，侍卫。但我不能从表面上看这件事——一个武卫谋杀了一个我认为是忠诚臣民的人。
plugin.target: 我相信你說的，侍衛。但我不能從表面上看這件事——一個男爵謀殺了一個我認為是忠誠臣民的人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Until I get verification, the Thane will be placed in lockup, and you'll be relieved as their protector.
plugin.seed: 在我得到验证之前，你的武卫将被关进监狱，你将被解除保护他的职责。
plugin.target: 在我得到驗證之前，你的男爵將被關進監獄，你將被解除保護他的職責。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's not fair, and you know it! You know you promised to give him leeway in situations like this.
plugin.seed: 这不公平！你答应过在这种情况下给予宽恕。
plugin.target: 這不公平！你答應過在這種情況下給予寬恕。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's not fair, and you know it! You know you promised to give her leeway in situations like this.
plugin.seed: 这不公平！你答应过在这种情况下给予宽恕。
plugin.target: 這不公平！你答應過在這種情況下給予寬恕。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can't let him get away with murder. Guards! Take the Thane to the dungeon. Mind yourselves with him - he's still a hero here.
plugin.seed: 我不能让他逍遥法外。卫兵！把武卫带去地牢。别太粗鲁———他仍然是这里的英雄。
plugin.target: 我不能讓他逍遙法外。衛兵！把男爵帶去地牢。別太粗魯———他仍然是這裡的英雄。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can't let her get away with murder. Guards! Take the Thane to the dungeon. Mind yourselves with her - she's still a hero here.
plugin.seed: 我不能让她逍遥法外。卫兵！把武卫带去地牢。别太粗鲁———他仍然是这里的英雄。
plugin.target: 我不能讓她逍遙法外。衛兵！把男爵帶去地牢。別太粗魯———他仍然是這裡的英雄。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's a shame to see that this is how Whiterun treats its heroes.
plugin.seed: 这就是白漫领对待英雄的方式，我对此感到很遗憾。
plugin.target: 這就是白漫領對待英雄的方式，我對此感到很遺憾。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'll have you out of there soon, Thane. Don't worry.
plugin.seed: 我很快就会让你离开那里，大人。别担心。
plugin.target: 我很快就會讓你離開那裡，大人。別擔心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Is that all?
plugin.seed: 就这样？
plugin.target: 就這樣？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Not quite. Here is your reward, as promised. Also, I believe your housecarl is waiting for you out on the porch.
plugin.seed: 不完全是。这是你答应的报酬。另外，我相信你的侍卫在门廊等你。
plugin.target: 不完全是。這是你答應的報酬。另外，我相信你的侍衛在門廊等你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Real stroke of genius you had, wanting to tell the Jarl about this whole affair.
plugin.seed: 你这想法可真好，想把这整件事告诉领主。
plugin.target: 你這想法可真好，想把這整件事告訴領主。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: In my defense, you wound up getting paid a lot for this.
plugin.seed: 在我眼中，你最终得到了很多报酬。
plugin.target: 在我眼中，你最終得到了很多報酬。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's fine, Lydia. It wasn't that long of a wait.
plugin.seed: 没事了，莱迪亚。很高兴再次见到你。
plugin.target: 沒事了，萊迪亞。很高興再次見到你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm glad to see you too.
plugin.seed: 我也很高兴见到你。
plugin.target: 我也很高興見到你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I figured you'd start missing me too much if I let the Jarl keep you in there for any longer.
plugin.seed: 我想如果你在领主那儿呆久了，会不会想我。
plugin.target: 我想如果你在領主那兒呆久了，會不會想我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I rode out there with a few guards. We're lucky I could convince them to ride.
plugin.seed: 我和几个卫兵一起骑马离开了那里。我们很幸运，我能说服他们骑马。
plugin.target: 我和幾個衛兵一起騎馬離開了那裡。我們很幸運，我能說服他們騎馬。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The old fort strewn with bandit corpses was enough to convince them - some of them had been with me during the Red-Tundra raids, years ago.
plugin.seed: 布满强盗尸体的古老堡垒足以让他们信服——他们中的一些人曾在多年前的红苔强盗们突袭中与我并肩作战。
plugin.target: 佈滿強盜屍體的古老堡壘足以讓他們信服——他們中的一些人曾在多年前的紅苔強盜們突襲中與我並肩作戰。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Everything that's happened between us... It's made me realize that some things are just non-negotiable.
plugin.seed: 我们之间发生的一切……让我意识到有些事情是不可谈判的。
plugin.target: 我們之間發生的一切……讓我意識到有些事情是不可談判的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I might not like the state my hold and my province are in, but I had a duty to the men I fought alongside eight years ago. I had a duty to avenge my mother. I have a duty to protect you.
plugin.seed: 我可能不喜欢我的领地和我的省份所处的状态，但我对八年前与我并肩作战的人负有责任。我有义务为母亲报仇。我有责任保护你。
plugin.target: 我可能不喜歡我的領地和我的省份所處的狀態，但我對八年前與我並肩作戰的人負有責任。我有義務為母親報仇。我有責任保護你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've lost a lot, but I'm lucky in that there are still things I could lose. And I don't intend to lose any of them.
plugin.seed: 我失去了很多，但我很幸运，还有一些东西我可能会失去。我不打算失去他们中的任何一个。
plugin.target: 我失去了很多，但我很幸運，還有一些東西我可能會失去。我不打算失去他們中的任何一個。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Everything you've done means the world to me, Lydia. I want you to know that I care about you, a lot.
plugin.seed: 你所做的一切对我来说意味着全部，莱迪亚。我想让你知道我很担心你。
plugin.target: 你所做的一切對我來說意味著全部，萊迪亞。我想讓你知道我很擔心你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I... don't know what to tell you.
plugin.seed: 我...我不知道该跟你说什么。
plugin.target: 我...我不知道該跟你說什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I mean, when we first met, I was a little bit excited, since you're not too far in age from me, and you're easy on the eyes, but I try not to think about that.
plugin.seed: 我的意思是，当我们第一次见面时，我有点兴奋，因为你跟我差不多大年纪，而且你的眼睛很好看，但我尽量不去想这些。
plugin.target: 我的意思是，當我們第一次見面時，我有點興奮，因為你跟我差不多大年紀，而且你的眼睛很好看，但我儘量不去想這些。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: First and foremost, it's my job to keep you breathing, even if it's the end of me.
plugin.seed: 首先，我的工作是让你继续呼吸，即使我的死亡到来。
plugin.target: 首先，我的工作是讓你繼續呼吸，即使我的死亡到來。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Don't you remember what I said on the Throat of the World? I wouldn't be able to live with you dying to protect me.
plugin.seed: 你不记得我在世界之喉上说了什么吗？我无法忍受你为保护我而死。
plugin.target: 你不記得我在世界之喉上說了什麼嗎？我無法忍受你為保護我而死。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Sigh* Look at it, looming over us. I suppose you couldn't have picked a better place to tell a woman your feelings for her than the summit of the tallest mountain on the continent.
plugin.seed: *叹气*看看它，在我们头顶若隐若现。我想你再也找不到比大陆上最高山峰的顶峰更好的地方来告诉一个女人你对她的感情了。
plugin.target: *嘆氣*看看它，在我們頭頂若隱若現。我想你再也找不到比大陸上最高山峰的頂峰更好的地方來告訴一個女人你對她的感情了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't think I could live with you doing what a lover does - sacrificing themselves to save you.
plugin.seed: 我想我无法忍受你做为爱人所做的事——牺牲自己来救你。
plugin.target: 我想我無法忍受你做為愛人所做的事——犧牲自己來救你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd say this is a fairly scenic view we have here. It's a shame you've got ice in your veins, though.
plugin.seed: 我会说你就是这里的风景。不过很可惜，你这么冷血。
plugin.target: 我會說你就是這裡的風景。不過很可惜，你這麼冷血。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I do not have ice in my veins, you ridiculous old codger. You'd know that if you'd actually paid attention to me.
plugin.seed: 我的血里没有冰，你这个可笑的老家伙。如果你真的关注我，你就会知道这一点。
plugin.target: 我的血裡沒有冰，你這個可笑的老傢伙。如果你真的關注我，你就會知道這一點。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You know what, come here if you care about me so much, and I'll prove it to you.
plugin.seed: 你知道吗，如果你这么关心我，就来这里，我会向你证明的。
plugin.target: 你知道嗎，如果你這麼關心我，就來這裡，我會向你證明的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're good at picking places to tell me how you feel about me, I'll give you that much.
plugin.seed: 你很擅长挑选地方来告诉我你对我的感觉，我承认。
plugin.target: 你很擅長挑選地方來告訴我你對我的感覺，我承認。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: But there it is. You want me to view you as more than just my thane, there you are.
plugin.seed: 但事实就是这样。你想让我把你看作不仅仅是我的丈夫，你就是这样。
plugin.target: 但事實就是這樣。你想讓我把你看作不僅僅是我的丈夫，你就是這樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm insulted by how little faith you have in me. I don't plan on getting killed any time soon.
plugin.seed: 你根本不信任我，这让我感到很受侮辱。我不想在这上面浪费时间了。
plugin.target: 你根本不信任我，這讓我感到很受侮辱。我不想在這上面浪費時間了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You know what, at this point, I'm holding out on you just because I don't want to valid your enomorous ego.
plugin.seed: 你知道吗，在这一点上，我坚持你，只是因为我不想证明你愚蠢的自负。
plugin.target: 你知道嗎，在這一點上，我堅持你，只是因為我不想證明你愚蠢的自負。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You shout dragons out of the sky and absorb their souls, you sweep through hordes of bandits, you have more coin then you'll ever know what to do with...
plugin.seed: 你对着天空中的巨龙吼啸，吸收它们的灵魂，你横扫成群的土匪，你有越来越多的硬币，但你永远不知道该怎么...
plugin.target: 你對著天空中的巨龍吼嘯，吸收它們的靈魂，你橫掃成群的土匪，你有越來越多的硬幣，但你永遠不知道該怎麼...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...You don't need the lover of your pick.
plugin.seed: ...你不需要你所选择的爱人。
plugin.target: ...你不需要你所選擇的愛人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Exactly. I'm not easy to kill. So stop worrying about losing me.
plugin.seed: 准确地说，我不会被轻易杀死。所以别太担心会失去我。
plugin.target: 準確地說，我不會被輕易殺死。所以別太擔心會失去我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And there you go again. Reminding us all of how great of a warrior the Last Dragonborn is.
plugin.seed: 你又来了。让我们想起最后的龙裔是一个多么伟大的战士。
plugin.target: 你又來了。讓我們想起最後的龍裔是一個多麼偉大的戰士。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Tell me again about how you slew the dragon at the Western Watchtower. I'm sure I'll just swoon right into your arms.
plugin.seed: 再告诉我你是如何在西部哨塔屠龙的。我相信我会被你抱在怀里。
plugin.target: 再告訴我你是如何在西部哨塔屠龍的。我相信我會被你抱在懷裡。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well, Irelith and I assembled some of the guards...
plugin.seed: 好吧，伊瑞莱斯和我召集了一些守卫……
plugin.target: 好吧，伊瑞萊斯和我召集了一些守衛……
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Get over here, you bloody idiot.
plugin.seed: 过来，你这个该死的白痴。
plugin.target: 過來，你這個該死的白痴。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm sorry. I should have given your request more heed.
plugin.seed: 对不起。我应该更注意你的要求。
plugin.target: 對不起。我應該更注意你的要求。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's alright, Thane. Wouldn't be right to be angry at you for having feelings for me.
plugin.seed: 没关系的，大人。我不会因为你对我的感情而生气的。
plugin.target: 沒關係的，大人。我不會因為你對我的感情而生氣的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We could just... hope that you never need saving THAT badly.
plugin.seed: 我们可以只是......希望你永远不要遇到那种情况。
plugin.target: 我們可以只是......希望你永遠不要遇到那種情況。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Laughs* You have a good sense of humor, I'll give you that much.
plugin.seed: *笑*你很有幽默感，我承认。
plugin.target: *笑*你很有幽默感，我承認。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And you know what... You and I can both handle ourselves perfectly fine. You deserve this. We deserve this.
plugin.seed: 你知道吗...你和我都能做得很好。这是你应得的。这是我们应得的。
plugin.target: 你知道嗎...你和我都能做得很好。這是你應得的。這是我們應得的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Lydia, you're going to need to learn to take risks if you want to be happy.
plugin.seed: 莱迪亚，如果你想快乐，就需要学会付出风险。
plugin.target: 萊迪亞，如果你想快樂，就需要學會付出風險。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Sigh* You're right.
plugin.seed: *叹气* 你说得对。
plugin.target: *嘆氣* 你說得對。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I mean, it is extraordinarily bold of you to assume that being with you would make me happy.
plugin.seed: 我的意思是，你非常大胆地认为和你在一起会让我快乐。
plugin.target: 我的意思是，你非常大膽地認為和你在一起會讓我快樂。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: But it honestly would - And hearing you put it like that makes me realize how overcautiaus I've become. So... thank you.
plugin.seed: 但老实说我会——听到你这么说让我意识到我已经变得多么谨慎了。所以...谢谢你。
plugin.target: 但老實說我會——聽到你這麼說讓我意識到我已經變得多麼謹慎了。所以...謝謝你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I understand your concerns. I won't bring this up again.
plugin.seed: 我理解你的担忧。我不会再提起这个了。
plugin.target: 我理解你的擔憂。我不會再提起這個了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Don't worry about it.
plugin.seed: 别太担心。
plugin.target: 別太擔心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You've been this way since we met - you served me, even when you didn't want to.
plugin.seed: 自从我们见面以来，你就一直这样——你为我服务，即使你不想。
plugin.target: 自從我們見面以來，你就一直這樣——你為我服務，即使你不想。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well... thanks for giving me a chance to prove that I meant well. Most people would be repulsed by a reluctant housecarl.
plugin.seed: 好...谢谢你给我一个机会来证明我是认真的。不是所有人都情愿做个侍卫。
plugin.target: 好...謝謝你給我一個機會來證明我是認真的。不是所有人都情願做個侍衛。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm really lucky to have someone like you, you know that?
plugin.seed: 我真的很幸运有你这样的人，你知道吗？
plugin.target: 我真的很幸運有你這樣的人，你知道嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Thank the Jarl, putting us together was his decision. And I suppose you deserve some credit for talking me into this.
plugin.seed: 感谢领主吧，让我们在一起是他的决定。而且你还得感谢我愿意参与。
plugin.target: 感謝領主吧，讓我們在一起是他的決定。而且你還得感謝我願意參與。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Really nice view we have out here...
plugin.seed: 我们这里的景色真的很好......
plugin.target: 我們這裡的景色真的很好......
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You told me how you felt about me on the tallest mountain in Tamriel, and then got me to fall for you when we found a scroll akin to the gods.
plugin.seed: 你告诉我在泰姆瑞尔最高的山上你对我的感觉，然后当我们发现一个类似于神的卷轴时，让我爱上了你。
plugin.target: 你告訴我在泰姆瑞爾最高的山上你對我的感覺，然後當我們發現一個類似於神的卷軸時，讓我愛上了你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I figured it was my turn to get us somewhere romantic.
plugin.seed: 我想该轮到我带你去另一个浪漫的地方了。
plugin.target: 我想該輪到我帶你去另一個浪漫的地方了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm glad you had a moral ephiphany - but I wish you got back here faster.
plugin.seed: 我很高兴你得到了道德的宽慰，但我希望你能更快地回到这里。
plugin.target: 我很高興你得到了道德的寬慰，但我希望你能更快地回到這裡。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Stop acting like it was my decision to lock you in there. Plus, I know the guards were instructed to make you comfortable.
plugin.seed: 不要表现得好像是我决定把你锁在那里一样。另外，我知道守卫们不会让你过得太差。
plugin.target: 不要表現得好像是我決定把你鎖在那裡一樣。另外，我知道守衛們不會讓你過得太差。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Gods, I wish you were still a guard so you could have been my jailer.
plugin.seed: 天哪，我希望你还是个守卫，这样你就可以当我的狱卒了。
plugin.target: 天哪，我希望你還是個守衛，這樣你就可以當我的獄卒了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're completely insane.
plugin.seed: 你完全疯了。
plugin.target: 你完全瘋了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Are you ready to keep making stories?
plugin.seed: 你准备好继续书写故事新篇章了吗？
plugin.target: 你準備好繼續書寫故事新篇章了嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Always am.
plugin.seed: 一直愿意。
plugin.target: 一直願意。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's not that big of a deal - we know how to get the horn.
plugin.seed: 这没什么大不了的——我们知道再哪里能找到号角。
plugin.target: 這沒什麼大不了的——我們知道再哪裡能找到號角。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I still don't like it. I'm worried we came all this way for nothing.
plugin.seed: 我还是不喜欢。我担心我们还会再白跑一趟。
plugin.target: 我還是不喜歡。我擔心我們還會再白跑一趟。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We might have to make someone regret taking that horn...
plugin.seed: 我们应该让某人后悔拿走了号角……
plugin.target: 我們應該讓某人後悔拿走了號角……
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah, I'm thinking the same thing. They seem to know who you are, which probably means they aren't very smart.
plugin.seed: 是的，我也在想同样的事情。他们似乎知道你是谁，这可能意味着他们并不是很聪明。
plugin.target: 是的，我也在想同樣的事情。他們似乎知道你是誰，這可能意味著他們並不是很聰明。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'll be fine, Lydia. You worry too much.
plugin.seed: 我会没事的，莱迪亚。你担心过多了。
plugin.target: 我會沒事的，萊迪亞。你擔心過多了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Worrying about you is my job, Thane.
plugin.seed: 担心你是我的职责，大人。
plugin.target: 擔心你是我的職責，大人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Thalmor are nothing but evil - my parents lost a lot of friends to them back in the war. Stendarr preserve you.
plugin.seed: 梭默都是邪恶的——我父母在战争中失去了很多朋友。斯坦达二保护你。
plugin.target: 梭默都是邪惡的——我父母在戰爭中失去了很多朋友。斯坦達二保護你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And here I wanted to take on their whole guard force alone and kidnap the ambassador.
plugin.seed: 我在想，我或许可以独自打穿他们的卫队并绑架大使。
plugin.target: 我在想，我或許可以獨自打穿他們的衛隊並綁架大使。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Laughs* Maybe with help from a few dozen armed men and women when we're not occupied with any dragons. Or incompetent Blades.
plugin.seed: *笑* 除非前面没有龙挡路，带着几十名全服武装的人才可能。或许那些无能的刀锋卫士也可以试试。
plugin.target: *笑* 除非前面沒有龍擋路，帶著幾十名全服武裝的人才可能。或許那些無能的刀鋒衛士也可以試試。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Esbern seems like he knows what he's talking about.
plugin.seed: 伊思本似乎理解自己说的什么。
plugin.target: 伊思本似乎理解自己說的什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah, I'm glad to have him around. It really balances out Delphine's mind-boggling ineptitude.
plugin.seed: 是的，我很高兴有他在身边。它真的平衡了戴尔菲娜令人难以置信的无能。
plugin.target: 是的，我很高興有他在身邊。它真的平衡了戴爾菲娜令人難以置信的無能。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I just hope we're not chasing shadows here.
plugin.seed: 我只是希望我们不要在这里追逐影子。
plugin.target: 我只是希望我們不要在這裡追逐影子。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't know. It seemed pretty obvious that I'd use a shout to defeat Alduin.
plugin.seed: 我不这么认为。很明显我会用吐目击败奥杜因。
plugin.target: 我不這麼認為。很明顯我會用吐目擊敗奧杜因。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I was thinking the same thing. Shouting seems to be a fairly large part of being Dragonborn.
plugin.seed: 我在想同样的事。吼声似乎是龙裔的一个很大优势。
plugin.target: 我在想同樣的事。吼聲似乎是龍裔的一個很大優勢。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That was... underwhelming.
plugin.seed: 那……没什么了不起的。
plugin.target: 那……沒什麼了不起的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Laughs* Maybe that's just because you had my help.
plugin.seed: *笑*也许那只是因为你得到了我的帮助。
plugin.target: *笑*也許那只是因為你得到了我的幫助。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't intend to stop while I have momentum against him.
plugin.seed: 只要我有机会击败他，我就不会停下脚步。
plugin.target: 只要我有機會擊敗他，我就不會停下腳步。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And I don't intend to slow you down. Let's go.
plugin.seed: 我不打算让你停下来。我们走吧。
plugin.target: 我不打算讓你停下來。我們走吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I promise I'll be careful.
plugin.seed: 我保证我会小心的。
plugin.target: 我保證我會小心的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: A promise isn't enough after all we've been through.
plugin.seed: 在我们经历了这么多之后，一个承诺是不够的。
plugin.target: 在我們經歷了這麼多之後，一個承諾是不夠的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: None of this says "careful", Thane. This isn't what careful people do.
plugin.seed: 这些都没有说“小心”，大人。谨慎的人不会这么做。
plugin.target: 這些都沒有說“小心”，大人。謹慎的人不會這麼做。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Good luck, nonetheless. Stendarr preserve you.
plugin.seed: 祝你好运。斯坦达尔保护你。
plugin.target: 祝你好運。斯坦達爾保護你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I love you. Mara preserve us both.
plugin.seed: 我爱你。愿玛拉保护我们。
plugin.target: 我愛你。願瑪拉保護我們。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think we both know that I might not make it back.
plugin.seed: 我想我们都知道我可能回不来了。
plugin.target: 我想我們都知道我可能回不來了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Shut up.
plugin.seed: 闭嘴。
plugin.target: 閉嘴。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Whereever this Dragon takes you can't be any worse than Blackreach. You'll be fine, Thane.
plugin.seed: 无论这条龙会带你去哪里，都不会比黑境更糟。你会没事的，武卫。
plugin.target: 無論這條龍會帶你去哪裡，都不會比黑境更糟。你會沒事的，男爵。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm really glad you feel that way, Lydia. In fact, it's hard to take in.
plugin.seed: 我真的很高兴你有这种感觉，莱迪亚. 事实上，这很难接受。
plugin.target: 我真的很高興你有這種感覺，萊迪亞. 事實上，這很難接受。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Laughs* Well, then it just makes it one more unbelievable thing that's happened to you recently.
plugin.seed: *笑*好吧，这只是最近发生在你身上的又一件令人难以置信的事情。
plugin.target: *笑*好吧，這只是最近發生在你身上的又一件令人難以置信的事情。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You never catch a break, do you? Not from the good or the bad.
plugin.seed: 你从来没有休息过，是吗？不好也不坏。
plugin.target: 你從來沒有休息過，是嗎？不好也不壞。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm just glad you're hear to share the moment, Lydia.
plugin.seed: 我很高兴你能分享这一刻，莱迪亚.
plugin.target: 我很高興你能分享這一刻，萊迪亞.
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah. Real romantic of you.
plugin.seed: 是啊。你真的很浪漫。
plugin.target: 是啊。你真的很浪漫。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: First, a balcony overlooking the verdant fields of Whiterun, then the tallest mountain in Tamriel, and now, a decrepit ruin full of deformed, blind elves.
plugin.seed: 首先是一个楼厅，俯瞰着白漫葱郁的田野，然后是泰姆瑞尔最高的山，现在，是一片破旧的废墟，到处都是变形的、失明的精灵。
plugin.target: 首先是一個樓廳，俯瞰著白漫蔥鬱的田野，然後是泰姆瑞爾最高的山，現在，是一片破舊的廢墟，到處都是變形的、失明的精靈。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You really know how to make a woman head-over-heels about you.
plugin.seed: 你真的知道如何让女人对你着迷。
plugin.target: 你真的知道如何讓女人對你著迷。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Where do you want to go next? Atmora, or the Heart of Black Marsh?
plugin.seed: 你下次想去哪里？阿特莫拉，还是黑沼泽之心？
plugin.target: 你下次想去哪裡？阿特莫拉，還是黑沼澤之心？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think a warm bed would suffice.
plugin.seed: 我想一张暖和的床就足够了。
plugin.target: 我想一張暖和的床就足夠了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...You were just going on about how beautiful this infernal scroll is.
plugin.seed: ……你不期待这里面的上古卷轴会有多迷人吗。
plugin.target: ……你不期待這裡面的上古卷軸會有多迷人嗎。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah. The scroll, not the place we found it in.
plugin.seed: 是啊，那是卷轴，而不是我们找到它的地方。
plugin.target: 是啊，那是卷軸，而不是我們找到它的地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Looks like that warm bed will have to wait.
plugin.seed: 看起来那张暖和的床要再等等了。
plugin.target: 看起來那張暖和的床要再等等了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: No, not on the metal floor - *Sigh* To Oblivion with it.
plugin.seed: 不，我不想睡在金属地板上-*叹气*-该死。
plugin.target: 不，我不想睡在金屬地板上-*嘆氣*-該死。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're still concerned about that? Have some faith in me.
plugin.seed: 你还担心吗？对我有点信心好吧。
plugin.target: 你還擔心嗎？對我有點信心好吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Faith doesn't come with a guarantee. But I'll do my best.
plugin.seed: 信仰不会保证。但我会尽力的。
plugin.target: 信仰不會保證。但我會盡力的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Just... remember what you mean to me.
plugin.seed: 只是...记住你对我意味着什么。
plugin.target: 只是...記住你對我意味著什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's... complicated. Let's leave it at Haafingar for now.
plugin.seed: 这...很复杂。等我们到了海芬加领再说吧。
plugin.target: 這...很複雜。等我們到了海芬加領再說吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm from Whiterun, myself. The hold, not the city. But I did live in the city for a while.
plugin.seed: 我来自白漫。白漫领，不是白漫城。但我已经住在城里一段时间了。
plugin.target: 我來自白漫。白漫領，不是白漫城。但我已經住在城裡一段時間了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How... how long were you in there for?
plugin.seed: 你...你在那待了多久了？
plugin.target: 你...你在那待了多久了？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't know. From what your friend told me, it sounds like at least a few centuries.
plugin.seed: 我不知道。距你朋友说，这听起来至少有几个世纪了。
plugin.target: 我不知道。距你朋友說，這聽起來至少有幾個世紀了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: By the Nine...
plugin.seed: 以九圣灵之名……
plugin.target: 九聖靈啊……
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Hold on, Nine? Did Skyrim add Shor back to the Pantheon or something?
plugin.seed: 等一下，九圣灵？天际是将朔尔请回万神殿了？
plugin.target: 等一下，九聖靈？天霜是將朔爾請回萬神殿了？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: No, you've just... been in there a really long time.
plugin.seed: 不，你只是……在里面呆了很长时间。
plugin.target: 不，你只是……在裡面呆了很長時間。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You seem excited...
plugin.seed: 你看起来很兴奋。。。
plugin.target: 你看起來很興奮。。。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Dawnguard has one of the most impressive fortresses I've ever seen, have very interesting weapons, and serve the Lord of Mercy and Strength.
plugin.seed: 黎明守卫城堡是我见过的最令人印象深刻的堡垒之一，拥有非常有趣的武器，为仁慈与力量之主服务。
plugin.target: 黎明守衛城堡是我見過的最令人印象深刻的堡壘之一，擁有非常有趣的武器，為仁慈與力量之主服務。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't know what's not to like about them.
plugin.seed: 我不知道他们有什么不喜欢的。
plugin.target: 我不知道他們有什麼不喜歡的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We've barely gotten started. Who knows what we're in for.
plugin.seed: 我们才刚刚起步。谁又知道我们在干什么。
plugin.target: 我們才剛剛起步。誰又知道我們在幹什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We've fought vampires before. It's tough, but it's a righteous cause. Always worthwhile.
plugin.seed: 我们以前打过吸血鬼。这很艰难，但这是一项正义的事业。总是值得的。
plugin.target: 我們以前打過吸血鬼。這很艱難，但這是一項正義的事業。總是值得的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I figured the fact that she's a vampire would bother you.
plugin.seed: 我想她是吸血鬼的这一事实会让你感到困扰。
plugin.target: 我想她是吸血鬼的這一事實會讓你感到困擾。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How'd you know?
plugin.seed: 你怎么知道的？
plugin.target: 你怎麼知道的？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Look, those thralls that vampires use to guard their lairs have to come from somewhere.
plugin.seed: 听着，吸血鬼用来保护巢穴的奴隶肯定来自某个地方。
plugin.target: 聽著，吸血鬼用來保護巢穴的奴隸肯定來自某個地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Just because a vampire doesn't attack you doesn't mean they're on your side.
plugin.seed: 吸血鬼不攻击你并不意味着他们站在你这边。
plugin.target: 吸血鬼不攻擊你並不意味著他們站在你這邊。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: She's right over there and can easily hear our conversation...
plugin.seed: 她就在那儿，很容易听到我们的谈话...
plugin.target: 她就在那兒，很容易聽到我們的談話...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well then, I guess I'm voicing my concerns to the both of you.
plugin.seed: 那么，我想我是在向你们两个表达我的担忧。
plugin.target: 那麼，我想我是在向你們兩個表達我的擔憂。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm well aware that vampires don't always go for their prey immediately. Sometimes, they enthrall them and use them as servents.
plugin.seed: 我很清楚吸血鬼并不总是立刻去寻找猎物。有时，他们会把它们迷住，并把它们当作仆人。
plugin.target: 我很清楚吸血鬼並不總是立刻去尋找獵物。有時，他們會把它們迷住，並把它們當作僕人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm keeping my head on a swivel around her.
plugin.seed: 我绕着她转了一圈。
plugin.target: 我繞著她轉了一圈。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm sure everything will be fine. She seems friendly enough.
plugin.seed: 我相信一切都会好起来的。她看起来很友好。
plugin.target: 我相信一切都會好起來的。她看起來很友好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Don't get me wrong, I hope you're right. But I'm keeping my eyes opened.
plugin.seed: 别误会我的意思，我希望你是对的。但我会一直警惕。
plugin.target: 別誤會我的意思，我希望你是對的。但我會一直警惕。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Good thing my loving, overzealous wife would never let another woman lay a finger on me.
plugin.seed: 幸好我那充满爱心、又过分热心肠的妻子永远不会让另一个女人对我指手画脚。
plugin.target: 幸好我那充滿愛心、又過分熱心腸的妻子永遠不會讓另一個女人對我指手畫腳。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Good thing, indeed.
plugin.seed: 难道不会好事吗。
plugin.target: 難道不會好事嗎。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Good point. I'll be careful.
plugin.seed: 不错。我会小心的。
plugin.target: 不錯。我會小心的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Let's just... mind that we're not outright rude to her about this.
plugin.seed: 我们只是... 小心点，我们并没有必要就因为这而对她粗鲁无礼。
plugin.target: 我們只是... 小心點，我們並沒有必要就因為這而對她粗魯無禮。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Isran isn't going to be happy about this... we should probably get back to Fort Dawnguard to figure out our next move.
plugin.seed: 伊士冉对此不会高兴的...我们可能应该回到黎明守卫城堡，想好我们的下一步行动。
plugin.target: 伊士冉對此不會高興的...我們可能應該回到黎明守衛城堡，想好我們的下一步行動。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd like to believe the two of us could storm this castle alone, but I'm not keen to test that theory.
plugin.seed: 我很想相信我们两个人可以单独冲击这座城堡，但我不想检验这个理论。
plugin.target: 我很想相信我們兩個人可以單獨衝擊這座城堡，但我不想檢驗這個理論。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're not jealous, are you?
plugin.seed: 你不会嫉妒的，是吗？
plugin.target: 你不會嫉妒的，是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Don't even suggest that.
plugin.seed: 根本不要问。
plugin.target: 根本不要問。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What's your verdict? Does she deserve to be Thane of Whiterun? Or is the title continually abused?
plugin.seed: 你的的想法是什么？她配得上白漫城的武卫吗？还是这个头衔配不上她？
plugin.target: 你的的想法是什麼？她配得上白漫城的男爵嗎？還是這個頭銜配不上她？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Very funny.
plugin.seed: 你这么问还真有趣。
plugin.target: 你這麼問還真有趣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Are you still concerned about her?
plugin.seed: 你还在关注她吗？
plugin.target: 你還在關注她嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Somewhat. Not as much as I was before, at least.
plugin.seed: 是的。但至少没有以前那么多了。
plugin.target: 是的。但至少沒有以前那麼多了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: On one hand, she's still a fanged creature of the night whose kind preys on the innocent. It'd be stupid to not be cautious about her.
plugin.seed: 一方面，她仍然是一个有尖牙的夜晚生物，这种生物捕食无辜者。对她不谨慎是愚蠢的。
plugin.target: 一方面，她仍然是一個有尖牙的夜晚生物，這種生物捕食無辜者。對她不謹慎是愚蠢的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: But... she didn't try to drink your blood or mine, she didn't try to make us her slaves, she just walked away from us without question.
plugin.seed: 但是她没有试图喝你我的血，她没有试图让我们成为她的奴隶，她只是毫无疑问地离开了我们。
plugin.target: 但是她沒有試圖喝你我的血，她沒有試圖讓我們成為她的奴隸，她只是毫無疑問地離開了我們。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If Isran decides to take Castle Volkihar by force - which I hope he does - we won't have to kill her.
plugin.seed: 如果伊士冉决定武力夺取弗基哈尔城堡——我希望他会这样做——那样我们就不必杀了她。
plugin.target: 如果伊士冉決定武力奪取弗基哈爾城堡——我希望他會這樣做——那樣我們就不必殺了她。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: He'll probably send us in their to rescue her, though. She'd probably be an asset if we were to assault the castle.
plugin.seed: 不过，他可能会派我们去救她。如果我们袭击城堡，她可能会成为可利用的资产。
plugin.target: 不過，他可能會派我們去救她。如果我們襲擊城堡，她可能會成為可利用的資產。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We won't be able to do much without more allies, though. Let's go find Sorine and Gunmar.
plugin.seed: 然而，如果没有更多的盟友，我们将无能为力。让我们去找索琳和甘马尔。
plugin.target: 然而，如果沒有更多的盟友，我們將無能為力。讓我們去找索琳和甘馬爾。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I know how seeing your home destroyed feels - trust me. But I can't imagine being sent over six hundred years into the future.
plugin.seed: 我知道物是人非的感受————相信我。但我也无法想象自己突然从六百年后醒来会是什么样。
plugin.target: 我知道物是人非的感受————相信我。但我也無法想像自己突然從六百年後醒來會是什麼樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Laughs* You'd be surprised by how much hasn't changed.
plugin.seed: *笑*你会惊讶于变化如此之大。
plugin.target: *笑*你會驚訝於變化如此之大。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That being said... a lot has.
plugin.seed: 话虽如此...很多。
plugin.target: 話雖如此...很多。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Seems like that's becoming a theme in our relationship.
plugin.seed: 这似乎正在成为我们关系中的一个重要部分。
plugin.target: 這似乎正在成為我們關係中的一個重要部分。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How terrible it is that someone dedicated their entire life to your safety.
plugin.seed: 有人把自己的一生都献给了你的安全，这是多么可怕啊。
plugin.target: 有人把自己的一生都獻給了你的安全，這是多麼可怕啊。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think I owe Serana here an apology. She got you in and out of a realm of Oblivion unscathed. Well, mostly unscathed.
plugin.seed: 我想我欠瑟拉娜一次道歉。她让你毫发无损地进出了湮灭领域。嗯，基本上毫发无损。
plugin.target: 我想我欠瑟拉娜一次道歉。她讓你毫髮無損地進出了湮滅領域。嗯，基本上毫髮無損。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And you've brought back yet another Elder Scroll. A few months ago, I didn't even know what those things were.
plugin.seed: 你又带回了一本上古卷轴。几个月前，我甚至不知道这些东西是什么。
plugin.target: 你又帶回了一本上古卷軸。幾個月前，我甚至不知道這些東西是什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I was expecting you to go off on a tirade about how concerned you are about my safety...
plugin.seed: 我原以为你会长篇大论地说你是多么关心我的安全......
plugin.target: 我原以為你會長篇大論地說你是多麼關心我的安全......
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm more concerned about Serana.
plugin.seed: 我更关心瑟拉娜。
plugin.target: 我更關心瑟拉娜。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: This ends with us killing her father. There are no two ways about that.
plugin.seed: 最后我们杀了她的父亲。别无他路。
plugin.target: 最後我們殺了她的父親。別無他路。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It doesn't mean much coming from someone who was close with her parents, but I don't think I could have ever harmed either of them.
plugin.seed: 这对一个与她父母关系密切的人来说意义不大，但我不认为我会伤害他们中的任何一个人。
plugin.target: 這對一個與她父母關係密切的人來說意義不大，但我不認為我會傷害他們中的任何一個人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Our new friend's obviously different, but... make sure she's okay.
plugin.seed: 我们的新朋友显然不同，但...确保她没事吧。
plugin.target: 我們的新朋友顯然不同，但...確保她沒事吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Glad to see you've come around about her.
plugin.seed: 很高兴看到你为她而来。
plugin.target: 很高興看到你為她而來。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I might have trust issues and an authority problem, but at least I admit when I'm wrong.
plugin.seed: 我以前确实不信任她，但我知道我错了。
plugin.target: 我以前確實不信任她，但我知道我錯了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Do you at least trust that she'll stand by us?
plugin.seed: 你现在至少相信她会支持我们吗？
plugin.target: 你現在至少相信她會支持我們嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Of course. She knows what needs to be done.
plugin.seed: 当然。她知道需要做什么。
plugin.target: 當然。她知道需要做什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm glad you've come around, but we have a keep to storm.
plugin.seed: 我很高兴你回来了，但我们依然面临难题。
plugin.target: 我很高興你回來了，但我們依然面臨難題。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We certainly do. Let's get going.
plugin.seed: 我们当然知道。我们走吧。
plugin.target: 我們當然知道。我們走吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Lydia, you know I can hear these conversations you have with our mutual friend.
plugin.seed: 莱迪亚，你知道我能听到你和我们共同的朋友的这些谈话。
plugin.target: 萊迪亞，你知道我能聽到你和我們共同的朋友的這些談話。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...What of them?
plugin.seed: ……什么？
plugin.target: ……什麼？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You seem about as fond of vampires as Isran.
plugin.seed: 你似乎和伊士冉一样讨厌吸血鬼。
plugin.target: 你似乎和伊士冉一樣討厭吸血鬼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Hah. I'm repulsed by creatures that try to drink their blood. Isn't that just absurd of me?
plugin.seed: 哈。我讨厌那些试图吸我血的生物。不是很正常吗？
plugin.target: 哈。我討厭那些試圖吸我血的生物。不是很正常嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's... not what I'm getting at.
plugin.seed: 那...不是我想说的。
plugin.target: 那...不是我想說的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Isran seems like he has to physically restrain himself from killing me. You don't.
plugin.seed: 伊士冉似乎必须克制自己才不会杀了我。而你没有。
plugin.target: 伊士冉似乎必須剋制自己才不會殺了我。而你沒有。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Our friend here trusts you, and that's enough for me. There's no one I trust more than him.
plugin.seed: 我们这里的朋友信任你，这对我来说就足够了。没有人比他更值得我信任了。
plugin.target: 我們這裡的朋友信任你，這對我來說就足夠了。沒有人比他更值得我信任了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Our friend here trusts you, and that's enough for me. There's no one I trust more than her.
plugin.seed: 我们这里的朋友信任你，这对我来说就足够了。没有人比她更值得我信任了。
plugin.target: 我們這裡的朋友信任你，這對我來說就足夠了。沒有人比她更值得我信任了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How'd you two meet, anyway?
plugin.seed: 无论如何，你们两个是怎么认识的？
plugin.target: 無論如何，你們兩個是怎麼認識的？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: He was named the Thane of Whiterun for killing a dragon that attacked the city, and I was made his housecarl. We've travelled together ever since.
plugin.seed: 他因杀死一条袭击这座城市的巨龙而被任命为白漫城武卫，而我则成为了他的侍卫。从那以后我们就一起旅行了。
plugin.target: 他因殺死一條襲擊這座城市的巨龍而被任命為白漫城男爵，而我則成為了他的侍衛。從那以後我們就一起旅行了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: She was named the Thane of Whiterun for killing a dragon that attacked the city, and I was made her housecarl. We've travelled together ever since.
plugin.seed: 她因杀死一条袭击这座城市的巨龙而被任命为白漫城武卫，而我则成为了他的侍卫。从那以后我们就一起旅行了。
plugin.target: 她因殺死一條襲擊這座城市的巨龍而被任命為白漫城男爵，而我則成為了他的侍衛。從那以後我們就一起旅行了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's a shame to see the way you're parents treated you, Serana. I'm sorry.
plugin.seed: 瑟拉娜，看到你的父母那样对待你真是令人遗憾。对不起。
plugin.target: 瑟拉娜，看到你的父母那樣對待你真是令人遺憾。對不起。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's... it's alright. I appreciate your sympathy.
plugin.seed: 好吧...我感谢你的同情。
plugin.target: 好吧...我感謝你的同情。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What about you? What were your parents like?
plugin.seed: 那你呢？你的家人怎么样？
plugin.target: 那你呢？你的家人怎麼樣？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My father was a kind man, but as tough as a drunken troll. He travelled all over the continent with the Legion before the High Elves invaded Cyrodiil.
plugin.seed: 我的父亲是一个善良的人，但像一个喝醉的巨魔一样顽固。在高精灵入侵赛瑞迪尔之前，他随军团游历了整个大陆。
plugin.target: 我的父親是一個善良的人，但像一個喝醉的巨魔一樣頑固。在高精靈入侵賽瑞迪爾之前，他隨軍團遊歷了整個大陸。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My mother was from Whiterun. She was a mercenary, but she convinced my father to settle down and start a farm, for the safety of all three of us.
plugin.seed: 我母亲来自白漫。她是个唯利是图的人，但为了我们三个人的安全，她说服了我父亲安定下来，开一个农场。
plugin.target: 我母親來自白漫。她是個唯利是圖的人，但為了我們三個人的安全，她說服了我父親安定下來，開一個農場。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: She'd always been the protective type... she died fighting off a bandit raid, but I think that's how she wanted to go out.
plugin.seed: 她一直在保护我们...她在击退土匪袭击时牺牲了，但我想这就是她解脱的方式。
plugin.target: 她一直在保護我們...她在擊退土匪襲擊時犧牲了，但我想這就是她解脫的方式。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Oh, I'm sorry. Didn't mean to bring up a bad memory.
plugin.seed: 真的很抱歉。我不是故意要唤起你伤心的回忆。
plugin.target: 真的很抱歉。我不是故意要喚起你傷心的回憶。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's fine. They were good people, and I'm proud of all that they did. They're with Shor now.
plugin.seed: 没关系。他们是好人，我为他们所做的一切感到自豪。他们现在和朔尔在一起。
plugin.target: 沒關係。他們是好人，我為他們所做的一切感到自豪。他們現在和朔爾在一起。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I never knew places like this even existed... by the gods, it's incredible.
plugin.seed: 我从来不知道有这样的地方存在……天啊，太不可思议了。
plugin.target: 我從來不知道有這樣的地方存在……天啊，太不可思議了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Certainly a welcome change from the inside of that coffin.
plugin.seed: 当然，石棺内部发生了一些可喜的变化。
plugin.target: 當然，石棺內部發生了一些可喜的變化。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can barely see in here... I hate Falmer.
plugin.seed: 我几乎什么都看不见……我讨厌伐莫。
plugin.target: 我幾乎什麼都看不見……我討厭伐莫。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: As much as you hate vampires?
plugin.seed: 就像你讨厌吸血鬼一样？
plugin.target: 就像你討厭吸血鬼一樣？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Shut up.
plugin.seed: 闭嘴。
plugin.target: 閉嘴。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Stendarr's Mercy... everything about this place is a sight to behold.
plugin.seed: 斯坦达尔在上...这个地方的一切都令人叹为观止。
plugin.target: 斯坦達爾在上...這個地方的一切都令人歎為觀止。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If anything, this journey's taken us to a lot of amazing places.
plugin.seed: 无论如何，这次旅行给我们见到了许多美景。
plugin.target: 無論如何，這次旅行給我們見到了許多美景。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It certainly has. Granted, you didn't have to go into the Soul Cairn.
plugin.seed: 没错。当然，您不必进入灵魂石冢。
plugin.target: 沒錯。當然，您不必進入靈魂石冢。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can't even imagine the horrors you saw in that place. Speaking of which... thank you, Serana.
plugin.seed: 我甚至无法想象你在那个地方看到的恐怖。说到这里...谢谢你，瑟拉娜。
plugin.target: 我甚至無法想像你在那個地方看到的恐怖。說到這裡...謝謝你，瑟拉娜。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You got our dear friend in and out of their safely. That's normally my job, and you did it better than I ever could have.
plugin.seed: 你让我们亲爱的朋友安全地进出了他们的家。这通常是我的工作，而你做得比我做得更好。
plugin.target: 你讓我們親愛的朋友安全地進出了他們的家。這通常是我的工作，而你做得比我做得更好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So... you trust me now?
plugin.seed: 所以……你现在信任我了吗？
plugin.target: 所以……你現在信任我了嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: To Oblivion and back. Quite literally.
plugin.seed: 毫不夸张的说，能陪你去湮灭走一遭。
plugin.target: 毫不誇張的說，能陪你去湮滅走一遭。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That means a lot, Lydia.
plugin.seed: 这意义重大，莱迪亚。
plugin.target: 這意義重大，萊迪亞。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Why did you leave the Imperial Legion?
plugin.seed: 你为什么离开帝国军团？
plugin.target: 你為什麼離開帝國軍團？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Make no mistake, the Empire's been good for Tamriel, by and large. They've kept people safe and generally treated everyone fairly.
plugin.seed: 毫无疑问，总的来说，帝国对泰姆瑞尔很好。帝国保护了人们的安全，并公平对待每个人。
plugin.target: 毫無疑問，總的來說，帝國對泰姆瑞爾很好。帝國保護了人們的安全，並公平對待每個人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Nowadays, though, they want me to kill my kinsmen. I couldn't bring myself to keep doing that.
plugin.seed: 然而今天，他们想要我杀害我的同胞。我不能强迫我自己去做这样的事情。
plugin.target: 然而今天，他們想要我殺害我的同胞。我不能強迫我自己去做這樣的事情。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Nothing more uncivil than a civil war.
plugin.seed:
没有什么比内战还要更为野蛮的了。
Nothing more uncivil than a civil war.
plugin.target:
沒有什麼比內戰還要更為野蠻的了。
Nothing more uncivil than a civil war.
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They left me for dead after an Imperial Ambush. I suppose you could argue that they didn't have much of a choice considering how hard the Imperials hit us.
plugin.seed: 他们在一次伏击后把我留下等死。我想你可以说，考虑到帝国对我们的打击有多大，他们别无选择。
plugin.target: 他們在一次伏擊後把我留下等死。我想你可以說，考慮到帝國對我們的打擊有多大，他們別無選擇。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Still, I was deeply disappointed in my shield brothers and sisters that day. It was Fenrar - the enemy - who helped me, and not them.
plugin.seed: 尽管如此，那天我还是对我的盾友们深感失望。帮助我的是敌人芬拉尔，而不是他们。
plugin.target: 儘管如此，那天我還是對我的盾友們深感失望。幫助我的是敵人芬拉爾，而不是他們。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Talking to Fenrar, though, I've actually gotten a bit of respect for Ulfric's cause back. But I don't think it's worth killing other Nords over.
plugin.seed: 不过，在与芬拉尔交谈时，我实际上对乌弗瑞克的事业有了一些尊重。但我认为这不值得杀死其他诺德人。
plugin.target: 不過，在與芬拉爾交談時，我實際上對烏弗瑞克的事業有了一些尊重。但我認為這不值得殺死其他諾德人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Why did you leave the Stormcloak Rebellion?
plugin.seed: 你为什么离开风暴斗篷叛军？
plugin.target: 你為什麼離開風暴斗篷叛軍？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How did you meet Eselda?
plugin.seed: 你是怎么认识埃斯尔达的？
plugin.target: 你是怎麼認識埃斯爾達的？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: My cohort ambushed a Stormcloak supply wagon she was guarding one evening. We outnumbered them and had a terrain advantage - it barely took a minute.
plugin.seed: 一天晚上，我的同伴伏击了她守卫的一辆风暴斗篷补给车。我们的人数超过了他们，而且在地形上有优势——只花了一分钟。
plugin.target: 一天晚上，我的同伴伏擊了她守衛的一輛風暴斗篷補給車。我們的人數超過了他們，而且在地形上有優勢——只花了一分鐘。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We drove them off before they could get a hold of their wounded, and they had to leave them behind.
plugin.seed: 我们在他们抓住伤员之前就把他们赶走了，他们不得不把他们留下。
plugin.target: 我們在他們抓住傷員之前就把他們趕走了，他們不得不把他們留下。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: After we took the wagon, we left as quick as we came.
plugin.seed: 在我们坐上马车后，一到达目的地我们就离开了。
plugin.target: 在我們坐上馬車後，一到達目的地我們就離開了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd been thinking about leaving for a long time, and seeing fellow Nords die almost helplessly at my hands earlier, I decided that would be the night I snuck out of the camp.
plugin.seed: 我已经考虑离开很长一段时间了，看到其他诺德人早些时候几乎无助地死于我的手利，我决定那将是我偷偷溜出营地的那晚。
plugin.target: 我已經考慮離開很長一段時間了，看到其他諾德人早些時候幾乎無助地死於我的手利，我決定那將是我偷偷溜出營地的那晚。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: On the way out, I found that Eselda had crawled hundreds of meters in a few hours, and had no intention to go back to the Rebel army after they left her for dead.
plugin.seed: 在离开的路上，我发现埃斯尔达在几个小时内爬了数百米，在叛军将她遗弃后，我无意再回到叛军那里。
plugin.target: 在離開的路上，我發現埃斯爾達在幾個小時內爬了數百米，在叛軍將她遺棄後，我無意再回到叛軍那裡。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: After I was left for dead in an Imperial Ambush, he found me and helped me.
plugin.seed: 在我被留在帝国救护车中等待死亡后，他找到了我并救了我。
plugin.target: 在我被留在帝國救護車中等待死亡後，他找到了我並救了我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: He told me he was running from the Legion, and considering what had happened earlier that day, I figured I ought to do the same.
plugin.seed: 他告诉我他要逃离军团，考虑到那天早些时候发生的事情，我想我也应该这么做。
plugin.target: 他告訴我他要逃離軍團，考慮到那天早些時候發生的事情，我想我也應該這麼做。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We've been running ever since. You ask me, we've got to get back into the fight at some point.
plugin.seed: 从那以后我们就一直在逃命。你问我的话，我们必须在某个时候重新投入战斗。
plugin.target: 從那以後我們就一直在逃命。你問我的話，我們必須在某個時候重新投入戰鬥。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How did you meet Fenrar?
plugin.seed: 你是怎么认识芬拉尔的？
plugin.target: 你是怎麼認識芬拉爾的？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Vonjar is dead. As far as I'm concerned, the canyon is yours.
plugin.seed: 冯贾尔死了。要我说，峡谷是你的了。
plugin.target: 馮賈爾死了。要我說，峽谷是你的了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm glad things worked out as you intended. Falcius and I are going to keep everyone here.
plugin.seed: 我很高兴事情如你所愿。法尔修斯和我会把所有人都留在这里。
plugin.target: 我很高興事情如你所願。法爾修斯和我會把所有人都留在這裡。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We'll keep training everyone who runs away from the Legion and Stormcloaks. I'm sure the real cowards will filter themselves out. The others... we'll help with any real threats when the time comes.
plugin.seed: 我们将继续训练每一个逃离军团和风暴斗篷的人。我相信真正的懦夫会把自己过滤掉的。其他人嘛...时机成熟时，我们将帮助他们应对任何真正的威胁。
plugin.target: 我們將繼續訓練每一個逃離軍團和風暴斗篷的人。我相信真正的懦夫會把自己過濾掉的。其他人嘛...時機成熟時，我們將幫助他們應對任何真正的威脅。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Thanks for giving us a chance, friend. Falcius and I are in your debt.
plugin.seed: 谢谢你给我们一个机会，朋友。法尔修斯和我欠你的债。
plugin.target: 謝謝你給我們一個機會，朋友。法爾修斯和我欠你的債。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Defeating Alduin really was something, wasn't it?
plugin.seed: 打败奥杜因真的很了不起，不是吗？
plugin.target: 打敗奧杜因真的很了不起，不是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah. You did great work, Thane.
plugin.seed: 是 啊。你做得很好，大人。
plugin.target: 是 啊。你做得很好，大人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How many more times do I have to save the world to earn your respect?
plugin.seed: 我还要拯救世界多少次才能赢得你的尊重？
plugin.target: 我還要拯救世界多少次才能贏得你的尊重？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Two.
plugin.seed: 两次。
plugin.target: 兩次。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Three times overall seems like a reasonable number. Then, maybe I’ll say “Honor to you, my Thane” every time I see you, like they told me I was supposed to.
plugin.seed: 总的来说，三次似乎是一个合理的数字。然后，也许我每次见到你都会说“向你致敬，我的武卫”，就像他们告诉我的那样。
plugin.target: 總的來說，三次似乎是一個合理的數字。然後，也許我每次見到你都會說“向你致敬，我的男爵”，就像他們告訴我的那樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd been fighting Alduin since I escaped Helgen, really.
plugin.seed: 从逃离圣地镇开始，我就一直在和奥杜因战斗。
plugin.target: 從逃離聖地鎮開始，我就一直在和奧杜因戰鬥。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's right. I wish I could have helped you in Bleak Falls Barrow and at the Western Watchtower.
plugin.seed: 是的。我希望我当时能在荒瀑古坟和西部哨塔帮助你。
plugin.target: 是的。我希望我當時能在荒瀑古墳和西部哨塔幫助你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I probably would have been even ruder to you before you became a Thane, but I'm sure I would have come around all the same.
plugin.seed: 在你成为武卫之前，我可能会对你稍微粗鲁一点，但我相信我还是回到现在这样。
plugin.target: 在你成為男爵之前，我可能會對你稍微粗魯一點，但我相信我還是回到現在這樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I wish I had your help at Skuldafn, and in Sovngarde.
plugin.seed: 我也希望在斯库达芬和松加德时能得到你的帮助。
plugin.target: 我也希望在斯庫達芬和松加德時能得到你的幫助。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I wish I could have seen it. I wish I could have...
plugin.seed: 我希望我能看到它。我希望我可以...
plugin.target: 我希望我能看到它。我希望我可以...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think you know what I'm going to say here.
plugin.seed: 我想你知道我在这里要说什么。
plugin.target: 我想你知道我在這裡要說什麼。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Really, I see my mother's face every day. Did... did you...?
plugin.seed: 真的，我每天都能看到我妈妈的脸。你看到了？
plugin.target: 真的，我每天都能看到我媽媽的臉。你看到了？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What was your favorite part?
plugin.seed: 你最喜欢的部分是什么？
plugin.target: 你最喜歡的部分是什麼？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I know you want me to say it was finding the Elder Scroll, but… we were on the floor of a Dwemer ruin. From now on, beds.
plugin.seed: 我知道你想让我说是在寻找上古卷轴，但是...我们当时在锻莫废墟的地板上。从现在起，是在床上。
plugin.target: 我知道你想讓我說是在尋找上古卷軸，但是...我們當時在鍛莫廢墟的地板上。從現在起，是在床上。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The whole idea of it was nicer than the experience.
plugin.seed: 整个想法比体验要好。
plugin.target: 整個想法比體驗要好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Honestly? Blackreach. That’s… really where I fell in love with you.
plugin.seed: 真的吗？黑降。那...其实是我爱上你的地方。
plugin.target: 真的嗎？黑降。那...其實是我愛上你的地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It was easily the most daunting thing we'd done up to that point, and we made it through because of each other.
plugin.seed: 这无疑是我们迄今为止所做的最令人生畏的事情，我们之所以能成功，是因为彼此。
plugin.target: 這無疑是我們迄今為止所做的最令人生畏的事情，我們之所以能成功，是因為彼此。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Somehow, that journey managed to beat it’s destination. Even though we were fighting through Falmer.
plugin.seed: 不知怎的，我们的旅程成功地到达了终点。尽管我们不断辗转于同伐莫的战斗。
plugin.target: 不知怎的，我們的旅程成功地到達了終點。儘管我們不斷輾轉於同伐莫的戰鬥。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Where it all began for us. The journey from Whiterun to Ivarstead.
plugin.seed: 这一切都是从我们开始的。从白漫到紫杉的旅程。
plugin.target: 這一切都是從我們開始的。從白漫到紫杉的旅程。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Seeing how strong your resolve really was, even back then... it restored a lot of the faith I'd lost in my homeland.
plugin.seed: 看到你的决心有多坚定，即使那时...它恢复了我对祖国失去的很多信心。
plugin.target: 看到你的決心有多堅定，即使那時...它恢復了我對祖國失去的很多信心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Wait, you, there’s specific training on how to address a Thane?
plugin.seed: 等等，你，有关于如何称呼武卫的具体培训吗？
plugin.target: 等等，你，有關於如何稱呼男爵的具體培訓嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yes, and it’s incredible stupid. Dumbest thing I’ve had to do as a housecarl.
plugin.seed: 有啊，那太愚蠢了。这是我作为一个侍卫不得不做的最愚蠢的事。
plugin.target: 有啊，那太愚蠢了。這是我作為一個侍衛不得不做的最愚蠢的事。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: All joking aside, I really do respect you, and I fully intend to keep you safe or die trying. I think that should be enough without all the pleasantries.
plugin.seed: 抛开玩笑不谈，我真的很尊重你，我完全打算保护你的安全，否则就死定了。我认为这应该足够了，没有开玩笑。
plugin.target: 拋開玩笑不談，我真的很尊重你，我完全打算保護你的安全，否則就死定了。我認為這應該足夠了，沒有開玩笑。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That’s rather demanding of you.
plugin.seed: 这对你的要求相当的高。
plugin.target: 這對你的要求相當的高。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I’m already willing to die for you. If you want that much more out of me, I don’t think it’s too much to ask.
plugin.seed: 我已经愿意为你而死了。如果你想从我身上得到更多，我认为要求并不过分。
plugin.target: 我已經願意為你而死了。如果你想從我身上得到更多，我認為要求並不過分。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What happens if I save the world four times over?
plugin.seed: 如果我四次拯救世界会发生什么？
plugin.target: 如果我四次拯救世界會發生什麼？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Guess.
plugin.seed: 猜猜看。
plugin.target: 猜猜看。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think stopping Ancano and Harkon counts…
plugin.seed: 我认为阻止安卡诺和哈孔很重要...
plugin.target: 我認為阻止安卡諾和哈孔很重要...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well then honor to you, my illustrious and noble Thane.
plugin.seed: 那好吧，尊敬的，我杰出而高尚的武卫大人，荣誉归于您。
plugin.target: 那好吧，尊敬的，我傑出而高尚的男爵大人，榮譽歸於您。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Could you imagine how annoying it would be if I acted like that all the time?
plugin.seed: 你能想象如果我一直这样做会有多烦人吗？
plugin.target: 你能想像如果我一直這樣做會有多煩人嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Lydia, you never stopped being rude to me.
plugin.seed: 莱迪亚，你一直都对我不礼貌。
plugin.target: 萊迪亞，你一直都對我不禮貌。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's an extreme exaggeration, and you know it.
plugin.seed: 你自己知道你说得有多夸张。
plugin.target: 你自己知道你說得有多誇張。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm just happy you're here now.
plugin.seed: 我只是很高兴你现在也在这里。
plugin.target: 我只是很高興你現在也在這裡。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Likewise. Thanks.
plugin.seed: 我也是。谢谢。
plugin.target: 我也是。謝謝。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I’m glad it’s over, but I’m glad we did it.
plugin.seed: 我很高兴这结束了，我很高兴我们做到了。
plugin.target: 我很高興這結束了，我很高興我們做到了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: A few months ago, I was guarding Jarl Balgruuf's children. I barely even got outside the walls of Whiterun.
plugin.seed: 几个月前，我在保护巴尔古夫领主的孩子。我甚至几乎没有走出白漫城的城墙。
plugin.target: 幾個月前，我在保護巴爾古夫領主的孩子。我甚至幾乎沒有走出白漫城的城牆。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And then I helped you save us all. I guess the other guards who told me not to become a housecarl were wrong.
plugin.seed: 然后我帮你救了我们所有人。我想那些叫我不要当侍卫的卫兵是错的。
plugin.target: 然後我幫你救了我們所有人。我想那些叫我不要當侍衛的衛兵是錯的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: There were a lot of warriors in Shor's Hall. I don't know if I saw her or not.
plugin.seed: 朔尔大厅里有很多战士。我不知道我有没有看到她。
plugin.target: 朔爾大廳裡有很多戰士。我不知道我有沒有看到她。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: All the same, I guess.
plugin.seed: 我想还是一样。
plugin.target: 我想還是一樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We know Sovngarde's real, and I know my mother wouldn't be anywhere else.
plugin.seed: 我们知道松加德是真的，我知道我妈妈不会在其他地方。
plugin.target: 我們知道松加德是真的，我知道我媽媽不會在其他地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Why did the other guards discourage you from becoming a housecarl?
plugin.seed: 为什么其他卫兵不鼓励你成为侍卫？
plugin.target: 為什麼其他衛兵不鼓勵你成為侍衛？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I thought I'd made it obvious - I'd be doing a whole lot of nothing if I hadn't gotten appointed to you.
plugin.seed: 我想我已经说得很清楚了——如果我没有被任命为你的侍卫的话，我什么都不会做。
plugin.target: 我想我已經說得很清楚了——如果我沒有被任命為你的侍衛的話，我什麼都不會做。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Being a guard can be... boring, but I at least moved around the hold a lot.
plugin.seed: 当卫兵可能...很无聊，至少我能在领地里转转。
plugin.target: 當衛兵可能...很無聊，至少我能在領地裡轉轉。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: As a housecarl, I got better equipment and spent more time training, at the cost of rarely leaving the city walls, let alone the Cloud Disctrict.
plugin.seed: 作为一名侍卫，我得到了更好的装备，花了更多的时间进行训练，代价是很少离开城内，更不用说云顶区了。
plugin.target: 作為一名侍衛，我得到了更好的裝備，花了更多的時間進行訓練，代價是很少離開城內，更不用說雲頂區了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I appreciate you saying that.
plugin.seed: 谢谢你这么说。
plugin.target: 謝謝你這麼說。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's a drop in the ocean with your ego.
plugin.seed: 你可自我多了。
plugin.target: 你可自我多了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Why do you think you had so little faith in Skyrim in the first place?
plugin.seed: 你当时为什么会对天际失去信念？
plugin.target: 你當時為什麼會對天霜失去信念？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Because so much effort is being committed to us killing each other and not enough towards actual threats.
plugin.seed: 因为我们付出了太多的努力来相互残杀，而对实际的威胁却付出不够。
plugin.target: 因為我們付出了太多的努力來相互殘殺，而對實際的威脅卻付出不夠。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Worse yet, the people who aren't in the fight have their heads in the clouds about the whole affair.
plugin.seed: 更糟糕的是，那些没有参与战斗的人对整个事件一无所知。
plugin.target: 更糟糕的是，那些沒有參與戰鬥的人對整個事件一無所知。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You seem like one of the only people on either side who wants Skyrim to go anywhere other than further into chaos.
plugin.seed: 你似乎是双方中唯一希望天际走向未来而非进一步陷入混乱的人之一。
plugin.target: 你似乎是雙方中唯一希望天霜走向未來而非進一步陷入混亂的人之一。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: There was so much falling apart outside of my control, and nothing I could do about it until I met you.
plugin.seed: 我无法控制的事情太多了，在见到你之前我对此无能为力。
plugin.target: 我無法控制的事情太多了，在見到你之前我對此無能為力。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You certainly have never been what anyone would expect a housecarl to be.
plugin.seed: 当然，你也从来都不像别人想象中的那种侍卫。
plugin.target: 當然，你也從來都不像別人想像中的那種侍衛。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Do the things I've said to you matter that much? I've never let you down with my actions. I've upheld my oath in every way except the formalities.
plugin.seed: 我对你说的话有那么重要吗？我的行为从来没有让你失望过。除了礼节这方面，我在所有方面都信守了我的誓言。
plugin.target: 我對你說的話有那麼重要嗎？我的行為從來沒有讓你失望過。除了禮節這方面，我在所有方面都信守了我的誓言。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And trust me, the formalities are boring.
plugin.seed: 相信我，那些礼节很无聊。
plugin.target: 相信我，那些禮節很無聊。
