plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: "Do you get out of the cloud district very often? Oh, what am I saying, of course you don't."
plugin.seed: "你常去云顶区吗？哦，我在说什么呀——你当然不常去了"
plugin.target: "你常去雲頂區嗎？哦，我在說什麼呀——你當然不常去了"
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That one was good.
plugin.seed: 这个不错。
plugin.target: 這個不錯。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Let's be on our way.
plugin.seed: 让我们上路吧。
plugin.target: 讓我們上路吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Of course.
plugin.seed: 当然。
plugin.target: 當然。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So you've come around about Serana?
plugin.seed: 这么说你对瑟拉娜有了新的认识？
plugin.target: 這麼說你對瑟拉娜有了新的認識？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Absolutely. She's a good woman - arguably a better woman than me.
plugin.seed: 当然。她是一个好女人——可以说是一个比我更好的女人。
plugin.target: 當然。她是一個好女人——可以說是一個比我更好的女人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Watching her go against her own family... I questioned it a lot at first. I don't need to tell you how important my family was to me.
plugin.seed: 看着她违背自己的家庭...起初我对此提出了很多质疑。我不需要告诉你我的家庭对我有多重要。
plugin.target: 看著她違背自己的家庭...起初我對此提出了很多質疑。我不需要告訴你我的家庭對我有多重要。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't know if I would have been able to do that. And I don't know how hard it is to resist the urge to drink our blood.
plugin.seed: 我不知道我是否能做到这一点。我不知道要忍住喝我们血的冲动有多难。
plugin.target: 我不知道我是否能做到這一點。我不知道要忍住喝我們血的衝動有多難。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: However hard it might have been, I convinced her to be cured.
plugin.seed: 无论多么难，我都会说服她接受治疗。
plugin.target: 無論多麼難，我都會說服她接受治療。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's certainly for the better. I'm sure immortality had its benefits, but...
plugin.seed: 这当然是更好的。我确信永生是有好处的，但是...
plugin.target: 這當然是更好的。我確信永生是有好處的，但是...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can't imagine what Vampirism must be like. They're servants of a monster, aren't they?
plugin.seed: 我无法想象吸血鬼会是什么样子。他们是怪物的仆人，不是吗？
plugin.target: 我無法想像吸血鬼會是什麼樣子。他們是怪物的僕人，不是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd be happy to travel with the two of you any time. Just tell Serana not to use frost magic when I might get caught in it.
plugin.seed: 我很乐意随时和你们两个一起旅行。只要告诉塞拉娜不要使用冰霜魔法，因为我可能会被打到。
plugin.target: 我很樂意隨時和你們兩個一起旅行。只要告訴塞拉娜不要使用冰霜魔法，因為我可能會被打到。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I certainly disagree with the comparison of you and her.
plugin.seed: 我当然不会把她和你相提并论。
plugin.target: 我當然不會把她和你相提並論。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You sure you never think about her dark hair, fair skin, and soft features when I'm not around?
plugin.seed: 你确定我不在的时候你从来没有想过她乌黑的头发、白皙的皮肤和柔软的五官吗？
plugin.target: 你確定我不在的時候你從來沒有想過她烏黑的頭髮、白皙的皮膚和柔軟的五官嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Surely you like the kind and caring way she speaks to you instead of my mockery and questioning?
plugin.seed: 你确定喜欢她对你说话的方式，而不是我的嘲笑和质疑吗？
plugin.target: 你確定喜歡她對你說話的方式，而不是我的嘲笑和質疑嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I have to respect your willingness to apologize to people...
plugin.seed: 你还知错就认......
plugin.target: 你還知錯就認......
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Pride doesn't get you as far in life as objectivity does.
plugin.seed: 在生活中，骄傲不会像客观事实那样让你走得更远。
plugin.target: 在生活中，驕傲不會像客觀事實那樣讓你走得更遠。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's never seemed like she was holding back from biting either of us.
plugin.seed: 她似乎也从来没有因为忍不住而咬过我们中的任何一个。
plugin.target: 她似乎也從來沒有因為忍不住而咬過我們中的任何一個。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't know much about vampires, but I'm not taking any risks.
plugin.seed: 我对吸血鬼了解不多，但我不会冒任何风险。
plugin.target: 我對吸血鬼瞭解不多，但我不會冒任何風險。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Shut your bloody mouth.
plugin.seed: 闭上你的臭嘴。
plugin.target: 閉上你的臭嘴。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Laughs* Fine.
plugin.seed: *大笑*好好。
plugin.target: *大笑*好好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm too busy thinking about you.
plugin.seed: 我正忙着想你呢。
plugin.target: 我正忙著想你呢。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I figured as much.
plugin.seed: 我也这么想。
plugin.target: 我也這麼想。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I care about Serana... a lot.
plugin.seed: 我在乎瑟拉娜......非常在乎。
plugin.target: 我在乎瑟拉娜......非常在乎。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Honestly, I've noticed. You've acted differently around her from the beginning. And I think she might feel the same way.
plugin.seed: 老实说，我注意到了。你从一开始就对她另眼相看。我想她可能也有同感。
plugin.target: 老實說，我注意到了。你從一開始就對她另眼相看。我想她可能也有同感。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You two deserve each other. Tell her your feelings.
plugin.seed: 你们两个如此般配。告诉她你的感受。
plugin.target: 你們兩個如此般配。告訴她你的感受。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I have, and she doesn't share them.
plugin.seed: 我的确试过，但她不这样想。
plugin.target: 我的確試過，但她不這樣想。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Sigh* I'm sorry, Thane. That's unfortunate.
plugin.seed: *叹气* 我很抱歉，大人。如此不幸。
plugin.target: *嘆氣* 我很抱歉，大人。如此不幸。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm... here for you, if you need to talk.
plugin.seed: 如果你需要谈谈的话，我...在这里等你。
plugin.target: 如果你需要談談的話，我...在這裡等你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I already have. It went... exceedingly well.
plugin.seed: 我已经试了。进展......非常顺利。
plugin.target: 我已經試了。進展......非常順利。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm happy for the both of you.
plugin.seed: 我为你们俩感到高兴。
plugin.target: 我為你們倆感到高興。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That was all I wanted to discuss.
plugin.seed: 这就是我想讨论的全部内容。
plugin.target: 這就是我想討論的全部內容。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Alright.
plugin.seed: 好吧。
plugin.target: 好吧。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: Sometimes I can't believe I have you all to myself.
plugin.seed: 有时我真不敢相信我拥有你们。
plugin.target: 有時我真不敢相信我擁有你們。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Congratulations. You just love to make me eat my words, don’t you?
plugin.seed: 恭喜。你只是喜欢让我收回我的话，不是吗？
plugin.target: 恭喜。你只是喜歡讓我收回我的話，不是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Pardon?
plugin.seed: 不好意思？
plugin.target: 不好意思？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I know next to nothing about magic, but I can tell you’re an incredible sorcerer. Even those of us who prefer strength and steel can respect that.
plugin.seed: 我对魔法几乎一无所知，但我可以说你是一个不可思议的法师。即使是我们这些喜欢力量和钢铁的人也可以尊重这一点。
plugin.target: 我對魔法幾乎一無所知，但我可以說你是一個不可思議的法師。即使是我們這些喜歡力量和鋼鐵的人也可以尊重這一點。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And I doubted you at first.
plugin.seed: 一开始我怀疑你。
plugin.target: 一開始我懷疑你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I doubted you, and you’re becoming even more skilled with a sword and shield than me.
plugin.seed: 我怀疑过你，而且你比我更熟练地使用剑和盾牌。
plugin.target: 我懷疑過你，而且你比我更熟練地使用劍和盾牌。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You know arming swords aren’t even a battlefield weapon, right? I only use one because it’s defensive.
plugin.seed: 你知道装备双剑并不是战场上的利器，知道吗？我只使用一个，因为它是防御性的。
plugin.target: 你知道裝備雙劍並不是戰場上的利器，知道嗎？我只使用一個，因為它是防禦性的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I doubted you, and now you’re cleaving your way through foe after foe.
plugin.seed: 我怀疑过你，现在你在一个又一个敌人面前开路。
plugin.target: 我懷疑過你，現在你在一個又一個敵人面前開路。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Then again, I’m the only reason you don’t need a free hand for a shield.
plugin.seed: 再说一遍，我是你不需要另一只手使用盾牌的唯一原因。
plugin.target: 再說一遍，我是你不需要另一隻手使用盾牌的唯一原因。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You’re a skilled archer. You could probably shoot the wings off a moth.
plugin.seed: 你是个熟练的弓箭手。你可能会射掉飞蛾的翅膀。
plugin.target: 你是個熟練的弓箭手。你可能會射掉飛蛾的翅膀。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You’re a skilled archer. You could probably shoot the wings off a moth.
plugin.seed: 你是个熟练的弓箭手。你可能会射掉飞蛾的翅膀。
plugin.target: 你是個熟練的弓箭手。你可能會射掉飛蛾的翅膀。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You’ve gotten to the point where one of your arms is bigger than the other.
plugin.seed: 你已经到了一只胳膊比另一只大的地步。
plugin.target: 你已經到了一隻胳膊比另一隻大的地步。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: …It’d probably be even worse if you didn’t have my help.
plugin.seed: ...如果没有我的帮助，情况可能会更糟。
plugin.target: ...如果沒有我的幫助，情況可能會更糟。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: No one would get close to me either way. You just rush in out of bravado.
plugin.seed: 不管怎样，都不会有人靠近我。你只是虚张声势地冲进来。
plugin.target: 不管怎樣，都不會有人靠近我。你只是虛張聲勢地衝進來。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Alright, I’m not sure if I like using the words “rush in”.
plugin.seed: 好吧，我不确定我是否喜欢用“冲进来”这个词。
plugin.target: 好吧，我不確定我是否喜歡用“衝進來”這個詞。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think it’s good for what we do, since we tend to fight a lot of opponents.
plugin.seed: 我认为这对我们的工作有好处，因为我们往往会与很多对手作战。
plugin.target: 我認為這對我們的工作有好處，因為我們往往會與很多對手作戰。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It’s worked out well enough for us so far, at least.
plugin.seed: 至少到目前为止，这对我们来说已经足够好了。
plugin.target: 至少到目前為止，這對我們來說已經足夠好了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I think I've barely stratched the surface of the Arcane.
plugin.seed: 我想我对魔法的了解还很浅显。
plugin.target: 我想我對魔法的瞭解還很淺顯。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: A modest wizard. Unbelievable.
plugin.seed: 谦逊的法师。难以置信。
plugin.target: 謙遜的法師。難以置信。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Bold of you to even consider weapons and armor a worthy comparison to magic.
plugin.seed: 你可真大胆，竟然把武器和盔甲与魔法相提并论。
plugin.target: 你可真大膽，竟然把武器和盔甲與魔法相提並論。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Just take the compliment, for Shor's sake.
plugin.seed: 看在朔尔的份上，就当这是赞美吧。
plugin.target: 看在朔爾的份上，就當這是讚美吧。

plugin.source: I followed your example.
plugin.seed: 我以你为榜样。
plugin.target: 我以你為榜樣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'll take the credit if you insist.
plugin.seed: 如果你坚持的话，我将承担责任。
plugin.target: 如果你堅持的話，我將承擔責任。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Figures, since you can’t seem to take your eyes off me.
plugin.seed: 嗯，因为你似乎无法将目光从我身上移开。
plugin.target: 嗯，因為你似乎無法將目光從我身上移開。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That’s why I use maces and axes.
plugin.seed: 这就是我使用钉锤和斧头的原因。
plugin.target: 這就是我使用釘錘和斧頭的原因。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Fair point.
plugin.seed: 有道理。
plugin.target: 有道理。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Is fighting as a team that strange of a concept?
plugin.seed: 作为一个团队作战是一个奇怪的概念吗？
plugin.target: 作為一個團隊作戰是一個奇怪的概念嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well no, but using you wife as bait is.
plugin.seed: 好吧，不，但利用你的妻子作为诱饵是。
plugin.target: 好吧，不，但利用你的妻子作為誘餌是。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: No, but I still don’t think you give me enough credit.
plugin.seed: 没有，但我还是觉得你不够信任我。
plugin.target: 沒有，但我還是覺得你不夠信任我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Better than rushing in head-on.
plugin.seed: 总比横冲直撞好。
plugin.target: 總比橫衝直撞好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Very true. You’ve only gotten as good as you are because you’ve had me to do that for you. Be honest with yourself.
plugin.seed: 非常正确。你之所以变得如此优秀，是因为你让我为你做了这件事。对自己诚实一点。
plugin.target: 非常正確。你之所以變得如此優秀，是因為你讓我為你做了這件事。對自己誠實一點。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: A shield. When you already have a whole sword blade and heavy armor to defend with.
plugin.seed: 一个盾牌。当你已经有一整把剑刃和厚重的盔甲可以防御的时候。
plugin.target: 一個盾牌。當你已經有一整把劍刃和厚重的盔甲可以防禦的時候。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Do you remember what my profession is?
plugin.seed: 你还记得我的职业是什么吗？
plugin.target: 你還記得我的職業是什麼嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Your assistance is always appreciated.
plugin.seed: 我永远感激你的帮助。
plugin.target: 我永遠感激你的幫助。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Thank you.
plugin.seed: 谢谢你。
plugin.target: 謝謝你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It seemed like a useful supplement for normal weapons.
plugin.seed: 它是普通武器的好搭档。
plugin.target: 它是普通武器的好搭檔。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Maybe I should learn a spell or two, then. Can’t be that hard.
plugin.seed: 也许我应该学一两个法术的。不可能那么难。

plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Because I would have to shoot more arrows if you weren’t helping me fight?
plugin.seed: 因为如果你不帮我战斗，我就得多射箭了？
plugin.target: 因為如果你不幫我戰鬥，我就得多射箭了？

plugin.source: Uh, sure. We’ll go with that.
plugin.seed: 噢，当然。我们会处理好的。
plugin.target: 噢，當然。我們會處理好的。

plugin.source: As if I get enough “help”.
plugin.seed: 好像我得到了足够的“帮助”。
plugin.target: 好像我得到了足夠的“幫助”。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Just ask me more often, then. Mara’s mercy…

plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well, you insist on “helping” me a lot more than I need it…
plugin.seed: 好吧，你坚持要“帮助”我的比我所需要的多得多...
plugin.target: 好吧，你堅持要“幫助”我的比我所需要的多得多...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You could always just say no, Thane.
plugin.seed: 你随时可以说不的，大人。
plugin.target: 你隨時可以說不的，大人。

plugin.source: Well, we've come far... but if anything, there's a lot more out there waiting for us. Let's be on our way.

plugin.target: 好吧，我們已經走了很遠...但如果有什麼不同的話，還有更多的事情在等著我們。讓我們上路吧。

plugin.source: Lydia, you mentioned knowing some of the guards who died at the Western Watchtower...
plugin.seed: 莱迪亚，你提到过你认识一些死于西部哨塔的卫兵...
plugin.target: 萊迪亞，你提到過你認識一些死於西部哨塔的衛兵...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah... if you insist on interrogating that out of me, I'll talk about it.
plugin.seed: 是啊...如果你坚持要审问我，我会说的。
plugin.target: 是啊...如果你堅持要審問我，我會說的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If you really don't want to...
plugin.seed: 如果你真的不想的话...
plugin.target: 如果你真的不想的話...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Thor was only 19, but he was as Nordic as they come. Fought with a battleaxe, drank a lot - but mead never made him violent. He always had his temper under control.
plugin.seed: 托尔只有19岁，但他和他们一样的“诺德”。与战斧搏斗，喝了很多酒——但蜂蜜酒从来没有让他变得暴力。他总是控制住自己的脾气。
plugin.target: 托爾只有19歲，但他和他們一樣的“諾德”。與戰斧搏鬥，喝了很多酒——但蜂蜜酒從來沒有讓他變得暴力。他總是控制住自己的脾氣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Faldir was an older man with a wife and teenaged son. He'd been guarding the city all the way through the Great War. He said he regretted not going when he was younger, but had gotten over it.
plugin.seed: 法迪尔年纪较大，有妻子和十几岁的儿子。在第一次大战期间，他一直守卫着这座城市。他说，他后悔年轻时没去，但已经过去了。
plugin.target: 法迪爾年紀較大，有妻子和十幾歲的兒子。在第一次大戰期間，他一直守衛著這座城市。他說，他後悔年輕時沒去，但已經過去了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Hroki was one of the only other women in the guard. She was about a decade older than me. She... was almost a mentor.
plugin.seed: 霍洛基是警卫中仅有的其他女性之一。她比我大十岁。（对我来说）她...几乎是一位导师。
plugin.target: 霍洛基是警衛中僅有的其他女性之一。她比我大十歲。（對我來說）她...幾乎是一位導師。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Jorving was smarter than what you'd expect from someone in that profession. He was very well-versed in the history of Skyrim, Morrowind, and Cyrodiil. He'd told me plenty of stories while we were on watch together.
plugin.seed: 乔文比你所期望的那个职业的人更聪明。他对天际、晨风和赛瑞迪尔的历史非常熟悉。当我们一起值班时，他给我讲了很多故事。
plugin.target: 喬文比你所期望的那個職業的人更聰明。他對天霜、晨風和賽瑞迪爾的歷史非常熟悉。當我們一起值班時，他給我講了很多故事。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Asvald reminded me of my father. Grew up as a petty thief in Windhelm, but turned his life around. I don't know how he survived living on those streets in the cold...
plugin.seed: 阿斯瓦德让我想起了我的父亲。在风盔城成长为一个小偷，但他改变了自己的生活。我不知道他是如何在寒冷的街道上生存下来的...
plugin.target: 阿斯瓦德讓我想起了我的父親。在風盔城成長為一個小偷，但他改變了自己的生活。我不知道他是如何在寒冷的街道上生存下來的...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How is this an "interrogation"?
plugin.seed: 这怎么是“审问”？
plugin.target: 這怎麼是“審問”？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You know what? I'll just tell you.
plugin.seed: 你知道吗？我马上告诉你。
plugin.target: 你知道嗎？我馬上告訴你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They sound like good people. I'm sorry I couldn't save them.
plugin.seed: 他们听起来像好人。很抱歉我没能救他们。
plugin.target: 他們聽起來像好人。很抱歉我沒能救他們。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They were. And I know you would have saved them if you could have.
plugin.seed: 他们是的。我知道如果你能的话，你会救他们的。
plugin.target: 他們是的。我知道如果你能的話，你會救他們的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Were you close with them?
plugin.seed: 你和他们关系密切吗？
plugin.target: 你和他們關係密切嗎？

plugin.source: Somewhat.
plugin.seed: 有点。
plugin.target: 有點。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I thought you didn't want to talk about this...

plugin.target: 我以為你不想談論這個...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well, Thane, I... I wasn't that close with any of them.
plugin.seed: 嗯，大人，我...我和他们中的任何一个都没那么亲密。
plugin.target: 嗯，大人，我...我和他們中的任何一個都沒那麼親密。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've told you about my parents, haven't I? No reason for me not to tell you about them.

plugin.target: 我已經告訴過你我父母的事了，不是嗎？我沒有理由不告訴你他們的事。

plugin.source: Let's... be on our way.
plugin.seed: 让我们...走我们的路吧。
plugin.target: 讓我們...走我們的路吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Lydia, remember when we talked about the guards who fell at the Western Watchtower?
plugin.seed: 莱迪亚，还记得我们谈论在西部哨塔倒下的卫兵吗？
plugin.target: 萊迪亞，還記得我們談論在西部哨塔倒下的衛兵嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah... but you know what? I think you've heard me talk about myself more than enough. Maybe it's time I learned about you.

plugin.target: 是啊...但你知道嗎？我想你聽我談論我自己已經夠多了。也許是時候瞭解你了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Where are you from, anyway?
plugin.seed: 你是哪里人？
plugin.target: 你是哪裡人？

plugin.source: Skyrim.
plugin.seed: 天际。
plugin.target: 天霜。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: At long last...

plugin.target: 終於...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Honestly? Blackreach. That's... really where I fell in love with you.
plugin.seed: 真的？黑降。那..其实是我爱上你的地方。
plugin.target: 真的？黑降。那..其實是我愛上你的地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It was easily the most daunting thing we'd done up to that point, and we made it through because of each other.
plugin.seed: 这无疑是我们迄今为止所做的最令人生畏的事情，我们之所以能成功，是因为彼此。
plugin.target: 這無疑是我們迄今為止所做的最令人生畏的事情，我們之所以能成功，是因為彼此。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Somehow, that journey managed to beat it’s destination. Even though we were fighting through Falmer.
plugin.seed: 不知怎的，我们的旅程成功地到达了终点。尽管我们不断辗转于同伐莫的战斗。
plugin.target: 不知怎的，我們的旅程成功地到達了終點。儘管我們不斷輾轉於同伐莫的戰鬥。

plugin.source: Fine, you want me to keep talking about the guards who died? Well like I said, I wasn't that close with them.
plugin.seed: 好吧，你想让我继续谈论那些死去的警卫吗？就像我说的，我和他们没那么亲近。
plugin.target: 好吧，你想讓我繼續談論那些死去的警衛嗎？就像我說的，我和他們沒那麼親近。

plugin.source: I lived in that city for 10 years; 4 as a guard and 6 as a housecarl. I didn't really get close to anyone in that time.
plugin.seed: 我在那个城市住了10年；4年警卫，6年管家。在那段时间里，我并没有真正接近任何人。
plugin.target: 我在那個城市住了10年；4年警衛，6年管家。在那段時間裡，我並沒有真正接近任何人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm just... I'm not great with people.
plugin.seed: 我只是...不善于与人相处。
plugin.target: 我只是...不善於與人相處。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It sounds like you're angry at me for this...
plugin.seed: 听起来你对我很生气...
plugin.target: 聽起來你對我很生氣...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well, I'm not.

plugin.target: 好吧，我沒有。

plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: To a degree, yes. And to tell you the truth, I did actually blame you for the loss. At least partially.
plugin.seed: 在某种程度上，是的。说实话，我确实把损失归咎于你。至少部分。
plugin.target: 在某種程度上，是的。說實話，我確實把損失歸咎於你。至少部分。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I know it wasn't your fault, though.
plugin.seed: 不过我知道这不是你的错。
plugin.target: 不過我知道這不是你的錯。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What about me? We've worked together for a little while now.
plugin.seed: 那我呢？我们已经合作了一段时间了。
plugin.target: 那我呢？我們已經合作了一段時間了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't know, Thane. I really don't.
plugin.seed: 我不知道，大人。我真的不知道。
plugin.target: 我不知道，大人。我真的不知道。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Let's just... let's get going.
plugin.seed: 那我们就...我们开始吧。
plugin.target: 那我們就...我們開始吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So I'm guessing you're over your fear of attachments?
plugin.seed: 所以我猜你已经不再害怕依恋了？
plugin.target: 所以我猜你已經不再害怕依戀了？

plugin.source: I love you, and that has me terrified.
plugin.seed: 我爱你，这让我很害怕。
plugin.target: 我愛你，這讓我很害怕。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You've fought at least one dragon at this point, Lydia. It can't be that bad.
plugin.seed: 在这一点上，你至少打过一条龙，莱迪亚。不会那么糟糕。
plugin.target: 在這一點上，你至少打過一條龍，萊迪亞。不會那麼糟糕。

plugin.seed: 你可能没有意识到这一点，但我并不那么害怕死亡。
plugin.target: 你可能沒有意識到這一點，但我並不那麼害怕死亡。

plugin.source: In that case, I admire your bravery.

plugin.source: I admire your bravery as well, among many other things about you.

plugin.target: 我也欽佩你的勇敢，以及你的許多其他優點。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.seed: 我保证不会死。
plugin.target: 我保證不會死。

plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.target: 這就是你為什麼一有機會就嘲笑我的原因嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm... sorry. Thane... you know what we have means the world to me, I do that because...

plugin.source: Honestly, I kind of like that about you. It's more fun that way.
plugin.seed: 老实说，我有点喜欢你。这样更有趣。
plugin.target: 老實說，我有點喜歡你。這樣更有趣。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Oh... oh, you were doing it to me just then, weren't you? You're too much.
plugin.seed: 噢...噢，你刚才对我这么做了，不是吗？你太过分了。
plugin.target: 噢...噢，你剛才對我這麼做了，不是嗎？你太過分了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Still afraid of getting too close, aren't you?
plugin.seed: 你还是害怕离得太近，不是吗？
plugin.target: 你還是害怕離得太近，不是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Just a little bit.
plugin.seed: 还有一点。
plugin.target: 還有一點。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I understand. Don't worry about it.
plugin.seed: 我理解。别担心。
plugin.target: 我理解。別擔心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Done.
plugin.seed: 结束了。
plugin.target: 結束了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: How have you been doing since we dealt with Vonjar?
plugin.seed: 自从我们和冯贾尔打交道以来，你过得怎么样？
plugin.target: 自從我們和馮賈爾打交道以來，你過得怎麼樣？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Fine. Vonjar... needed to die. The Red-Tundras were brutal. I had that proved to me first-hand too many times.
plugin.seed: 很好。冯贾尔...需要去死。红苔氏很残忍。我已经多次为我自己证明了这一点。
plugin.target: 很好。馮賈爾...需要去死。紅苔氏很殘忍。我已經多次為我自己證明了這一點。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If I hadn't gotten away when they raided my family's house... I...
plugin.seed: 如果他们突袭我家时我没有逃走...我...
plugin.target: 如果他們突襲我家時我沒有逃走...我...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I really don't want to think about that, Lydia.
plugin.seed: 我真的不想去想那个，莉莱迪亚。
plugin.target: 我真的不想去想那個，莉萊迪亞。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah. Neither do I.
plugin.seed: 是啊。我也不想。
plugin.target: 是啊。我也不想。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: No regrets over seeking vengence instead of burying the hatchet?
plugin.seed: 以牙还牙，后悔吗？
plugin.target: 以牙還牙，後悔嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Absolutely not. Skyrim is a better place without clan Red-Tundra.
plugin.seed: 当然不会。没有红苔氏族，天际是一个更好的地方。
plugin.target: 當然不會。沒有紅苔氏族，天霜是一個更好的地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Do you think this eased the loss of your parents?
plugin.seed: 你认为这减轻了你失去父母的痛苦吗？
plugin.target: 你認為這減輕了你失去父母的痛苦嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: First off, we were doing what we had to do for Whiterun Hold. But maybe it didn't.
plugin.seed: 首先，我们是为白漫领做我们必须做的事情。但也许这没有减轻这种痛苦。
plugin.target: 首先，我們是為白漫領做我們必須做的事情。但也許這沒有減輕這種痛苦。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Killing that bastard, Vonjar - it didn't show me that there are still things in Skyrim worth fighting for, or that it's safe to have friends again.
plugin.seed: 杀死那个混蛋，冯贾尔——这并没有让我明白，在天际还有值得为之奋斗的东西，也没有让我知道，再次拥有朋友是安全的。
plugin.target: 殺死那個混蛋，馮賈爾——這並沒有讓我明白，在天霜還有值得為之奮鬥的東西，也沒有讓我知道，再次擁有朋友是安全的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You did all that, Thane.
plugin.seed: 是你做到的这一切，大人。
plugin.target: 是你做到的這一切，大人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I thought you were still afraid...
plugin.seed: 我还以为你还在害怕...
plugin.target: 我還以為你還在害怕...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I am. But I can think of a few reasons to not let fear control my life.
plugin.seed: 我是在。但我能想出几个理由不让恐惧控制我的生活。
plugin.target: 我是在。但我能想出幾個理由不讓恐懼控制我的生活。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'll take the credit if you insist.
plugin.seed: 如果你坚持的话，我将承担责任。
plugin.target: 如果你堅持的話，我將承擔責任。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: This time, I'm actually certain that you deserve it.
plugin.seed: 这一次，我确信这是你应得的。
plugin.target: 這一次，我確信這是你應得的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I hadn't noticed.
plugin.seed: 我没有注意到。
plugin.target: 我沒有注意到。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You've done a lot more than you realize.
plugin.seed: 你做的比你意识到的要多得多。
plugin.target: 你做的比你意識到的要多得多。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah, Last time we shared a bedroll up here, you clung to me as tightly as you possibly could.
plugin.seed: 是的，上次我们在这里共享铺盖卷时，你尽可能紧紧地抓住我。
plugin.target: 是的，上次我們在這裡共享鋪蓋卷時，你儘可能緊緊地抓住我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Your wife showed you love and affection. Stendarr, preserve us.
plugin.seed: 你妻子向你表达了爱意。斯坦达尔，保护我们。
plugin.target: 你妻子向你表達了愛意。斯坦達爾，保護我們。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...There's barely space for the both of us in those things, anyway.
plugin.seed: ……不管怎样，在这些事情上几乎没有我们两个人的空间。
plugin.target: ……不管怎樣，在這些事情上幾乎沒有我們兩個人的空間。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's a bit strange how you talk to me like you don't even like being married, but can't keep your hands off me.
plugin.seed: 你和我说话有点奇怪，好像你甚至不喜欢结婚，但又不能把手从我身上移开。
plugin.target: 你和我說話有點奇怪，好像你甚至不喜歡結婚，但又不能把手從我身上移開。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Sigh* Gods, I... I know what you're talking about. And it's not easy for me to explain.
plugin.seed: *叹气* 天啊，我…我知道你在说什么。这我不好解释。
plugin.target: *嘆氣* 天啊，我…我知道你在說什麼。這我不好解釋。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's so cold in this part of the province...
plugin.seed: 这个省的这个地方太冷了...
plugin.target: 這個省的這個地方太冷了...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I get claustrophobic like that.
plugin.seed: 我有那种幽闭恐惧症。
plugin.target: 我有那種幽閉恐懼症。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's better than being cold... but I'll try to take it down a notch.
plugin.seed: 这比冷要好...但我会努力把它降低一个档次。
plugin.target: 這比冷要好...但我會努力把它降低一個檔次。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I have a hard time sleeping without you there. I get too anxious. I've panicked when I woke up alone a few times.
plugin.seed: 没有你在，我很难入睡。我太焦虑了。有几次我一个人醒来时都很惊慌。
plugin.target: 沒有你在，我很難入睡。我太焦慮了。有幾次我一個人醒來時都很驚慌。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Knowing that you're safe makes me feel so much better.
plugin.seed: 知道你很安全让我感觉好多了。
plugin.target: 知道你很安全讓我感覺好多了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Because you're afraid of losing me.
plugin.seed: 因为你害怕失去我。
plugin.target: 因為你害怕失去我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...You hit the nail on the head.
plugin.seed: ......你真是一针见血。
plugin.target: ......你真是一針見血。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I never said I didn't like it.
plugin.seed: 我从来没有说过我不喜欢它。
plugin.target: 我從來沒有說過我不喜歡它。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Laughs* I was wondering why you were complaining after how enthuisastic you seemed last night.
plugin.seed: *笑* 我想知道你昨晚表现得如此热情，为什么还要抱怨。
plugin.target: *笑* 我想知道你昨晚表現得如此熱情，為什麼還要抱怨。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What does that have to do with the way you talk to me?
plugin.seed: 这和你和我说话的方式有什么关系？
plugin.target: 這和你和我說話的方式有什麼關係？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Because... even after getting married, I'm still scared. We've been over this.
plugin.seed: 因为即使结婚了，我还是很害怕。我们已经解决了这个问题。
plugin.target: 因為即使結婚了，我還是很害怕。我們已經解決了這個問題。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can't lose anyone if I don't get close to anyone. Now I'm as close to you as I can get.
plugin.seed: 如果我不靠近任何人，我就不会失去任何人。现在我已经尽我所能接近你了。
plugin.target: 如果我不靠近任何人，我就不會失去任何人。現在我已經盡我所能接近你了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You do really make me feel safe, Lydia.
plugin.seed: 你确实让我感到安全，莱迪亚。
plugin.target: 你確實讓我感到安全，萊迪亞。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You have no idea how happy it makes me to hear you say that.
plugin.seed: 你不知道听到你这么说我有多高兴。
plugin.target: 你不知道聽到你這麼說我有多高興。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And now you're caught between wanting to be as close as you can and not wanting to be close at all.
plugin.seed: 现在，你陷入了想要尽可能接近和根本不想接近之间的困境。
plugin.target: 現在，你陷入了想要儘可能接近和根本不想接近之間的困境。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Exactly. I know it's irrational, but...
plugin.seed: 是的。我知道这是不合理的，但是...
plugin.target: 是的。我知道這是不合理的，但是...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I also lost my parents, you know...
plugin.seed: 我也失去了父母，你知道的...
plugin.target: 我也失去了父母，你知道的...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah, and you don't act like I do. I know. I'm having a hard time approaching this rationally.
plugin.seed: 是的，而且你并没有像我那样做。我知道。我很难理性地对待这个问题。
plugin.target: 是的，而且你並沒有像我那樣做。我知道。我很難理性地對待這個問題。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Is it that hard for you to explain this?
plugin.seed: 你这么难解释吗？
plugin.target: 你這麼難解釋嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yes, because the way am acting doesn't make sense, and I'm not sure how to fix that.
plugin.seed: 是的，因为我的表达方式没有意义，我不知道该怎么解决。
plugin.target: 是的，因為我的表達方式沒有意義，我不知道該怎麼解決。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Even beyond just being a housecarl, you're here for me constantly, and it means everything to me.
plugin.seed: 即使只是一个管家，你也会一直在我身边，这对我来说意味着一切。
plugin.target: 即使只是一個管家，你也會一直在我身邊，這對我來說意味著一切。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Mara's mercy, I'll just say it... *laughs* I want to ride you like a stolen horse right now.
plugin.seed: 玛拉仁慈，我只想说...*笑*....我现在想像偷来的马一样骑着你。
plugin.target: 瑪拉仁慈，我只想說...*笑*....我現在想像偷來的馬一樣騎著你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Being irrational is the least of your problems.
plugin.seed: 不理智是你的问题中最小的一个了。
plugin.target: 不理智是你的問題中最小的一個了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Such an endearing husband.
plugin.seed: 真是可爱的丈夫。
plugin.target: 真是可愛的丈夫。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Such an endearing wife.
plugin.seed: 真是可爱的妻子。
plugin.target: 真是可愛的妻子。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're human, Lydia. Not everything you do will be rational. I love you all the same.
plugin.seed: 你是人，莱迪亚。并不是你做的每件事都是理性的。我依然爱你。
plugin.target: 你是人，萊迪亞。並不是你做的每件事都是理性的。我依然愛你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I love you, too. And thank you.
plugin.seed: 我也爱你。谢谢你。
plugin.target: 我也愛你。謝謝你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Everyone reacts to things differently. Don't get hung up over it.
plugin.seed: 每个人对事物的反应都不一样。不要为它而烦恼。
plugin.target: 每個人對事物的反應都不一樣。不要為它而煩惱。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Sigh* Thanks. Can we... not talk about this anymore?
plugin.seed: *叹气* 谢谢。我们...能不再谈论这个了？
plugin.target: *嘆氣* 謝謝。我們...能不再談論這個了？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If you know it doesn't make sense, why do you act that way?
plugin.seed: 如果你知道这没有道理，你为什么要这样做？
plugin.target: 如果你知道這沒有道理，你為什麼要這樣做？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't know... damn it, you knew what you were getting into when we got married.
plugin.seed: 我不知道...该死，当我们结婚的时候，你就知道自己陷入了什么境地。
plugin.target: 我不知道...該死，當我們結婚的時候，你就知道自己陷入了什麼境地。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Ysmir's beard, from the moment we met, I doubted what was probably the most significant thing in your life. You knew what you were getting into.
plugin.seed: 伊斯米尔的胡子，从我们见面的那一刻起，我就怀疑你生命中最重要的事情是什么。你知道自己陷入了什么境地。
plugin.target: 伊斯米爾的鬍子，從我們見面的那一刻起，我就懷疑你生命中最重要的事情是什麼。你知道自己陷入了什麼境地。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: ...I'll get us a room.
plugin.seed: …我给我们找个房间。
plugin.target: …我給我們找個房間。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Laughs* Perfect.
plugin.seed: *笑* 太棒了。
plugin.target: *笑* 太棒了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Please calm down.
plugin.seed: 请冷静下来。
plugin.target: 請冷靜下來。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Sigh* You can just say you're not in the mood.
plugin.seed: *叹气* 你可以说你没有心情。
plugin.target: *嘆氣* 你可以說你沒有心情。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Why are you giving me that look...?
plugin.seed: 你为什么那样看我。。。？
plugin.target: 你為什麼那樣看我。。。？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What look? I...
plugin.seed: 看什么？我...
plugin.target: 看什麼？我...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Let's be on our way.
plugin.seed: 让我们上路吧。
plugin.target: 讓我們上路吧。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm more excited than ever to keep travelling with you.
plugin.seed: 我比以往任何时候都更兴奋能继续和你一起旅行。
plugin.target: 我比以往任何時候都更興奮能繼續和你一起旅行。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The most significant thing in my life was marrying you.
plugin.seed: 我一生中最重要的事情就是嫁给你。
plugin.target: 我一生中最重要的事情就是嫁給你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well, I'm flattered to hear you say that, but I'd appreciated if you stopped picking me apart like a Thalmor Justicar.
plugin.seed: 听到你这么说我很荣幸，但如果你不再像梭默审判官那样挑剔我，我将不胜感激。
plugin.target: 聽到你這麼說我很榮幸，但如果你不再像梭默審判官那樣挑剔我，我將不勝感激。

plugin.source: You know I love you. Why do you have to make this difficult?
plugin.seed: 你知道我爱你。你为什么要让这件事变得困难？
plugin.target: 你知道我愛你。你為什麼要讓這件事變得困難？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah, we're *married*. I'd expect your tone to have changed by now.
plugin.seed: 是的，我们结婚了。我希望你的语气现在已经改变了。
plugin.target: 是的，我們結婚了。我希望你的語氣現在已經改變了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I really don't want to have this conversation anymore, okay?

plugin.source: So you forgive me?
plugin.seed: 所以你原谅我了吗？
plugin.target: 所以你原諒我了嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You've accepted all my apologies graciously enough, so yes.
plugin.seed: 你已经很礼貌地接受了我所有的道歉，所以是的。
plugin.target: 你已經很禮貌地接受了我所有的道歉，所以是的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I also appreciate the fact that you tried.
plugin.seed: 我也很感激你的努力。
plugin.target: 我也很感激你的努力。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Want to get going?
plugin.seed: 想出发吗？
plugin.target: 想出發嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah. Just... don't get involved with anything morally questionable again.
plugin.seed: 是啊。只是不要再卷入任何道德上有问题的事情。
plugin.target: 是啊。只是不要再捲入任何道德上有問題的事情。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: What about, you know... us?
plugin.seed: 那，你知道吗...我们？
plugin.target: 那，你知道嗎...我們？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I... thought that went without saying.
plugin.seed: 我…我想那是不言而喻的。
plugin.target: 我…我想那是不言而喻的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It... crushed me to see that you weren't the person I thought you were. I loved that person, Thane.
plugin.seed: 看到你不是我想象中的那个人，我崩溃了。我爱那个人，大人。
plugin.target: 看到你不是我想像中的那個人，我崩潰了。我愛那個人，大人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That's... how I figured out about this problem. I haven't been able sleep, so I investigated.
plugin.seed: 那是...我是如何解决这个问题的。我一直睡不着，所以我调查了一下。
plugin.target: 那是...我是如何解決這個問題的。我一直睡不著，所以我調查了一下。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'll keep travelling with you, but after what happened... what you did to me... I don't think I'm ready to be yours again. I'm sorry.
plugin.seed: 我会继续和你一起旅行，但在发生了什么之后...你对我所做的...我想我还没有准备好再次成为你的人。我很抱歉。
plugin.target: 我會繼續和你一起旅行，但在發生了什麼之後...你對我所做的...我想我還沒有準備好再次成為你的人。我很抱歉。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I am the person you fell in love with, I promise. There has to be some way I can prove that to you.
plugin.seed: 我保证，我就是你爱上的那个人。我必须有办法向你证明这一点。
plugin.target: 我保證，我就是你愛上的那個人。我必須有辦法向你證明這一點。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I just don't know, Thane. I'll... think about it.
plugin.seed: 我只是不知道，大人。我会...再考虑这个的。
plugin.target: 我只是不知道，大人。我會...再考慮這個的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I thought about you a lot when you left, yeah.
plugin.seed: 你离开的时候我很想你，是的。
plugin.target: 你離開的時候我很想你，是的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm sure you did.
plugin.seed: 我相信你在想我。
plugin.target: 我相信你在想我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That was rude, I'm sorry. If we're being honest, I missed you, too.
plugin.seed: 那太粗鲁了，对不起。老实说，我也想你。
plugin.target: 那太粗魯了，對不起。老實說，我也想你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've moved on.
plugin.seed: 我已经改变了。
plugin.target: 我已經改變了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I... understand. I won't bring this up again.
plugin.seed: 我…明白了。我不会再提这个了。
plugin.target: 我…明白了。我不會再提這個了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: "Rude". Sounds more like you think we're already back together.
plugin.seed: “粗鲁”。听起来更像是你认为我们已经复合了。
plugin.target: “粗魯”。聽起來更像是你認為我們已經複合了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: There's something I need you to do first.
plugin.seed: 有件事我需要你先去做。
plugin.target: 有件事我需要你先去做。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So are you willing to start this up again?
plugin.seed: 那么你愿意重新开始吗？
plugin.target: 那麼你願意重新開始嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Not quite yet.
plugin.seed: 还没有。
plugin.target: 還沒有。
plugin.provenance: Skyrim Traditional Chinese 8.20 exact English-text match

plugin.source: If there's a cure for vampirism, you need to find it. I... won't do this with you.
plugin.seed: 如果有治疗吸血鬼病的方法，你需要找到它。我...不会和你一起做的。
plugin.target: 如果有治療吸血鬼病的方法，你需要找到它。我...不會和你一起做的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Daedra you served - if you have anything from them, you need to get rid of it. Throw it in the ocean.
plugin.seed: 你服务的魔神——如果你从他们那获得了任何东西，你需要把它扔掉。把它扔到海里。
plugin.target: 你服務的魔神——如果你從他們那獲得了任何東西，你需要把它扔掉。把它扔到海里。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've thought hard about this, and I think it's the only solution. You're going to have to kill everyone else in the Thieves' Guild.
plugin.seed: 我已经仔细考虑过了，我认为这是唯一的解决方案。你将不得不杀死盗贼公会中的其他人。
plugin.target: 我已經仔細考慮過了，我認為這是唯一的解決方案。你將不得不殺死盜賊公會中的其他人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I've thought hard about this, and I think it's the only solution. You're going to have to kill everyone else in the Dark Brotherhood.
plugin.seed: 我已经仔细考虑过了，我认为这是唯一的解决方案。你将不得不杀死黑暗兄弟会中的其他人。
plugin.target: 我已經仔細考慮過了，我認為這是唯一的解決方案。你將不得不殺死黑暗兄弟會中的其他人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm sorry, but that just isn't worth it for me.
plugin.seed: 对不起，但这对我来说不值得。
plugin.target: 對不起，但這對我來說不值得。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Sigh* I want to walk away again. I really do.
plugin.seed: *叹气*我想再次离开。我真的会。
plugin.target: *嘆氣*我想再次離開。我真的會。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: But I won't let my personal feelings get in the way. Last time it was about morals. This time... it isn't.
plugin.seed: 但我不会让我的个人感情妨碍我。上次是关于道德的。这次...并非如此。
plugin.target: 但我不會讓我的個人感情妨礙我。上次是關於道德的。這次...並非如此。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Alright. I'll find a way to get cured, if there is one.
plugin.seed: 好吧。如果有办法的话，我会想办法治好的。
plugin.target: 好吧。如果有辦法的話，我會想辦法治好的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I appreciate this, Thane.
plugin.seed: 我很感激，大人。
plugin.target: 我很感激，大人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: We'll head up north and I'll get rid of the artifact, then.
plugin.seed: 我们会往北走，然后我会把魔神器处理掉。
plugin.target: 我們會往北走，然後我會把魔神器處理掉。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You want me to just... kill all of those people?
plugin.seed: 你想让我...杀了所有这些人？
plugin.target: 你想讓我...殺了所有這些人？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It sounds harsh, but it needs to happen. They're a force of evil in this world, Thane.
plugin.seed: 这听起来很刺耳，但它需要发生。他们是这个世界上的邪恶力量，大人。
plugin.target: 這聽起來很刺耳，但它需要發生。他們是這個世界上的邪惡力量，大人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: And they're connected with Maven Black-Briar. That vile hagraven will just get them out of prison if you report them to the guards.
plugin.seed: 他们与玛雯·黑荆棘有联系。如果你把他们报告给狱警，那个卑鄙的巫婆只会把他们从监狱里救出来。
plugin.target: 他們與瑪雯·黑荊棘有聯繫。如果你把他們報告給獄警，那個卑鄙的巫婆只會把他們從監獄裡救出來。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You're the only person who knows where they are - you need to do this. I'll come with you.
plugin.seed: 你是唯一知道他们在哪里的人——你需要这样做。我和你一起去。
plugin.target: 你是唯一知道他們在哪裡的人——你需要這樣做。我和你一起去。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I guess this is the end of the Thieves' Guild.
plugin.seed: 我想这就是盗贼公会的结局。
plugin.target: 我想這就是盜賊公會的結局。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Dark Brotherhood ends today.
plugin.seed: 黑暗兄弟会今天终结了。
plugin.target: 黑暗兄弟會今天終結了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I won't kill my friends for you.
plugin.seed: 我不会为了你杀了我的朋友。
plugin.target: 我不會為了你殺了我的朋友。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: If you consider those people friends, I can't consider you a lover.
plugin.seed: 如果你把那些人视为朋友，我就不能把你视为爱人。
plugin.target: 如果你把那些人視為朋友，我就不能把你視為愛人。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So... you're ready to take me back?
plugin.seed: 那么…你准备好带我回去了吗？
plugin.target: 那麼…你準備好帶我回去了嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Yeah. I wish it could have been less gruesome, but that's just what our lives have come to, hasn't it?
plugin.seed: 是啊。我希望它能不那么可怕，但这正是我们生活的结果，不是吗？
plugin.target: 是啊。我希望它能不那麼可怕，但這正是我們生活的結果，不是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: The Dark Brotherhood is gone. You did Skyrim a service, and showed me that you're not completely lost.
plugin.seed: 黑暗兄弟会消失了。你为天际付出了你的努力，向我展示了你并没有完全迷失。
plugin.target: 黑暗兄弟會消失了。你為天霜付出了你的努力，向我展示了你並沒有完全迷失。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You were right. The Thieves' Guild was reprehensible, I shouldn't have...
plugin.seed: 你是对的。盗贼公会应该受到谴责，我不应该...
plugin.target: 你是對的。盜賊公會應該受到譴責，我不應該...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: It's alright, Thane. We... dealt with them, and I'm ready to trust you again.
plugin.seed: 没关系，大人。我们处理好了他们，我准备再次信任你。
plugin.target: 沒關係，大人。我們處理好了他們，我準備再次信任你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm not sure if killing people who trusted me was right. Especially for your trust.
plugin.seed: 我不确定杀死信任我的人是否正确。特别是因为你对我的信任。
plugin.target: 我不確定殺死信任我的人是否正確。特別是因為你對我的信任。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Thane, they were thieves. A whole syndicate of them.
plugin.seed: 大人，他们是小偷。他们都是一丘之貉。
plugin.target: 大人，他們是小偷。他們都是一丘之貉。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They expected loyalty from you, but would have stabbed you in the back at the first opportunity.
plugin.seed: 他们期望你忠诚，但一有机会就会在背后捅你一刀。
plugin.target: 他們期望你忠誠，但一有機會就會在背後捅你一刀。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I don't know if I'll ever be absolved for what I did with the Dark Brotherhood.
plugin.seed: 我不知道我对黑暗兄弟会的所作所为是否会被赦免。
plugin.target: 我不知道我對黑暗兄弟會的所作所為是否會被赦免。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I can forgive you. I know what type of person you are at heart, and I love you because of that.
plugin.seed: 我可以原谅你。我知道你内心深处是一个什么样的人，因此我爱你。
plugin.target: 我可以原諒你。我知道你內心深處是一個什麼樣的人，因此我愛你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Those people considered me family, and I betrayed their trust...
plugin.seed: 那些人认为我是家人，而我背叛了他们的信任...
plugin.target: 那些人認為我是家人，而我背叛了他們的信任...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: They were murderers, Thane. They masquaraded as a cult that masquaraded as a family.
plugin.seed: 他们是杀人犯，大人。他们像一个家庭一样戴面具，像一个邪教一样戴面具。
plugin.target: 他們是殺人犯，大人。他們像一個家庭一樣戴面具，像一個邪教一樣戴面具。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That kind of treachery wasn't unknown to them. You made the right choice.
plugin.seed: 他们并非不知道这是背信弃义。你做出了正确的选择。
plugin.target: 他們並非不知道這是背信棄義。你做出了正確的選擇。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Anything for you.
plugin.seed: 为你做什么都行。
plugin.target: 為你做什麼都行。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: You really never changed, did you?
plugin.seed: 你真的从来没有变过，是吗？
plugin.target: 你真的從來沒有變過，是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I hope you don't take this lightly.
plugin.seed: 我希望你不要掉以轻心。
plugin.target: 我希望你不要掉以輕心。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Not at all. You just... gave up immortality for me.
plugin.seed: 一点也不。你刚刚...为了我放弃了永生。
plugin.target: 一點也不。你剛剛...為了我放棄了永生。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I just wanted to have some kind of sensual vampire love affair with you.
plugin.seed: 我只是想和你来一段吸血鬼般的性爱。
plugin.target: 我只是想和你來一段吸血鬼般的性愛。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Laughs* Maybe next time you get bit.
plugin.seed: *笑* 也许下次你被咬的时候。
plugin.target: *笑* 也許下次你被咬的時候。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: So... are we back together?
plugin.seed: 那么…我们复合了吗？
plugin.target: 那麼…我們複合了嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: That was the deal, wasn't it?
plugin.seed: 这就完了，不是吗？
plugin.target: 這就完了，不是嗎？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'm glad you went through with this. Come on, we should go.
plugin.seed: 我很高兴你完成了这个。来吧，我们该走了。
plugin.target: 我很高興你完成了這個。來吧，我們該走了。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Being undead is overrated.
plugin.seed: 成为不死者并没有那么好。
plugin.target: 成為不死者並沒有那麼好。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: I'd imagine.
plugin.seed: 我能想象。
plugin.target: 我能想像。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Why would I want to live forever if I didn't have you there with me?
plugin.seed: 如果没有你在我身边，我为什么要永生？
plugin.target: 如果沒有你在我身邊，我為什麼要永生？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: *Laughs* You're a massive sap, and I love you for it.
plugin.seed: *笑* 你是一个大傻瓜，我因此爱你。
plugin.target: *笑* 你是一個大傻瓜，我因此愛你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Why do you still refer to me as "Thane" after all this time?
plugin.seed: 为什么这么久了，你还称我为“男爵大人”？
plugin.target: 為什麼這麼久了，你還稱我為“男爵大人”？
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Because I take my oath as a housecarl seriously. That's who you are to me, first and foremost.
plugin.seed: 因为我认真对待我作为一个家庭主妇的誓言。对我来说，这就是你，首先也是最重要的。
plugin.target: 因為我認真對待我作為一個家庭主婦的誓言。對我來說，這就是你，首先也是最重要的。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: With everything that's happened... I'm more devoted to you than ever.
plugin.seed: 发生了这么多...我比以往任何时候都更忠诚于你。
plugin.target: 發生了這麼多...我比以往任何時候都更忠誠於你。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Really? You've always seemed kind of... casual about being a housecarl.
plugin.seed: 真的？对当管家这件事而言，你看起来总是有点...无所谓。
plugin.target: 真的？對當管家這件事而言，你看起來總是有點...無所謂。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Let me put it like this: To me, you're a hero. You didn't just save Whiterun, you changed my entire life.
plugin.seed: 让我这样说：对我来说，你是英雄。你不仅拯救了白漫，还改变了我的整个生活。
plugin.target: 讓我這樣說：對我來說，你是英雄。你不僅拯救了白漫，還改變了我的整個生活。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Well, yeah, that was part of it. Really, that's why I still see myself as a housecarl.

plugin.source: While travelling in Skyrim, a skilled Dunmer assassin ambushed Lydia and I, but we were able to subdue him. On his corpse, I found a note that indicated a man in Rorikstead named Kolgar. Lydia is insisting we travel there at once.
plugin.seed: 在天际旅行时，一名熟练的丹莫刺客伏击了莱迪亚和我，但我们还是制服了他。在他的尸体上，我发现了一张纸条，上面著名了一个名叫科尔加的洛利克人。莉迪亚坚持要我们马上去那里。
plugin.target: 在天霜旅行時，一名熟練的丹莫刺客伏擊了萊迪亞和我，但我們還是制服了他。在他的屍體上，我發現了一張紙條，上面著名了一個名叫科爾加的洛利克人。萊迪亞堅持要我們馬上去那裡。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Lydia and I interrogated Kolgar, learning that him and the assassin were working for a man named Vonjar Red-Tundra, who told Kolgar to meet him in a farm in eastern Whiterun Hold... which happens to be the farm Lydia grew up on.
plugin.seed: 莱迪亚和我审问了科尔加，得知他和那名刺客正在为一个名叫冯贾尔·红苔的人工作，他告诉科尔加在白漫领东部的一个农场与他会面......那个农场恰好是莱迪亚长大的地方。
plugin.target: 萊迪亞和我審問了科爾加，得知他和那名刺客正在為一個名叫馮賈爾·紅苔的人工作，他告訴科爾加在白漫領東部的一個農場與他會面......那個農場恰好是萊迪亞長大的地方。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Lydia and I found two deserters from the Legion and Stormcloak Rebellion squatting in her old house. It seems that Vonjar was trafficking them through the region before having them travel to their final destination, a place called Coldspire Canyon. The whole experience has been emotionally riveting for my Housecarl...
plugin.seed: 莉迪亚和我发现两名来自军团和风暴斗篷的逃兵蹲在她的老房子里。看来，冯贾尔在让他们前往最终目的地——一个叫冷塔峡谷的地方之前，一直在通过该地区贩卖他们。整个经历对我的侍卫来说非常震惊...
plugin.target: 萊迪亞和我發現兩名來自軍團和風暴斗篷的逃兵蹲在她的老房子裡。看來，馮賈爾在讓他們前往最終目的地——一個叫冷塔峽谷的地方之前，一直在通過該地區販賣他們。整個經歷對我的侍衛來說非常震驚...
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Lydia and I have found Coldspire Canyon - it's an expansive fortress in the mountains segmented by ravines. There are a large number of bandits and deserters guarding it, but also a small trail we can use to get a better vantage point. Vonjar must be somewhere inside.
plugin.seed: 莱迪亚和我发现了冷塔峡谷——这是一座由峡谷分割的山脉中的广阔堡垒。有大量的土匪和逃兵守卫着它，但也有一条小路，我们可以利用它来获得更好的有利位置。冯贾尔肯定在里面。
plugin.target: 萊迪亞和我發現了冷塔峽谷——這是一座由峽谷分割的山脈中的廣闊堡壘。有大量的土匪和逃兵守衛著它，但也有一條小路，我們可以利用它來獲得更好的有利位置。馮賈爾肯定在裡面。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Lydia and I defeated Vonjar, and now she's insisting that I inform the Jarl of Whiterun of his demise, so that his sudden absence from local politics isn't concerning.
plugin.seed: 莉迪亚和我打败了冯贾尔，现在她坚持要我把他的死讯通知白漫领主，这样他就不会突然退出当地政治。
plugin.target: 萊迪亞和我打敗了馮賈爾，現在她堅持要我把他的死訊通知白漫領主，這樣他就不會突然退出當地政治。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

plugin.source: Lydia's insistance on us telling the Jarl about Vonjar's death has landed me in a holding cell, as the Jarl wants to verify that I didn't murder a man in cold blood, despite the arguments of my Housecarl. Finally, she's returned with evidence, setting me free. Now, she's waiting for me on the Dragonsreach Great Porch.
plugin.seed: 莉迪亚坚持让我们把冯贾尔的死告诉领主，这让我被关进了监狱，因为贾尔想核实我没有冷血地谋杀一个男人，尽管我的侍卫提出了反驳的论点。最后，她带着证据回来了，把我释放了。现在，她在龙临堡的门廊等我。
plugin.target: 萊迪亞堅持讓我們把馮賈爾的死告訴領主，這讓我被關進了監獄，因為賈爾想核實我沒有冷血地謀殺一個男人，儘管我的侍衛提出了反駁的論點。最後，她帶著證據回來了，把我釋放了。現在，她在龍臨堡的門廊等我。
plugin.provenance: IFD Lydia CHS 4.2.2 + OpenCC s2tw + terminology normalization

pex.source: Checking this will make Lydia unable to be killed by the player. By default, only the player can kill her. Do not use this if you have another mod that changes Lydia's protection status.
pex.seed: 点选该选项将会使莱迪亚无法被玩家杀害。默认情况下，只有玩家可以杀害她。不要使用该选项如果你有其他改变莱迪亚保护数据的模组。
pex.target: 勾選後，玩家將無法殺死萊迪亞。預設只有玩家能殺死她；若其他模組也會變更萊迪亞的保護狀態，請勿啟用。

pex.source: Having this enabled will make it so that Lydia doesn't object to the player joining the Thieves' Guild, Dark Brotherhood, or Clan Volkihar.
pex.seed: 激活该选项将会使得莱迪亚不会拒绝玩家加入盗贼公会、黑暗兄弟会或吸血鬼阵营。
pex.target: 啟用後，萊迪亞不會反對玩家加入盜賊公會、黑暗兄弟會或沃基哈氏族。

pex.source: Having this enabled will make it so that Lydia doesn't object to the player serving Mehrunes Dagon, Molag Bal, Mephala, Boethiah, Vaermina, or Namira.
pex.seed: 激活该选项将会使得莱迪亚不会拒绝玩家信仰魔神大衮、莫拉格·巴尔、梅法拉、波耶西亚、瓦尔迷娜或娜米拉。
pex.target: 啟用後，萊迪亞不會反對玩家侍奉梅魯涅斯·大袞、莫拉格·巴爾、梅法拉、波耶西亞、瓦爾迷納或娜米拉。

pex.source: A higher number leads to a higher likelihood of Lydia saying something when engine-level scripts call on her to.
pex.seed: 数值越高，莱迪亚对话偏好的脚本频率就越高。
pex.target: 數值越高，引擎層腳本要求萊迪亞發言時，她實際開口的機率就越高。
